title: Manipur Temple Recipes
tagline: 62 sattvic recipes for institutional cooking, written for ISKCON Bangalore

recipes.name: Manipuri Black Tea
recipes.sub: Black tea with ginger and bay
recipes.sub_l: ꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯥꯠ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯆꯥ

method.en: The valley drinks its tea black. Milk tea is a plains habit and worth distinguishing before a menu is decided.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯗ ꯆꯥ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯊꯛꯏ꯫ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯆꯥ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄꯒꯤꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Bruise the ginger with the back of a knife rather than grating it. Grated ginger clouds the tea and has to be strained twice.
method.l: ꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯅꯝꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯆꯥꯏꯅ ꯀꯥꯏꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil the ginger and bay leaf in the water ten minutes before the tea goes anywhere near it.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯅꯥ ꯍꯥꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯥꯠ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯱꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Take the vessel off the fire, then add the tea leaves and steep four minutes. Tea boiled with the leaves in turns bitter.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯆꯥꯅꯥ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯴ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Strain at once. Leaves left in the pot go on brewing and the last cup is nothing like the first.
method.l: ꯈꯨꯗꯛꯇ ꯆꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯆꯥꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Keep it in an insulated urn rather than over a flame, and sweeten at the counter.
method.l: ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯝꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯐ꯭ꯂꯥꯁꯀꯗ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Black, not milky, and off the fire before the leaves go in. Both rules are about not making it bitter.
recipes.why_l: ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯥ ꯍꯥꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯠꯊꯠꯄ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start twenty-five minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯲꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and drunk at every hour.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯄꯨꯡ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯊꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.name: Lemon Ginger Sharbat
recipes.sub: Lemon, ginger and black salt cooler
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ, ꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ

method.en: Roll each lemon hard under the palm before cutting. A rolled lemon gives about a third more juice.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯛꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯝꯗꯨꯅ ꯂꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Squeeze by hand rather than in a machine, and stop before the pith is crushed. Machine-pressed lemon turns bitter within the hour.
method.l: ꯃꯦꯁꯤꯅꯗꯒꯤ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯄꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil the bruised ginger in a few litres of water for fifteen minutes and let it cool before it joins the rest.
method.l: ꯅꯝꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯕ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯔꯗ ꯱꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Dissolve the sugar in warm water first and cool it completely. Sugar stirred into cold water settles at the bottom of the drum.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯪꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add both the black salt and the roasted cumin. Taste it cold — chilled drinks need more salt than seems right.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯖꯤꯔꯥ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Crush the mint by hand and steep twenty minutes. Add the lemon juice last, at the counter.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯗꯤꯅꯥ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯝꯂꯒ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Costs a fraction of a milk drink and the syrup can be made a day ahead.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯃꯜ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯇꯝꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯔꯄ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯁꯦꯝꯕ ꯌꯥꯏ꯫

start.en: Make the syrup an hour ahead and hold it cold.
start.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯁꯤꯔꯄ ꯁꯦꯝꯗꯨꯅ ꯏꯡꯅ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L drum and a juicer. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯗ꯭ꯔꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯖꯨꯁꯔ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: April to September, and doubled in the hot months.
season.l: ꯑꯦꯞꯔꯤꯜꯗꯒꯤ ꯁꯦꯞꯇꯦꯝꯕꯔ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Chak-hao Milk
recipes.sub: Black rice milk with cardamom
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ

method.en: Chak-hao is the black rice of the valley and it grows nowhere else in India in this quantity. It is what a Manipuri feast is known for.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯅꯤ, ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄꯗ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯐꯪꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Soak four hours and boil it in plain water — not milk — for forty minutes until the grains split.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯴ ꯅꯃꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯴꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil it in water first and strain the grain out. Cooked directly in milk, chak-hao turns the whole pot grey-purple and slightly starchy.
method.l: ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Keep the deep purple cooking water. That colour is the point of the drink and it goes back in.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil and cool the milk separately, then combine. Chak-hao water added to hot milk on the flame can split it.
method.l: ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Sweeten, add cardamom and almond, and chill three hours. Serve cold.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ, ꯏꯂꯥꯏꯆꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯕꯥꯗꯥꯝ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯏꯡꯅ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: The colour is the whole dish, and it comes from the cooking water rather than the grain.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ꯫

start.en: Soak the black rice four hours. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯴ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel and a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Festivals, and served cold in summer.
season.l: ꯀꯨꯝꯃꯩꯗ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯡꯅ ꯊꯛꯅꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Heikru Thak
recipes.sub: Gooseberry pounded and steeped cold with honey and rock salt
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯁꯨꯝꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯟꯗꯨꯄꯒ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯧꯁꯤꯅꯕ

method.en: Take the stone out of every one before it goes near the mortar. A cracked heikru seed turns twenty-two litres bitter in one pounding.
method.l: ꯁꯨꯝꯐꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ ꯆꯪꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯀꯥꯏꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯲ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯒꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Pound it in the stone mortar and do not use a mixer. A machine heats the fruit and the drink comes out the colour of weak tea.
method.l: ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯥꯡ ꯁꯨꯝꯐꯝꯗ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ, ꯃꯤꯛꯁꯤ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯔꯣꯏ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤꯟ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯍꯩ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯥꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯛꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥ ꯑꯅꯧꯕꯒꯨꯝꯅ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Honey only after the water is strained and cold. Honey warmed is honey wasted and it is the dearest thing in this list.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯥꯍꯜꯂꯕ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯈꯤꯕ ꯊꯨꯝꯅꯤ; ꯄꯔꯤꯡ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯌꯥꯝꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Serve within two hours. Heikru water standing longer separates into a clear top and a grey bottom and looks spoiled when it is not.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯊꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯦꯡꯅ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯈꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯣꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯕꯁꯨ ꯁꯣꯛꯂꯕꯒꯨꯝꯅ ꯎꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head. In Hiyangei the Ukhrul hill gooseberry comes in by the sack and the vaidya asks for this before any other drink in the book.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯸꯫ ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗ ꯎꯈ꯭ꯔꯨꯂꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯈꯥꯎꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯊꯛꯅꯕ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯑꯃꯥꯏꯕꯅ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯍꯥꯏꯖꯩ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Stoning seven kilos takes two people an hour, and that is the long part.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯷ꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯅꯕ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯧꯏ; ꯃꯗꯨꯅꯤ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L drum, a stone mortar and a coarse strainer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯗ꯭ꯔꯝ, ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯥꯡ ꯁꯨꯝꯐꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯆꯥꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Hiyangei to Wakching, when the hill fruit comes down to the Imphal market.
season.l: ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯍꯩ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯜ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Komla Mahi
recipes.sub: Tamenglong orange pressed by hand with black salt, no sugar
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ, ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯍꯤꯛꯄ ꯇꯥꯃꯦꯡꯂꯣꯡꯒꯤ ꯀꯣꯝꯂꯥ ꯃꯍꯤ

method.en: Press by hand and not through a machine. A machine crushes the white pith and one pressing of it turns twenty litres bitter for the whole day.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯍꯤꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯅ ꯑꯉꯧꯕ ꯃꯔꯨꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯥꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯰ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Twenty-four kilos of orange gives twelve litres of juice. That is the arithmetic and a kitchen that plans on eighteen will be adding water to make up.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯝꯂꯥ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯲꯴ꯅ ꯃꯍꯤ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯱꯲ ꯄꯤ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ ꯃꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ; ꯱꯸ ꯍꯥꯏꯅ ꯋꯥꯈꯜ ꯊꯃꯒꯗꯕ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯠꯇ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: No sugar at all. A Tamenglong orange in Poinu carries its own and sugar on top of it makes a squash rather than a juice.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯄꯣꯏꯅꯨꯗ ꯇꯥꯃꯦꯡꯂꯣꯡꯒꯤ ꯀꯣꯝꯂꯥꯗ ꯃꯁꯥꯒꯤ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯂꯩ; ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯤ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯁꯔꯕꯠ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Serve within the hour. Orange juice standing two hours goes bitter at the top of the drum and no stirring brings it back.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕ ꯀꯣꯝꯂꯥ ꯃꯍꯤꯅ ꯗ꯭ꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯧꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯉꯨ ꯍꯥꯏꯕꯅ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯀ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯂꯥꯛꯂꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-one rupees a head. In Poinu the Tamenglong orange comes down the road at twenty rupees a kilo and is dear the rest of the year; outside that month this should not be attempted.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯱꯫ ꯄꯣꯏꯅꯨꯗ ꯇꯥꯃꯦꯡꯂꯣꯡꯒꯤ ꯀꯣꯝꯂꯥ ꯂꯝꯕꯤꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯰ꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯆꯍꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯌꯥꯝꯃꯤ; ꯊꯥ ꯑꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯄꯥꯟꯗ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯁꯥꯅꯕ ꯍꯣꯠꯅꯔꯣꯏ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Peeling and pressing twenty-four kilos takes three people an hour.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯲꯴ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯍꯤꯛꯅꯕ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯧꯏ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L drum, a hand press and a cloth strainer. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯗ꯭ꯔꯝ, ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯍꯤꯛꯄ ꯃꯁꯤꯟ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯐꯤꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

season.en: Poinu and Wakching only. The rest of the year the champhut sharbat takes its place.
season.l: ꯄꯣꯏꯅꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯈꯛꯇꯗ꯫ ꯆꯍꯤꯒꯤ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯁꯔꯕꯠꯅ ꯃꯍꯨꯠ ꯁꯤꯅꯩ꯫

recipes.name: Chinghi Cha
recipes.sub: Hill herbs boiled thin and drunk hot without milk
recipes.sub_l: ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯁꯥꯍꯜꯂꯒ ꯊꯛꯅꯕ ꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯒꯤ ꯆꯥ

method.en: Bring the water to a full boil and drop the leaves in with the fire off. Leaves boiled four minutes go the colour of pond water and taste of it.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯍꯜꯂꯒ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯔꯤ ꯍꯨꯝꯂꯕ ꯃꯅꯥꯅ ꯄꯨꯈ꯭ꯔꯤꯒꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯒꯨꯝꯅ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Crush the dry ginger coarse and boil it from the start. Sonth needs the full boil; the leaf does not.
method.l: ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯃꯑꯣꯡꯗ ꯁꯨꯝꯗꯨꯅ ꯑꯍꯧꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯨꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕꯗ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯕ ꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯆꯪꯏ; ꯃꯅꯥꯗ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Jaggery off the fire and stirred until it is gone. Boiled jaggery in a herb tea turns it dark and the leaf disappears under it.
method.l: ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯅꯥꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯗ ꯍꯨꯝꯂꯕ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯨꯛꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯃꯥꯡꯈꯤ꯫

method.en: Keep it on a low flame at the counter and pour it hot. A chinghi cha gone cold is a bitter brown water that nobody finishes.
method.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯝꯗ ꯃꯩ ꯅꯦꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯥꯅ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯎ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕ ꯆꯤꯡꯍꯤ ꯆꯥꯅ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯅꯥꯒꯨꯝꯕꯅꯁꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯅꯗꯦ꯫

recipes.why: Four rupees a head, the cheapest line in this book. A hill household gathers a kilo and a half in one Mera morning and it dries and keeps a year.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯴꯫ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯄꯔꯤꯡ ꯑꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫ ꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯌꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱.꯵ ꯈꯣꯃꯖꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯁꯥꯡꯍꯜꯂꯒ ꯆꯍꯤ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Twenty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯩꯐꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯲꯰꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel with a lid and a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and twice a day from Mera to Lamda when the cold sits in the hills.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠꯇ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ, ꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯑꯁꯥꯕ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Sangom Cha
recipes.sub: Tea boiled in milk with cardamom, for a cold Imphal morning
recipes.sub_l: ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯑꯁꯥꯕ ꯑꯌꯨꯛꯀꯤꯗꯃꯛ, ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯍꯅꯕ ꯆꯥ

method.en: Boil the water with the tea and the ginger first and bring the milk in only at the end. Tea boiled in milk from cold is bitter and no sugar covers it.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯆꯥꯅꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ, ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯧꯅ ꯍꯨꯝꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯅ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯆꯤꯅꯤꯅꯁꯨ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯨꯄꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Five hundred grams of leaf to twenty-six litres and no more. Tea is the one thing in this vessel that a hall notices when it is overdone.
method.l: ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯶ꯗ ꯆꯥꯅꯥ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯵꯰꯰, ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕꯗ ꯂꯨꯞꯅ ꯈꯉꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯅꯥ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Once the milk is in, one boil and off. Tea boiled with milk for ten minutes is the colour of brick and tastes of the vessel.
method.l: ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯈꯛꯇ, ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯛꯎ꯫ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯍꯨꯝꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯅ ꯏꯀꯥꯏꯒꯨꯝꯅ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: Strain it into the serving drum and not the other way round. Tea leaves left in a warm drum go on brewing and the last glass is black.
method.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕ ꯗ꯭ꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ ꯆꯥꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯗ꯭ꯔꯃꯗ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯕ ꯆꯥꯅꯥꯅ ꯃꯈꯥ ꯆꯠꯊꯅ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯒ꯭ꯂꯥꯁ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head. The black tea in this book costs a quarter of it and is drunk all day; this is what goes out at six on a Lamda morning when the fog is on the valley.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯶꯫ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯆꯥ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯃꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯊꯛꯏ; ꯂꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯃꯅꯤꯡꯅ ꯏꯃꯐꯥꯜ ꯇꯝꯄꯥꯛꯇ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇ ꯆꯠꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯩꯐꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯳꯰꯫

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, a strainer and a serving drum. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ, ꯆꯥꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯅꯕ ꯗ꯭ꯔꯝ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Mera to Lamda, at six in the morning and at four in the afternoon.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯃꯔꯤꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Tulsi Cha
recipes.sub: Tulsi steeped off the fire with jaggery, no tea leaf in it
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯅꯥ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ, ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯗ ꯂꯧꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯇꯨꯂꯁꯤ

method.en: Pick the tulsi from the tulsi mandap and wash it once. It is offered before it is drunk and a leaf off the road is not what goes in this vessel.
method.l: ꯇꯨꯂꯁꯤ ꯃꯟꯗꯄꯗꯒꯤ ꯇꯨꯂꯁꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯍꯥꯝꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯊꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯀꯠꯄ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯝꯕꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯕ ꯃꯅꯥꯅ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Never boil the leaf. Bring the water to a boil, take it off and drop the tulsi in under a lid for ten minutes.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯨ ꯍꯥꯌꯗꯦ꯫ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯃꯍꯜꯂꯒ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯇꯨꯂꯁꯤ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯨꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫

method.en: Jaggery and not sugar. The two do not taste the same in a tulsi tea and the gul is what makes it drinkable without milk.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ꯫ ꯇꯨꯂꯁꯤ ꯆꯥꯗ ꯑꯅꯤꯃꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯃꯥꯟꯅꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯊꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Strain it and serve it warm. Tulsi tea left on a low flame all morning goes bitter and twenty-six litres is thrown.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯩ ꯅꯦꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯕ ꯇꯨꯂꯁꯤ ꯆꯥꯅ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯶ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯛꯀꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Four rupees a head, and the leaf comes off the mandap in the courtyard. On any Ekadashi it is the one drink the hall can be given without a second thought.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯴, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯀꯣꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯟꯗꯄꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ꯫ ꯑꯦꯀꯥꯗꯁꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯋꯥꯈꯜ ꯑꯅꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯈꯅꯗꯅ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨ ꯄꯤꯕ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯊꯛꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Twenty-five minutes, ten of them under the lid.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯲꯵, ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel with a close lid and a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯆꯦꯛꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and on every Ekadashi and every Kartik morning.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯦꯀꯥꯗꯁꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Paknam
recipes.sub: Steamed gram flour cake in banana leaf
recipes.sub_l: ꯂꯥꯐꯨ ꯃꯅꯥꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯀꯦꯛ

method.en: Whisk the besan into a thick batter with no lumps and rest it thirty minutes.
method.l: ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯗꯣꯂꯥ ꯂꯩꯇꯅ ꯍꯨꯡꯂꯒ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Paknam is normally bound with ngari. Here the roasted ground perilla does that work — it gives the same depth and the same body.
method.l: ꯄꯛꯅꯥꯝ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯉꯥꯔꯤꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯩ꯫

method.en: Roast the perilla on the lowest flame until it just pops, cool it and grind it coarse. It burns in about twenty seconds, so watch it closely.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯆꯥꯗ ꯄꯨꯡꯗꯨꯅ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Pass the banana leaves over an open flame until they turn glossy. Unheated leaves crack along the fold and the parcel opens in the steamer.
method.l: ꯂꯥꯐꯨ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯍꯟꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Spread the batter thin on the leaf, no thicker than a finger. A thick paknam steams wet in the middle and will not set.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯥꯗ ꯃꯄꯤ ꯑꯃꯒꯨꯝꯅ ꯄꯥꯛꯅ ꯊꯤꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fold, tie, and steam thirty minutes. Test with a skewer before cutting and let it cool ten minutes in the leaf.
method.l: ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Perilla in place of ngari, and the batter spread thin. Both decide whether it sets.
recipes.why_l: ꯉꯥꯔꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯠꯇ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯥꯛꯅ ꯊꯤꯡꯕ꯫

start.en: Rest the batter thirty minutes. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Three steamers and a stack of banana leaves. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯳ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯐꯨ ꯃꯅꯥ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯳꯫

season.en: All year. The dish a Manipuri kitchen is known for.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Kabok
recipes.sub: Puffed rice with jaggery and sesame
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯀꯕꯣꯛ, ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ

method.en: Soak the rice overnight, drain it, and dry it in the sun for two days until each grain is hard and separate.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯃꯂꯒ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯀꯪꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast in hot sand rather than in a dry pan. Sand surrounds each grain evenly and that is what makes it puff rather than scorch.
method.l: ꯀꯔꯥꯏꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯂꯩꯉꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Work in small handfuls. A full pan of rice cools the sand and the grains harden instead of puffing.
method.l: ꯈꯨꯠꯀꯪ ꯑꯃꯃꯝ ꯑꯃꯃꯝ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Sieve the sand out at once while the rice is still hot, and keep the sand for the next batch.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕꯗ ꯂꯩꯉꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯅꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Melt the jaggery to a thick syrup and strain it. Jaggery always carries grit and unstrained it goes into the kabok.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯪꯍꯅꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mix the puffed rice into the syrup off the fire and press into trays while warm. Cool completely before tinning.
method.l: ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯌꯥꯟꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Sand-roasted rather than pan-roasted, and that is the only step that decides whether it puffs.
recipes.why_l: ꯀꯔꯥꯏꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯂꯩꯉꯣꯏꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯈꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏ꯫

start.en: The rice must be soaked, dried and roasted. Two days for the drying.
start.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ, ꯀꯪꯍꯅꯗꯨꯅ, ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy iron pan and sand, and drying trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯌꯣꯠ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯩꯉꯣꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: All year, and made in quantity for Kang and for weddings.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯃꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Chak-hao Porridge
recipes.sub: Black rice porridge with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ

method.en: Soak the black rice six hours. Chak-hao has its bran on and will not soften in a short soak however long it is cooked.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯶ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯃꯁꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil it in plain water for a full hour before anything else goes in. This grain takes roughly twice as long as white rice.
method.l: ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯍꯥꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Do not throw the purple water away at any point. That colour is the whole dish and it is in the water, not the grain.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the coconut milk only when the grain is completely soft. Coconut milk added early splits over a long cook.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯀꯣꯅꯠ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯉꯥꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately, strain it, and stir it in off the fire. Jaggery added to hot coconut milk on the flame curdles it.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Finish with grated coconut and cardamom. It thickens hard as it cools, so pull it off looser than it should be.
method.l: ꯌꯨꯕꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯂꯥꯏꯆꯤ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Coconut milk rather than dairy, and the jaggery off the fire. Both are how the valley has always made it.
recipes.why_l: ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯠꯇ ꯀꯣꯀꯣꯅꯠ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ꯫

start.en: Soak the black rice six hours. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯶ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel. One cook who stays with it.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and served at every Kang festival.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Alu Kangmet
recipes.sub: Mashed potato with mustard oil and chilli
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯑꯂꯨ

method.en: Kangmet means mashed with oil and chilli, and it is a whole family of Manipuri dishes. Potato is the commonest but the method works for any boiled vegetable.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯡꯃꯦꯠ ꯍꯥꯏꯕꯁꯤ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯅ ꯅꯃꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil the potatoes the day before and mash them warm, not cold. Cold potato mashes stiff and no amount of oil loosens it.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕꯗ ꯅꯃꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯏꯡꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Heat the mustard oil to smoking and cool it completely before it goes in. Raw mustard oil is harsh and this dish is not cooked afterwards.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: This is the one place mustard oil must be smoked first and it matters more here than anywhere else, because nothing after this step cooks it.
method.l: ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Roast the umorok over an open flame, rub the skin off without washing, and pound it fine. Wear cloth on the hands.
method.l: ꯎꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mix everything by hand and taste before adding more chilli. Umorok is among the hottest in the world and twenty-five grams serves a hundred.
method.l: ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯌꯥꯟꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯌꯦꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Smoked mustard oil and a very small quantity of umorok. Nothing is cooked after mixing, so both have to be right.
recipes.why_l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯎꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯈꯔ ꯈꯛꯇ꯫

start.en: Boil the potatoes the evening before. Start thirty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Two large bowls and a masher. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: All year. On the plate at almost every meal.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯆꯥꯛ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Kelli Chana
recipes.sub: Black chana boiled soft and tossed with ginger and coconut
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯃꯅꯤꯅ ꯍꯨꯝꯂꯒ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯣꯀꯣꯅꯠꯀ ꯌꯥꯅꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯆꯅꯥ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ

method.en: Soak the chana overnight with a spoon of salt. Soaked short it cooks unevenly and half of it is still hard when the counter opens.
method.l: ꯆꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯃꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯝ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯃ ꯌꯥꯝꯗ꯭ꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯗꯦ, ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯝ ꯍꯥꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩꯒꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook it in the soaking water and keep what is left. That black water is half the taste and it goes into the ooti pot rather than the drain.
method.l: ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯗꯃꯛ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯋꯥꯠꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯥꯎꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ, ꯃꯗꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯆꯦꯅꯐꯝꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯎꯇꯤꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫

method.en: Cook it just to the point where the skin splits and stop. Past that it is a chana thongba and this book already has one.
method.l: ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ, ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯂꯦꯞꯄꯨ꯫ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯆꯠꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯆꯅꯥ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯍꯧꯖꯤꯛ ꯂꯩꯔꯦ꯫

method.en: Lemon and coconut at the counter and not in the vessel. Coconut standing in warm chana for an hour turns and the whole tray smells of it.
method.l: ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯣꯀꯣꯅꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯝꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯆꯅꯥꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕ ꯀꯣꯀꯣꯅꯠꯅ ꯁꯣꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯅꯃꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head and six kilos of chana gives a hundred people the protein of a meal. It is what the Govindaji gate hands out on a Wakching morning when the queue is long.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯶, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯅꯥ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯶ꯅ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯆꯥꯃꯗ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯄꯤ꯫ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯃꯤꯁꯤꯡ ꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯒꯣꯕꯤꯟꯗꯖꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯤꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Soaks overnight and cooks ninety minutes. Start the evening before.
start.l: ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯝ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 25 L vessel and a shallow serving tray. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯲꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯅꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and every morning of Kartik.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Chak-hao Tan
recipes.sub: Black rice flour kneaded into the wheat and patted thick
recipes.sub_l: ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ ꯃꯆꯨꯗ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯌꯥꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯇꯦꯡꯕ

method.en: Five parts chak-hao to seven of wheat and no more chak-hao than that. Black rice flour has nothing to bind it and a tan of it alone breaks on the plate.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯃꯉꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯇꯔꯦꯠ, ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯃꯆꯨꯗ ꯄꯨꯅꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ, ꯃꯗꯨ ꯈꯛꯇꯅ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯇꯥꯅꯅ ꯇꯥꯎꯗ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Knead with water off the boil. Chak-hao flour worked with cold water cracks at the edge of every tan.
method.l: ꯍꯨꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯇꯥꯟ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Pat them thicker than a wheat tan. Chak-hao is heavy and a thin one tears the moment it is lifted off the cloth.
method.l: ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ ꯇꯥꯟꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯇꯦꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯐꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Cook it slow on a medium plate. A hot plate browns the outside while the middle is raw, and raw chak-hao is felt in the throat for an hour.
method.l: ꯃꯔꯤꯜꯃꯔꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯇꯥꯋꯥꯗ ꯇꯞꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯇꯥꯋꯥꯅ ꯃꯄꯥꯟꯗ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯄꯤꯔꯛꯏ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯈꯣꯡꯎꯄꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head. Chak-hao off a Bishnupur field costs three times what wheat does, and five kilos in twelve is how a temple puts it on a plate every week instead of once a year.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯰꯫ ꯕꯤꯁ꯭ꯅꯨꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯄ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯍꯦꯟꯅꯤ; ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯲ꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯵ ꯍꯥꯄꯄꯅ ꯂꯥꯏꯁꯉꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯆꯍꯤꯗ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯒꯤ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯇꯥꯎꯗ ꯊꯃꯖꯩ꯫

start.en: Dough rests thirty minutes. Two hours for two hundred and fifty.
start.l: ꯌꯦꯡꯂꯕ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫ ꯲꯵꯰ꯒꯤ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Two iron plates and a wet cloth for the patting. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯌꯣꯠꯀꯤ ꯇꯥꯋꯥ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇꯦꯡꯅꯕ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯐꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

season.en: Hiyangei to Lamda, after the chak-hao harvest is in.
season.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ, ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Sooji Upma
recipes.sub: Semolina roasted and cooked savoury with peas and beans
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯔꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯕ ꯁꯨꯖꯤ

method.en: Roast the sooji dry and keep it aside, then make the tempering in the same vessel. Sooji roasted in the tempering browns unevenly and half of it is raw.
method.l: ꯁꯨꯖꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯒ ꯃꯄꯥꯟꯗ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ, ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛꯇ ꯐꯣꯗꯅꯤ ꯁꯥꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯐꯣꯗꯅꯤꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯁꯨꯖꯤꯅ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯄꯤꯗꯦ, ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Boiling water into the roasted sooji and never cold, poured in a stream while the other hand stirs. Cold water gives lumps that nothing takes out.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯁꯨꯖꯤꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ; ꯈꯨꯠ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯔꯤꯅꯁꯨ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Two and a half parts water to one of sooji at a hall's scale, not the two a house uses. A big vessel loses less steam and the upma is drier than expected.
method.l: ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯁꯨꯖꯤ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ, ꯌꯨꯃꯗ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯖꯤꯟ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯃꯥꯡꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯨꯄꯃꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯋꯥꯈꯜ ꯊꯃꯖꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Cover it five minutes off the fire before serving. That is when the grain opens and an upma served straight off the flame is always a little raw.
method.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯉꯥ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ; ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯛ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯑꯨꯄꯃꯥꯗ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯕ ꯈꯔ ꯂꯩ꯫

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head and it is on the counter in thirty-five minutes from a cold stove. On a morning the pohe has run out, this is what an Imphal kitchen falls back on.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯷, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯩꯐꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯳꯵ꯗ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯝꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ꯫ ꯄꯣꯍꯥ ꯂꯣꯏꯔꯕ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯃꯁꯤꯗ ꯅꯨꯡꯉꯥꯏꯅ ꯍꯟꯖꯤꯜꯂꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty-five minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯩꯐꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯳꯵꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L heavy vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. The two vegetables change with the month and the dish does not.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫ ꯊꯥꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯣꯡꯏ, ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯣꯡꯗꯦ꯫

recipes.name: Mairen Kangmet
recipes.sub: Pumpkin steamed and mashed with chilli and raw mustard oil
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯝꯂꯒ ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ

method.en: Steam it in the skin and scoop the flesh out after. Boiled mairen takes up water and twenty kilos of kangmet becomes twenty-five of nothing.
method.l: ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯝꯂꯒ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟꯅ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯆꯨꯄꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯡꯃꯦꯠ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯲꯰ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯲꯵ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Roast the dry chilli on the flame and crush it in the hand, do not use a powder. A kangmet is judged on the pieces of chilli in it.
method.l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯉꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯒ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ, ꯃꯆꯨ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯔꯣꯏ꯫ ꯀꯥꯡꯃꯦꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯌꯦꯡꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mash it with the hand and not a ladle. A kangmet should show the fibre of the pumpkin; a smooth one is a halwa without sugar.
method.l: ꯆꯃꯆꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯀꯥꯡꯃꯦꯠꯇ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯎꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ; ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯕ ꯍꯂꯨꯋꯥ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Raw mustard oil over it at the end, uncooked. Heated oil kills the sharpness that is the whole reason a kangmet is eaten at all.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ, ꯊꯣꯡꯗꯅ꯫ ꯁꯥꯍꯜꯂꯕ ꯊꯥꯎꯅ ꯀꯥꯡꯃꯦꯠ ꯆꯥꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯤꯕ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head, the cheapest breakfast in this book. In Mera a Thoubal field gives more mairen than the kitchen can use and sixteen kilos costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯸꯫ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯑꯌꯨꯛꯀꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯊꯧꯕꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯅ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯶ꯗ ꯄꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯂꯩ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, most of it steaming.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰, ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯝꯕꯗ꯫

vessel.en: A steamer and a wide mashing tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯡꯅꯕ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Mera to Wakching, out of the field and then the cold room.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯂꯧꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯀꯥꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Morok Metpa
recipes.sub: Roasted chilli mash
recipes.sub_l: ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯕ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯅꯃꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ

method.en: Morok metpa is normally made with ngari. Without it the tomato is roasted longer and the ginger is doubled, and that carries it.
method.l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯉꯥꯔꯤꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯉꯥꯔꯤ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Umorok is among the hottest chillies in the world. Wear cloth or gloves, do not touch the face, and wash the mortar with salt afterwards.
method.l: ꯎꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯑꯀꯪꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯈꯨꯠꯇ ꯐꯤ ꯌꯦꯠꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: One hundred and twenty grams serves a hundred people. A first-time cook should use half that and taste before adding more.
Roast the chillies, tomato and ginger whole over an open flame until the skins blacken in patches.
method.l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ, ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Rub the blackened skins off but do not wash them. Washing takes the smoke off and the smoke is the point.
method.l: ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯠꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯆꯦꯛꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Pound in a mortar rather than grinding. A machine turns it thin; pounded it stays rough, which is how it is eaten.
method.l: ꯃꯦꯁꯤꯅꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯁꯨꯝꯕꯂꯗ ꯁꯨꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: On the table at every meal in the valley. Roasted rather than ground, and the quantity is the whole risk.
recipes.why_l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯩ꯫ ꯀꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Keeps two days. Start thirty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯲ ꯆꯠꯀꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: An open flame and a mortar. One cook, wearing cloth on the hands.
vessel.l: ꯃꯩ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯨꯝꯕꯜ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. On every Manipuri table at every meal.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯆꯥꯛ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Hawaijar Metpa
recipes.sub: Fermented soybean mash
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯅꯃꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ

method.en: Hawaijar is fermented soybean and it is the vegetarian answer to ngari. It is indigenous to this valley and many Vaishnava households already use it for exactly this reason.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯉꯥꯔꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯠꯇ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯩ꯫

method.en: Buy it in small quantity and use it fresh. Hawaijar keeps about three weeks and an old batch smells of ammonia rather than of soybean.
method.l: ꯈꯔꯈꯛꯇ ꯂꯩꯗꯨꯅ ꯑꯅꯧꯕꯗ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the tomato, ginger and umorok over an open flame and rub the skins off without washing.
method.l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ, ꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯎꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Pound the roasted vegetables first and add the hawaijar last, working it in by hand rather than in the mortar.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯁꯨꯝꯂꯒ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Pounded hard, hawaijar turns to a smooth paste and loses the whole beans that give it its texture.
method.l: ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯁꯨꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯃꯥꯡꯏ꯫

method.en: Finish with a spoon of smoked mustard oil and plenty of coriander, and serve at room temperature.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯈꯔ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯣꯛꯆꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: The dish that shows how this book works: an indigenous ferment doing the job of fish, and nothing missing.
recipes.why_l: ꯉꯥꯔꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯠꯇ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ, ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯋꯥꯠꯇꯦ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Make it the same day. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ ꯁꯦꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A mortar and a 6 L bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯁꯨꯝꯕꯜ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year — hawaijar keeps three weeks.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Ushoi Metpa
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo shoot mash
recipes.sub_l: ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯅꯃꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ

method.en: Rinse the soibum twice in cold water and squeeze it out. Straight from the jar it is far too sour for a mash.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯆꯦꯛꯂꯒ ꯄꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil the rinsed shoot ten minutes and drain it. Uncooked soibum in a mash is aggressively sour and stays raw on the tongue.
method.l: ꯆꯦꯛꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯱꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the tomato, ginger and umorok over an open flame and rub the skins off without washing.
method.l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ, ꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯎꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the perilla on the lowest flame until it just pops and grind it coarse. It burns in about twenty seconds.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯆꯥꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Pound the shoot and roasted vegetables together, then stir the ground perilla in by hand.
method.l: ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯨꯝꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Salt last and taste first. Soibum is salted in the jar and a heavy hand cannot be taken back.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: One jar of soibum, opened in September, still on the table in June. Rinse it twice or it takes over.
recipes.why_l: ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯆꯍꯤ ꯑꯃ ꯆꯠꯀꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Rinse the soibum twice. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯆꯦꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A mortar and a 6 L bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯁꯨꯝꯕꯜ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year — soibum keeps a year in its jar.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Heikru Metpa
recipes.sub: Gooseberry pounded raw with chilli, no water in it
recipes.sub_l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯄꯗꯅ, ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯁꯨꯝꯂꯕ

method.en: Take the stone out of every one, without exception. A single cracked seed will carry through four litres and be tasted in the last spoon.
method.l: ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯍꯦꯟꯗꯣꯛꯇꯅ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯀꯥꯏꯔꯕ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯃꯔꯤꯗ ꯆꯠꯊꯒꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯆꯃꯆꯗꯁꯨ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯒꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Pound it raw and never steam it. Steamed heikru loses the sharpness this metpa is made for and turns a dull green.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ, ꯍꯨꯝꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨꯅ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯤꯕ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯃꯅꯃꯅꯕ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: No water at any point. Two and a half kilos of heikru carries enough of its own and a watery metpa will not sit on rice.
method.l: ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯲.꯵ꯗ ꯃꯁꯥꯒꯤ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯃꯔꯥꯡ ꯀꯥꯏꯅ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯔꯕ ꯃꯦꯠꯄꯅ ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯂꯦꯞꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Make it the same hour it is served. Heikru metpa goes brown at the surface within two hours and a brown metpa is left on the leaf.
method.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛꯇ ꯁꯥꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯃꯦꯠꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯥꯎꯗ ꯊꯥꯗꯣꯛꯂꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Six and a half rupees a head. In Hiyangei the heikru comes down from Ukhrul by the sack, and a metpa is the way to put two and a half kilos of it on a plate a devotee will finish.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯶.꯵꯫ ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯎꯈ꯭ꯔꯨꯂꯗꯒꯤ ꯈꯥꯎꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯲.꯵ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯨꯞꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕ ꯇꯥꯎꯗ ꯊꯃꯅꯕ ꯂꯝꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯦꯠꯄꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Pound within the hour of serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫

vessel.en: A stone mortar and a covered bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯥꯡ ꯁꯨꯝꯐꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯨꯞꯄ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯀꯆꯤꯟ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Hiyangei to Wakching, while the hill fruit is in the market.
season.l: ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯍꯩ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Thoiding Metpa
recipes.sub: Sesame roasted dark and pounded dry with chilli
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯃꯨꯛꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯗꯨꯅ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯁꯨꯝꯂꯕ ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ

method.en: Roast the sesame a kilo at a time and stop the moment the seeds start to jump. Two kilos in one kadai burns at the bottom while the top is still white.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯃꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯔꯨꯁꯤꯡ ꯆꯣꯡꯂꯀꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯍꯦꯛ ꯂꯦꯞꯄꯨ꯫ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯅꯤ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯊꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯉꯧꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯈꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯅ ꯆꯥꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Stop before it smokes. A sesame seed roasted past that is bitter and one bitter lot spoils the whole tin.
method.l: ꯃꯤꯡꯁꯥꯡ ꯊꯣꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯂꯦꯞꯄꯨ꯫ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ ꯃꯔꯨꯅ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯗꯕ꯭ꯕꯥ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯥꯡꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Pound it coarse in the stone and not fine in a mixer. This is spooned onto hot rice with oil and a fine powder cakes the moment it touches it.
method.l: ꯃꯤꯛꯁꯤꯗ ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯥꯡꯗ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯃꯑꯣꯡꯗ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯇ ꯊꯥꯎꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯥꯄꯄꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯁꯣꯀꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯍꯦꯛ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Keep it in a tin with a tight lid and it holds three months. In a jar with a loose lid it holds three weeks.
method.l: ꯆꯦꯛꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯗꯕ꯭ꯕꯥꯗ ꯊꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯊꯥ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯆꯦꯛꯁꯤꯟꯗꯕ ꯖꯥꯔꯗ ꯊꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a head, and it is the metpa a kitchen has in Lamda when there is not a green leaf in the Imphal market. Two kilos of sesame is three months of metpa.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯱, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯜ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫ ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯲ꯅ ꯊꯥ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯒꯤ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, most of it roasting in small lots.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰, ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯕꯗ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy iron kadai and a stone mortar. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯌꯣꯠꯀꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯥꯡ ꯁꯨꯝꯐꯝ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Made in Mera and eaten from Hiyangei to Lamda.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯁꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯆꯥꯏ꯫

recipes.name: Chandok Metpa
recipes.sub: Perilla roasted and pounded with chilli, the hill metpa
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯗꯨꯅ ꯁꯨꯝꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ — ꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ

method.en: Roast the chandok on a low flame and stop before it smokes. It has more oil in it than sesame and it goes from roasted to burnt in half a minute.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩ ꯅꯦꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ, ꯃꯤꯡꯁꯥꯡ ꯊꯣꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯂꯦꯞꯄꯨ꯫ ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯂꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫

method.en: Pound it warm and not cold. Cold chandok sets into a cake in the mortar and no pounding afterwards breaks it up.
method.l: ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯅ ꯁꯥꯗꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛꯅ ꯁꯨꯝꯐꯃꯗ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯁꯨꯝꯕꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯥꯏꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Chandok and chilli only. In Tamenglong this metpa is the perilla and the chilli, and anything else in it is somebody else's metpa.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯈꯛꯇ꯫ ꯇꯥꯃꯦꯡꯂꯣꯡꯗ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯅꯤ; ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Use it within two weeks. Chandok is the quickest thing in this store room to go rancid and a rancid metpa is thrown, not served.
method.l: ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯑꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯗꯤꯄꯣꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯁꯣꯛꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯛꯀꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head. Chandok grows in the Tamenglong hills where nothing else will, and a bhakri with this metpa and a chilli was the whole of a field lunch there.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯸꯫ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯍꯧꯗꯕ ꯇꯥꯃꯦꯡꯂꯣꯡꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯍꯧꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ, ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯂꯧꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯃꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯃꯃꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the pounding has to be done while the seed is warm.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯥꯗꯅ ꯂꯩꯉꯩꯗ ꯁꯨꯝꯕ ꯇꯪꯑꯩꯐꯗꯦ꯫

vessel.en: A dry iron kadai and a stone mortar. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯌꯣꯠꯀꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯥꯡ ꯁꯨꯝꯐꯝ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year from the store room, and freshest in Mera when the hill crop comes in.
season.l: ꯗꯤꯄꯣꯗꯒꯤ ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯩ ꯂꯥꯛꯄ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.name: Hendru Metpa
recipes.sub: Tomato roasted on the flame and pounded with chilli
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯁꯨꯝꯂꯕ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ

method.en: Roast the tomato whole on the flame until the skin blisters black, then peel it. A boiled tomato gives a metpa that tastes of nothing but water.
method.l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯒ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨꯅ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the chilli on the same flame after the tomato. Raw ground chilli is heat and nothing else; roasted, it is a taste.
method.l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯩ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛꯇ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯁꯨꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ; ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: No water and no tamarind. Four kilos of tomato is sour enough and a second sour makes the metpa sharp instead of round.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯩꯅꯧ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯴ꯗ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯃꯔꯥꯡ ꯀꯥꯏꯅ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯁꯪꯕꯅ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Raw mustard oil over it at the end. Heated oil kills the smell of the roasted skin, which is the whole of this metpa.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯁꯥꯍꯜꯂꯕ ꯊꯥꯎꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯃꯍꯨꯝꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯗꯨꯃꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Five rupees a head, and it is the metpa to make when the coriander has run out and the hawaijar is finished. Tomato is in the Imphal market every month of the year.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯵, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯥꯡꯃ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯂꯣꯏꯔꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯂꯣꯏꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯁꯥꯒꯗꯕ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫ ꯆꯍꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯥ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯜ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯂꯩ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty minutes, and the roasting has to be done at an open window.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯳꯰, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯖꯥꯡꯒꯨꯒꯤ ꯅꯛꯇ ꯇꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: An open flame and a stone mortar. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯩ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯥꯡ ꯁꯨꯝꯐꯝ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and cheapest in Mera and Hiyangei.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯦꯔꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯃꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Yongchak Metpa
recipes.sub: Tree bean roasted whole and pounded, the strongest metpa here
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯗꯨꯅ ꯁꯨꯝꯂꯕ ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛ — ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ

method.en: Roast the pods whole on the flame until the skin blackens, then shell them. A raw yongchak in a metpa is sharp enough to take the tongue off.
method.l: ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯄ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯒ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯃꯦꯠꯄꯗ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛꯅ ꯂꯩ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯀꯅꯩ꯫

method.en: Roast it at an open window or outside the kitchen. Three kilos of yongchak on a flame is smelt at the temple gate and it stays in the walls for a day.
method.l: ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯖꯥꯡꯒꯨꯒꯤ ꯅꯛꯇ ꯅꯠꯇ꯭ꯔꯒ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯄꯥꯟꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯥꯏꯁꯉꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯀꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫

method.en: Put it out in a small bowl and not a large one. Twenty devotees in a hundred will take it and the rest should not have to smell it across the leaf.
method.l: ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯑꯄꯤꯛꯄ ꯀꯆꯤꯅꯗ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯆꯥꯃꯗ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯀꯨꯅꯅ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯂꯧꯒꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯇꯩꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯇꯥꯎꯒꯤ ꯃꯄꯥꯟꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯍꯟꯗꯕ ꯐꯩ꯫

method.en: Make it the same hour. Yongchak metpa left standing goes from strong to unbearable and a four-litre bowl is thrown.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛꯇ ꯁꯥꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕ ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯦꯠꯄꯅ ꯀꯅꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯈꯥꯡꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯃꯔꯤꯒꯤ ꯀꯆꯤꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯛꯀꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head, the dearest metpa in this book, and it is here because a Manipuri leaf without yongchak on it in Lamda is a leaf somebody complains about.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯰ — ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯌꯥꯝꯕ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ꯫ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯕ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯇꯥꯎ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ ꯀꯅꯥꯒꯨꯝꯕꯅ ꯋꯥꯀꯠ ꯄꯤꯒꯅꯤ, ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯂꯩ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty-five minutes, and the roasting must be done outside.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯵, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯄꯥꯟꯗ ꯇꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: An open flame outside, a stone mortar and a covered bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯃꯄꯥꯟꯗ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯩ, ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯥꯡ ꯁꯨꯝꯐꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯨꯞꯄ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯀꯆꯤꯟ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Wakching to Lamda, the eight weeks the yongchak is on the tree.
season.l: ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛ ꯄꯥꯝꯕꯤꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Hawai Tharak
recipes.sub: Manipuri bean stew
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ

method.en: Any mix of dried beans works — this is the dish a household makes from whatever is in the store.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯌꯥꯏ꯫

method.en: Soak eight hours and throw the soaking water away.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯸ ꯅꯃꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook until a bean crushes to nothing between finger and thumb. Merely soft is not cooked.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯝꯂꯕꯗ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯉꯥꯛꯄ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Use a generous amount of asafoetida. This dish is normally built on maroi, the Manipuri chive, which is an allium and is excluded here.
method.l: ꯍꯤꯡ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯔꯣꯏ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Add the potato only when the beans are already soft, and let it break down into the stew.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯉꯥꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire. It thickens the pot and there is no dairy in this book to do it.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Asafoetida and ginger in place of maroi, which is an allium. Stated here because every Manipuri cook will notice it missing.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯔꯣꯏꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯠꯇ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡ꯫

start.en: Soak the beans eight hours. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯸ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L pressure vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. The everyday pulse of the valley.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Ooti
recipes.sub: Dried peas cooked soft with soda
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯉꯥꯛꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ

method.en: Ooti is defined by its texture — the peas are cooked until they collapse entirely into a smooth, pale stew.
method.l: ꯎꯇꯤ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯉꯥꯛꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: The baking soda is what does that, and it is used deliberately rather than as a shortcut. Sixty grams in five kilos is the right proportion.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯗꯥ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Do not exceed it. Too much soda gives a soapy taste that cannot be corrected and the whole vessel is wasted.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯗꯥ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯐꯠꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Add the soda to the cooking water, not to the soaking water, and skim the foam off as it rises.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯗꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Ooti is traditionally finished with maroi, which is an allium and is excluded here. Asafoetida and a generous hand with ginger take its place.
method.l: ꯃꯔꯣꯏ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯩ꯫

method.en: Keep it pale. There is no turmeric-heavy hand and no chilli powder in an ooti — it should look almost white on the plate.
method.l: ꯑꯉꯧꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Sixty grams of soda in five kilos, and no more. That single measurement is the whole dish.
recipes.why_l: ꯁꯣꯗꯥ ꯶꯰ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯈꯛꯇ, ꯃꯁꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

start.en: Soak the peas overnight. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. Served at Meitei feasts and at Kang.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Mangal Thongba
recipes.sub: Lentils with ginger and bay
recipes.sub_l: ꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯃꯉꯥꯜ

method.en: Wash the moong dal in three changes of water. Moong throws more starch than any other dal and unwashed it foams over the vessel.
method.l: ꯃꯉꯥꯜ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯂꯛ ꯆꯦꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook with the turmeric and bay leaf until it falls apart completely.
method.l: ꯌꯥꯏꯉꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯥꯠ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯉꯥꯛꯄ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Whisk it smooth with the back of a ladle. One minute of this makes more difference than any spice.
method.l: ꯆꯃꯆꯀꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯅ ꯍꯨꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Temper the cumin in oil, let it darken, then add a generous amount of asafoetida and the ginger.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯖꯤꯔꯥ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Asafoetida goes in last of the three — it burns faster than anything else in the pan.
method.l: ꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯃꯁꯤ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯃꯩ ꯆꯥꯏ꯫

method.en: Pour the tempering over the dal in the serving vessel rather than the cooking pot, and finish with coriander.
method.l: ꯇꯦꯝꯄꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯤꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: The dal for a sick tray and for anyone breaking a fast. Nothing in it is heavy.
recipes.why_l: ꯅꯥꯕ ꯃꯤꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯨꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ꯫

start.en: No soaking needed. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯃꯊꯧ ꯇꯥꯗꯦ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a small kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Hawai Amubi Thongba
recipes.sub: Black soybean cooked slow overnight on the dying fire
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯨꯛꯂꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯝ ꯇꯞꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯤ

method.en: Soak it twelve hours and not eight. Hawai amubi is the hardest bean in this store room and a short soak means two hours more on the fire.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤꯃꯗꯣꯏ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯗꯤꯄꯣ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯤꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯋꯥꯠꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫

method.en: Put it on the dying fire at night and take it off in the morning. A pressure cooker gives a soft bean but not the black water, and the black water is the dish.
method.l: ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯃꯨꯛꯂꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯑꯌꯨꯛꯇ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯄ꯭ꯔꯦꯁꯔ ꯀꯨꯀꯔꯅ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯃꯅꯤꯕ ꯄꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯕꯨ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯄꯤꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Salt only when it is fully soft. Salted early, hawai amubi hardens and no amount of further cooking brings it back.
method.l: ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯃꯅꯤꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯤ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯀꯌꯥ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕꯁꯨ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯂꯥꯛꯂꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Mash a quarter of it against the side of the vessel at the end. That quarter is what makes twenty-two litres look rich without a spoon of cream in it.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯤꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯃꯂꯥꯏ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯲ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯥꯡ ꯀꯥꯏꯅ ꯎꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head. Four kilos of hawai amubi gives a hundred people the protein of a meal at half what rajma costs, and the fuel is the fuel that was going to waste anyway.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯵꯫ ꯔꯥꯖꯃꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯗ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯔꯤꯅ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯆꯥꯃꯗ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯪꯒꯗꯕ ꯃꯩꯁꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯅꯁꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕ ꯃꯩꯁꯥ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Soak twelve hours and cook overnight on the banked fire. Two days from the decision to the leaf.
start.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤꯃꯗꯣꯏ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯝ ꯃꯨꯛꯂꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯋꯥꯔꯦꯞ ꯂꯧꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯇꯥꯎ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 25 L heavy vessel with a close lid. One cook to set it and one to finish it.
vessel.l: ꯆꯦꯛꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯲꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯊꯃꯅꯕ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and best from Mera to Lamda when the fire is banked every night anyway.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯛꯂꯛꯄ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯩ꯫

recipes.name: Hawai Angouba Thongba
recipes.sub: White soybean cooked soft and finished with raw mustard oil
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯅꯤꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯊꯥꯎꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯉꯧꯕ

method.en: Soak it eight hours and rub the skins off before cooking. A soybean skin does not soften in two hours on the fire and it is felt in every spoon.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯍꯨꯝꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕꯁꯨ ꯃꯅꯤꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Perilla powder in place of the coconut a plains kitchen would use. It grows here and coconut does not, and it holds the thongba together the same way.
method.l: ꯇꯝꯄꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯀꯣꯀꯣꯅꯠ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯒꯗꯕ ꯃꯐꯃꯗ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯃꯆꯨ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯍꯧꯏ, ꯀꯣꯀꯣꯅꯠꯅ ꯍꯧꯗꯦ; ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯑꯣꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛꯇ ꯄꯨꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Keep the thongba thin. A Manipuri thongba is drunk off the leaf at the end of the meal and a thick one is a plains dish with another name.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯂꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯇꯥꯎꯗꯒꯤ ꯊꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯃꯃꯤꯡ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯇꯝꯄꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Raw mustard oil over it at the end and not in the tempering. That uncooked oil on a hot thongba is what a Manipuri leaf is known by.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ, ꯐꯣꯗꯅꯤꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯗꯕ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯇꯥꯎ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯈꯉꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head. The white bean cooks in half the time the black one does on the same fuel, which is why it is the thongba for a morning decided at seven.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯴꯫ ꯃꯩꯁꯥ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛꯇ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯉꯧꯕ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯤ, ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯦꯠꯇ ꯋꯥꯔꯦꯞ ꯂꯧꯔꯕ ꯑꯌꯨꯛꯀꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Soaks eight hours and cooks an hour. Start the evening before.
start.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 25 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯲꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. It is the thongba of the days between festivals.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫ ꯀꯨꯃꯍꯩꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯛꯀꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Masoor Hawai Thongba
recipes.sub: Whole masoor cooked until the skins split, thin and dark
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯃꯁꯨꯔ — ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯨꯛꯅ

method.en: Soak it two hours. Whole masoor has a skin on it and an unsoaked one takes an hour more on the fire for no reason.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯃꯁꯨꯔꯗ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯅ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫

method.en: Cook it until the skins split and stop there. Past that the thongba goes to a brown paste and the whole point of using the whole pulse is lost.
method.l: ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ, ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ ꯂꯦꯞꯄꯨ꯫ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯆꯠꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯈꯤ꯫

method.en: Take it off the moment the froth rises at the edge. A masoor thongba boiled hard loses its top note and tastes of the masala alone.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯑꯐꯨꯠ ꯀꯥꯈꯠꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯍꯦꯛ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯀꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯁꯨꯔ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯅ ꯃꯊꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥ ꯈꯛꯇꯀꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: No perilla in this one. Masoor already has a heaviness of its own and chandok on top of it makes a thongba nobody takes twice.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯤꯗ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯃꯁꯨꯔꯗ ꯃꯁꯥꯒꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯂꯩꯔꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯀꯅꯥꯒꯨꯝꯕꯅ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯂꯧꯗꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head, and masoor is the cheapest whole pulse in the Imphal market for eight months of the year. It cooks in half the time hawai amubi does.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯲, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯍꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯥ ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯜ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯨꯔꯅꯤ꯫ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯤ꯫

start.en: Soaks two hours and cooks fifty minutes. Three hours before the bell.
start.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯒꯪ ꯈꯣꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

vessel.en: A 25 L vessel and a small tempering pan. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯲꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯐꯣꯗꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯑꯄꯤꯛꯄ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and every second day in Lamda.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Arhar Hawai Thongba
recipes.sub: Toor dal cooked thin with turmeric and raw mustard oil
recipes.sub_l: ꯌꯥꯏꯡꯒꯪ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯊꯥꯎꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯑꯔꯍꯔ

method.en: Cook it with turmeric and a spoon of oil and nothing else. Tomato in from the start stops the dal softening and it sits half done for an hour.
method.l: ꯌꯥꯏꯡꯒꯪ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯃꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ, ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯍꯧꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯃꯅꯤꯕ ꯂꯦꯞꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫

method.en: Asafoetida into hot oil and straight into the dal. Stirred into a cold vessel it does nothing, and in a kitchen with no maroi and no onion it has a great deal to do.
method.l: ꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯊꯥꯎꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯗ ꯍꯦꯛ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯅꯕꯅ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯇꯧꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯔꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯤꯌꯥꯖ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯇꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Whisk it once with a wooden churner before the tempering. A dal that has not been whisked separates in the vessel and the last ladle is water.
method.l: ꯐꯣꯗꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯎꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯨꯃꯅ ꯑꯃꯨꯛ ꯌꯦꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯌꯦꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯅ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯟꯇꯣꯉꯥꯟ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Keep it thin. This is poured over rice with a spoon of raw mustard oil and a thick arhar thongba will not spread across a leaf.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯃꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯄꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯔꯍꯔ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯅ ꯇꯥꯎꯗ ꯁꯟꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head and it is on the counter in fifty minutes. When the count goes up by fifty at nine in the morning, this is the thongba an Imphal kitchen falls back on.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯲, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰ꯗ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯝꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ꯫ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯃꯥꯄꯜꯗ ꯃꯤꯁꯤꯡ ꯵꯰ ꯍꯦꯟꯒꯠꯂꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯍꯟꯖꯤꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Two hours' soak, fifty minutes on the fire. Start three hours before the bell.
start.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰꯫ ꯒꯪ ꯈꯣꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 25 L vessel, a wooden churner and a tempering pan. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯲꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ, ꯎꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯨꯃ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯐꯣꯗꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. It is the thongba of an ordinary Tuesday.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫ ꯃꯑꯣꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Urad Hawai Thongba
recipes.sub: Whole urad cooked overnight, thick enough to stand on rice
recipes.sub_l: ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯝ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯎꯔꯗ — ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯂꯦꯞꯄ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ

method.en: Soak it eight hours. Whole urad has a skin on it and a short soak means a bean that is still a bead after two hours on the fire.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯎꯔꯗꯗ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯋꯥꯠꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯂꯩꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗꯁꯨ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨꯒꯨꯝꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Put it on the dying fire at night and take it off in the morning. The long way gives a thongba that does not need cream to look like it has some.
method.l: ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯃꯨꯛꯂꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯑꯌꯨꯛꯇ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯁꯥꯡꯕ ꯂꯝꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯂꯥꯏ ꯆꯪꯗꯅ ꯃꯂꯥꯏ ꯂꯩꯕꯒꯨꯝꯅ ꯎꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: Salt only when it is fully soft. Salted early, urad hardens and no amount of further cooking brings it back.
method.l: ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯃꯅꯤꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯎꯔꯗ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯀꯌꯥ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕꯁꯨ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯂꯥꯛꯂꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Mash a quarter of it against the side of the vessel at the end. That quarter is what makes twenty litres look rich when the ghee in it is half a kilo.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯤꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯂꯩꯉꯩꯗ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯰ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯥꯡ ꯀꯥꯏꯅ ꯎꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head. On a Ratha Jatra day the urad goes on the fire at nine at night and comes off at six, and the fuel it costs is the fuel that was going to waste anyway.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯶꯫ ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠꯇ ꯎꯔꯗ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯃꯥꯄꯜꯗ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯃꯖꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯪꯒꯗꯕ ꯃꯩꯁꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯅꯁꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕ ꯃꯩꯁꯥ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Soaks eight hours and cooks overnight on the banked fire. Two days from the decision to the leaf.
start.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯝ ꯃꯨꯛꯂꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯋꯥꯔꯦꯞ ꯂꯧꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯇꯥꯎ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 25 L heavy vessel with a close lid. Two cooks, a night apart.
vessel.l: ꯆꯦꯛꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯲꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯈꯨꯠꯊꯥꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: All year, and at every Ratha Jatra and Yaoshang.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯌꯥꯎꯁꯪ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Chagem Pomba
recipes.sub: Rice and vegetables cooked to a thick porridge
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯍꯣꯡꯕ

method.en: Chagem pomba is the valley's one-pot meal and it is thicker than a khichdi — it should pour slowly off a ladle.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯒꯦꯝ ꯄꯣꯝꯕ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯈꯤꯆꯗꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Hawaijar is what makes it chagem pomba rather than plain boiled rice, and it goes in early rather than at the end.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯁꯤꯕꯨ ꯆꯥꯒꯦꯝ ꯄꯣꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry the hawaijar in the oil with the ginger for five minutes before anything else goes in. Added raw at the end it smells only of the ferment.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the colocasia and pumpkin with the rice. Both break down and thicken the pot, which is what this dish wants.
method.l: ꯄꯥꯟ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯏꯅꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the greens only in the last eight minutes. Cooked from the start they go grey-brown and the whole pot looks tired.
method.l: ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯸ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire and keep hot water aside — it thickens hard as it stands.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: One pot, one fire, and it stretches with hot water. The cheapest full meal in this book.
recipes.why_l: ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃ, ꯃꯩ ꯑꯃ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯇꯝꯕ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy 50 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯵꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: All year. The one-pot meal of the valley.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Kangshoi
recipes.sub: Boiled seasonal vegetable stew
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯃꯆꯤꯟ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ

method.en: Kangshoi is not a recipe so much as a method. It is what a valley household does with whatever came from the market, and there is very little oil in it.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯡꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ, ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Add colocasia to every batch. It breaks down and gives the broth its body, and without it a kangshoi is a bowl of water.
method.l: ꯄꯥꯟ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Kangshoi is normally seasoned with ngari and maroi. Neither is used here; asafoetida, ginger and the perilla carry it.
method.l: ꯉꯥꯔꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯔꯣꯏ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Cook the hard vegetables and the taro together for fifteen minutes, then the soft ones for eight.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Keep it wet. Kangshoi is a stew and the broth is poured over the rice — a dry one has been cooked too long.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯅ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire and salt at the very end.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Almost no oil, whatever the market gave, and it is what the valley genuinely eats every day.
recipes.why_l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯈꯔꯈꯛꯇ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year with whatever the market gave that morning.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯐꯪꯕ ꯃꯅꯥꯅ꯫

recipes.name: Eromba
recipes.sub: Boiled vegetables mashed with chilli
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯅꯃꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ

method.en: Eromba is boiled vegetables mashed together with chilli, and it is normally made with ngari. Hawaijar is used here in its place.
method.l: ꯏꯔꯣꯝꯕ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯉꯥꯔꯤꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯩ꯫

method.en: Boil everything together in as little water as possible and drain it thoroughly. A wet eromba cannot be mashed and will not hold.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯔꯈꯛꯇ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯄꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the umorok over a flame and pound it separately before it joins the mash. Wear cloth on the hands.
method.l: ꯎꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯁꯨꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mash while the vegetables are still hot. Cold vegetables do not take the oil or the chilli evenly.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕꯗ ꯅꯃꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Heat the mustard oil to smoking and cool it before it goes in. Nothing here is cooked after mixing, so raw oil stays raw.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mix by hand rather than with a spoon and finish with a great deal of coriander. Serve at room temperature.
method.l: ꯆꯃꯆꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯌꯥꯟꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Uses whatever boiled, costs almost nothing, and hawaijar does the work ngari would do.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔꯅ ꯉꯥꯔꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯇꯧꯏ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel and two large mashers. Two cooks.

season.en: All year. On the plate beside rice at most meals.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Yendem Thongba
recipes.sub: Colocasia boiled in its skin and cooked thin with chilli
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯕ ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ

method.en: Boil the yendem in the skin and peel it after. Peeled raw it itches the hands of whoever is cutting and the itch lasts the afternoon.
method.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯈꯨꯠ ꯆꯤꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯛꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫

method.en: Break the pieces by hand and do not cut them. A knife-cut yendem holds its edges and the thongba never takes hold of it.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯀꯎ, ꯊꯉꯣꯂꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯊꯉꯣꯂꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯕ ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯃꯅ ꯃꯅꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯦꯠꯅ ꯊꯃꯖꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯄꯥꯏꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Perilla powder and not coconut. It grows in the hills here and it is what thickens twenty-eight litres with no flour in it.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯀꯣꯅꯠ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯃꯆꯨ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯍꯥꯄꯗꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯸ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Keep it thin. A yendem thongba is drunk off the leaf at the end of the meal and a thick one sits in the stomach for the afternoon.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯂꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯇꯥꯎꯗꯒꯤ ꯊꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯄꯨꯛꯇ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a head. Yendem grows in the wet corner behind every Manipuri kitchen and nobody plants it; in Mera fourteen kilos costs less than a kilo of paneer.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯱꯫ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯊꯪꯕꯒꯤ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯃꯐꯃꯗ ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ ꯍꯧꯏ, ꯀꯅꯥꯅꯁꯨ ꯊꯥꯗꯦ; ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯴ꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯇꯝꯃꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, most of it boiling and peeling.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰, ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯄꯗ꯫

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel and a boiling pot. Two cooks for the peeling.
vessel.l: ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯅꯕ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Mera to Wakching, out of the ground behind the kitchen.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯊꯪꯕꯒꯤ ꯂꯩꯃꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Ushoi Ooti
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot cooked with peas and a pinch of soda
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯇꯔ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯣꯗꯥ ꯈꯔꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ

method.en: A pinch of soda and no more than a pinch. Forty grams in twenty-six litres softens the pea; more than that and the ooti tastes of soap.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯗꯥ ꯈꯔ ꯈꯛꯇ, ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯶ꯗ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯴꯰ꯅ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯃꯅꯤꯍꯜꯂꯤ; ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯎꯇꯤꯅ ꯁꯥꯕꯨꯅꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil the ushoi once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sourness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯅꯠꯔꯒ ꯂꯩ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Soak the dried pea twelve hours. A dried pea is the hardest thing in this store room and a short soak means two hours more on the fire.
method.l: ꯃꯇꯔ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤꯃꯗꯣꯏ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯗꯤꯄꯣ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯑꯀꯪꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯋꯥꯠꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫

method.en: Keep the vessel uncovered while the soda works. Under a lid the ooti froths over and half of twenty-six litres is on the floor.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯗꯥꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯇꯧꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯎꯇꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯐꯨꯠ ꯀꯥꯈꯠꯇꯨꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯶ꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯂꯩꯃꯥꯏꯗ ꯆꯦꯅꯊꯒꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Ten rupees a head. In Sajibu the bamboo shoot comes off the hill for the cutting and three kilos of dried pea is what a sack costs at the end of the winter.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯰꯫ ꯁꯖꯤꯕꯨꯗ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯛꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯈꯛꯇꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯤꯡꯊꯃꯊꯥ ꯂꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯈꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: The pea soaks twelve hours. Start the evening before.
start.l: ꯃꯇꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤꯃꯗꯣꯏ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, uncovered, and a boiling pot for the ushoi. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Sajibu to Kalen for the fresh shoot; from Mera the soibum takes its place.
season.l: ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯎꯁꯣꯏꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯁꯖꯤꯕꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯥꯂꯦꯟ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ; ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯃꯅ ꯃꯍꯨꯠ ꯁꯤꯅꯩ꯫

recipes.name: Mairen Thongba
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked down thin with its own sweetness and chilli
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯁꯥꯒꯤ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ

method.en: Keep the skin on if it is a country mairen. The skin is what stops fourteen kilos collapsing into a single orange mass.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯣꯏꯅꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯴ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯃꯂꯥ ꯃꯆꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯃꯇꯃꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯅ ꯂꯦꯞꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: No sugar and no jaggery. A mairen in Mera is sweet on its own and a thongba sweetened on top of that is a kheer with chilli in it.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯈꯤꯔ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Let it fall apart on its own and do not mash it. Mairen mashed with a ladle goes watery within twenty minutes of standing.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯍꯅꯨ, ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯆꯃꯆꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Raw mustard oil over it at the counter. Heated oil on a mairen thongba covers the sweetness and the whole vessel tastes of turmeric.
method.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯁꯥꯍꯜꯂꯕ ꯊꯥꯎꯅ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯨꯄꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯌꯥꯏꯡꯒꯪꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head, the cheapest wet dish in this book. In Mera a Thoubal field gives more mairen than the kitchen can use and fourteen kilos costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯸꯫ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯊꯧꯕꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯅ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯴ꯗ ꯄꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯂꯩ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯩꯐꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰꯫

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Mera to Wakching, from the field and then the cold room.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯂꯧꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯀꯥꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Chana Ooti
recipes.sub: Black chana cooked with soda until it breaks on its own
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯁꯣꯗꯥꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯆꯅꯥ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ

method.en: Soak the chana overnight and cook it in the soaking water. That black water is half the colour of the finished ooti.
method.l: ꯆꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯝ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯗꯃꯛ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯔꯕ ꯎꯇꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: A pinch of soda and taste before adding a second. Forty grams in twenty-four litres is right and more than that is soap on the tongue.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯗꯥ ꯈꯔ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯒ ꯑꯅꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯌꯦꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯴ꯗ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯴꯰ ꯆꯨꯃꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅꯗꯤ ꯂꯩꯗ ꯁꯥꯕꯨꯅꯒꯨꯝꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook it until a quarter of the beans break by themselves. That quarter is what thickens twenty-four litres with no flour in it.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯍꯥꯄꯗꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯴ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, chana hardens and no amount of soda brings it back.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯃꯅꯤꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯆꯅꯥ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯣꯗꯥ ꯀꯌꯥ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯁꯨ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯂꯥꯛꯂꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees a head. Four kilos of chana gives a hundred people the protein of a meal, and the ooti keeps overnight without a fridge.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯳꯫ ꯆꯅꯥ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯔꯤꯅ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯆꯥꯃꯗ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯎꯇꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯐ꯭ꯔꯤꯖ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯝ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫

start.en: Soaks overnight and cooks ninety minutes. Start the evening before.
start.l: ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯝ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, uncovered while the soda works. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯁꯣꯗꯥꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯇꯧꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and every third day in Lamda when the market is empty.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯜ ꯍꯥꯡꯂꯕ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯍꯨꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Alu Eromba
recipes.sub: Potato boiled and mashed with roasted chilli, no oil at all
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯍꯥꯄꯗꯅ, ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯕ ꯑꯂꯨ

method.en: No oil anywhere in an eromba and none is wanted. The hawaijar carries it and a spoon of oil turns the whole tray into a kangmet.
method.l: ꯏꯔꯣꯝꯕꯗ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯗꯦ, ꯆꯪꯗꯦꯁꯨ꯫ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯔꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯀꯥꯡꯃꯦꯠ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the chilli on the flame and crush it in the hand. A powder gives heat; the pieces are what an eromba is looked at for.
method.l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯒ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯄꯤ; ꯏꯔꯣꯝꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯌꯦꯡꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil the potato in the skin and peel it after. Peeled and boiled it drinks water and eighteen kilos of eromba is a wet mass.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯆꯨꯄꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯸ꯒꯤ ꯏꯔꯣꯝꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Mash it with the hand and not a ladle. An eromba should show the potato; a smooth one is a paste and comes back to the counter.
method.l: ꯆꯃꯆꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯏꯔꯣꯝꯕꯗ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯎꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ; ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯍꯟꯖꯤꯜꯂꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head, no oil and no fire under the mashing. It is what an Imphal household eats when the market did not come, and eighteen kilos of potato is the whole cost.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯹, ꯊꯥꯎ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯡꯕꯗ ꯃꯩꯁꯨ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ꯫ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯜ ꯂꯥꯛꯇꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠꯇ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯌꯨꯃꯅ ꯆꯥꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯸ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Potatoes boil an hour and are mashed warm. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯨꯝꯂꯒ ꯁꯥꯗꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯏ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰꯫

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a wide mashing tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯡꯅꯕ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: All year. It is the dish of the day the market did not come.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯜ ꯂꯥꯛꯇꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Kuttu ki Puri
recipes.sub: Buckwheat puri for fasting days
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯦꯀꯥꯗꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯄꯨꯔꯤ

method.en: This observance came with the temple and the ingredients on this page are brought in from outside the valley. It is worth saying so on the menu.
method.l: ꯑꯦꯀꯥꯗꯁꯤ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯅ꯭ꯗꯤꯔꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯄꯣꯠꯆꯩ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯄꯥꯟꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯨꯁꯤꯜꯂꯀꯄꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Buckwheat has no gluten, so the dough has nothing holding it together. Boiled mashed potato does that job.
method.l: ꯀꯨꯠꯇꯨꯗ ꯂꯨꯠꯦꯟ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ, ꯑꯂꯨꯅ ꯃꯁꯤꯕꯨ ꯄꯨꯟꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Use cold boiled potato, grated rather than mashed, so no lumps go into the dough.
method.l: ꯏꯡꯅ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯀꯥꯏꯗꯨꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Knead with as little water as possible, greasing the palms with ghee. The dough must be firm.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯔꯈꯛꯇ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯆꯦꯠꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Do not let it stand. Kuttu dough turns slack within twenty minutes, so roll and fry as you go.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯝꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠꯇ ꯑꯅꯤꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯀꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry in medium-hot ghee. Kuttu browns faster than wheat and needs a lower flame than an ordinary puri.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯥꯅ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯉꯥꯃꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: The dough is the whole difficulty, and everything here is bought in rather than grown.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯑꯋꯥꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Boil and cool the potatoes first. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Two deep kadhais and a rolling board. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯀꯔꯥꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯳꯫

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: ꯑꯦꯀꯥꯗꯁꯤ ꯈꯛꯇ꯫

recipes.name: Samak ke Chawal
recipes.sub: Barnyard millet cooked like rice
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯨꯝꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯁꯃꯛ

method.en: Rinse the samak and drain it well, then let it stand twenty minutes. Wet grain in hot ghee steams and turns the vessel sticky.
method.l: ꯁꯃꯛ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯆꯦꯛꯂꯒ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Use two parts water to one of grain, not three. Samak swells more and takes less water than it looks.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Temper the cumin in ghee, add the ginger and chilli, then the drained samak and fry two minutes.
method.l: ꯉꯥꯃꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯖꯤꯔꯥ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯁꯃꯛ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add water and rock salt, bring to a boil, cover, and cook twelve minutes on the lowest flame.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯱꯲ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Rest ten minutes with the lid on before opening. Stirred hot, samak becomes paste faster than any rice.
method.l: ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯱꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fork through the crushed peanut, coriander and lemon just before serving.
method.l: ꯄꯤꯅꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯕꯥꯗꯥꯝ, ꯀꯣꯛꯆꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Twelve minutes and it feeds a fasting hall. The only trap is treating it like rice and drowning it.
recipes.why_l: ꯱꯲ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠꯇ ꯃꯤ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯆꯥꯕ ꯉꯃꯒꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Rinse and drain twenty minutes before cooking.
start.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯆꯦꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: ꯑꯦꯀꯥꯗꯁꯤ ꯈꯛꯇ꯫

recipes.name: Vrat ke Aloo
recipes.sub: Potato with cumin and rock salt
recipes.sub_l: ꯖꯤꯔꯥ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯑꯂꯨ

method.en: Boil the potatoes the day before and chill them. Cold potato breaks into clean pieces; warm potato mashes at a touch.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Break them by hand rather than cutting — torn faces hold the tempering.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯛꯄꯗꯒꯤ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯊꯨꯒꯥꯏꯕ ꯐꯩ꯫

method.en: Temper a generous quantity of cumin in ghee. On a fasting day there is no asafoetida, so cumin carries the dish alone.
method.l: ꯑꯦꯀꯥꯗꯁꯤꯗ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ, ꯖꯤꯔꯥꯅ ꯈꯛꯇꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯏ꯫

method.en: Add the ginger and green chilli, then the chopped tomato, and cook until it collapses.
method.l: ꯁꯤꯡ, ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the potato with rock salt and crushed pepper and turn with a flat ladle rather than stirring.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯃꯑꯣꯡꯗ ꯑꯣꯟꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add a little hot water if it looks dry and finish with coriander and lemon off the fire.
method.l: ꯑꯀꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯔ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Rock salt only, no asafoetida, and cumin doing all the work.
recipes.why_l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯁꯦꯟꯙꯥ ꯈꯛꯇ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯖꯤꯔꯥꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯇꯧꯏ꯫

start.en: Boil the potatoes the evening before.
start.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: ꯑꯦꯀꯥꯗꯁꯤ ꯈꯛꯇ꯫

recipes.name: Singhare ka Halwa
recipes.sub: Water chestnut flour halwa
recipes.sub_l: ꯁꯤꯡꯍꯥꯔꯥ ꯃꯆꯨꯒꯤ ꯍꯂꯨꯋꯥ

method.en: Roast the singhara flour in ghee on a low flame for a full thirty minutes. It is heavier than semolina and takes longer to lose its raw smell.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯆꯥꯗ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: It is ready when it turns pinkish-brown and smells sweet. Under-roasted it tastes chalky and sits heavy.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯉꯥꯜ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯁꯦꯝꯂꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stir constantly. Singhara flour is fine and catches on the bottom faster than semolina.
method.l: ꯃꯇꯝ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯍꯨꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil the water and sugar separately and keep the syrup at a rolling boil.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Pour the boiling syrup into the roasted flour and stand back. Syrup that is not boiling lumps the halwa instantly.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯤꯕ ꯁꯤꯔꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯆꯨꯗ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯩꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stir until the ghee separates, then fold in cardamom and nuts and cover five minutes off the fire.
method.l: ꯉꯥꯃꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩ ꯍꯨꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: The fasting sweet that does not feel like a compromise, provided the flour is properly roasted.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯐꯖꯅ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯆꯤꯟ ꯍꯥꯎꯏ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: ꯑꯦꯀꯥꯗꯁꯤ ꯈꯛꯇ꯫

recipes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
recipes.sub: Sago soaked to the grain and turned with groundnut and potato
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯔꯨ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯨꯡꯐꯂꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯂꯨꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯕ ꯁꯥꯕꯨꯗꯥꯅꯥ

method.en: Wash the sago three times and soak it in water that only just covers it. Sago under two inches of water is paste by morning and nothing separates it.
method.l: ꯁꯥꯕꯨꯗꯥꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯂꯛ ꯍꯥꯝꯗꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯈꯣꯡ ꯆꯨꯝꯅ ꯀꯨꯞꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯂꯩꯕꯗ ꯅꯃꯂꯕ ꯁꯥꯕꯨꯗꯥꯅꯥꯅ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕꯗ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯔꯤꯅꯁꯨ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅꯍꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Six hours is enough here and not the overnight the plains use. A longer soak only makes it wetter and a wet sabudana will not separate in the pan.
method.l: ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯨꯛ ꯃꯔꯥꯡ ꯀꯥꯏ, ꯇꯝꯄꯥꯛꯅ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯋꯥꯏꯔꯝ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯕꯅ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯁꯥꯕꯨꯗꯥꯅꯥꯅ ꯀꯗꯥꯏꯗ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Roast the groundnut, skin it and crush it coarse. Whole groundnut rolls off the spoon and the crushed part is what stops the sago sticking.
method.l: ꯃꯨꯡꯐꯂꯤ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯒ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯃꯑꯣꯡꯗ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯃꯨꯡꯐꯂꯤꯅ ꯆꯃꯆꯗꯒꯤ ꯆꯦꯅꯊꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯨꯝꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯁꯥꯕꯨꯗꯥꯅꯥ ꯅꯥꯛꯄ ꯂꯦꯞꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Rock salt only, and taste it at the pan. On a fast day the difference matters to the devotee even where it does not to the cook.
method.l: ꯏꯟꯗꯨꯄ ꯈꯛꯇ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯗꯥꯏꯗꯃꯛꯇ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯌꯦꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯑꯦꯀꯥꯗꯁꯤꯗ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯗ꯭ꯔꯕꯁꯨ ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡꯕꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏ꯫
