method.en: Soak at least six hours. The bran is intact and this grain takes roughly twice as long as white rice.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯶ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯃꯁꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Do not drain it. Unlike white rice, chak-hao is cooked by absorption so that the colour stays in the pot rather than going down the sink.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯄꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯒꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Use about two parts water to one of rice and cook covered on the lowest flame for forty minutes.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯴꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Rest fifteen minutes with the lid on before opening. Chak-hao firms up in the resting and is chewy straight off the fire.
method.l: ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯱꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Serve it plain. This rice is expensive and the point of it is the colour and the nutty bite, not what is added to it.
method.l: ꯑꯀꯣꯏꯕ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯄꯤꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Absorption rather than draining, because the colour is in the water and pouring it away wastes the whole point.
recipes.why_l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯄꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯇꯕꯅꯤ, ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯩ꯫

start.en: Soak the black rice six hours. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯶ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Festivals. The rice a Manipuri feast is not held without.
season.l: ꯀꯨꯝꯃꯩꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Kabok Chak
recipes.sub: Turmeric rice with bay and ghee
recipes.sub_l: ꯌꯥꯏꯉꯥꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯆꯥꯛ

method.en: This is the rice cooked for offerings and for a wedding, and its colour comes from turmeric rather than saffron.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯅ꯭ꯗꯤꯔꯗ ꯀꯠꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ, ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯌꯥꯏꯉꯥꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Rinse and soak the rice twenty minutes, then drain it thoroughly for ten more.
method.l: ꯆꯦꯛꯂꯒ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯅꯃꯂꯒ ꯄꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Use a light hand with the turmeric. Eighty grams in nine kilos gives a pale gold; more gives a hard yellow that looks artificial.
method.l: ꯌꯥꯏꯉꯥꯡ ꯈꯔꯈꯛꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Temper the whole spices in ghee, add the drained rice, and fry gently two minutes turning with a flat ladle.
method.l: ꯉꯥꯃꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add hot water at about one and a half parts to one of rice, cover, and cook twelve minutes on the lowest flame.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯱.꯵ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯱꯲ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Rest ten minutes with the lid on, then fork through gently. Never stir rice with a spoon.
method.l: ꯱꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯃꯑꯣꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: A light hand with the turmeric. Everything else is a plain rice and this is the one decision in it.
recipes.why_l: ꯌꯥꯏꯉꯥꯡ ꯈꯔꯈꯛꯇ, ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯆꯨꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Soak the rice twenty minutes and drain well.
start.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯅꯃꯂꯒ ꯄꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Festivals and temple offerings.
season.l: ꯀꯨꯝꯃꯩ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯅ꯭ꯗꯤꯔꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ꯫

recipes.name: Hawai Chak
recipes.sub: Rice cooked with soaked white soybean in the same vessel
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯗꯃꯛꯇ ꯅꯃꯂꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯉꯧꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ

method.en: Soak the hawai eight hours and boil it half done before the rice goes in. Rice is done in twelve minutes and a hawai in forty.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯁꯦꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰ꯗ꯫

method.en: Rub the skins off the soaked hawai. A soybean skin does not soften and it is found in the mouth in a plain rice where nothing hides it.
method.l: ꯅꯃꯂꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯤꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯔꯤꯅꯁꯨ ꯂꯣꯅꯁꯤꯅꯗꯕ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯇ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯥꯗ ꯐꯉꯏ꯫

method.en: Drain the rice and do not let it absorb. A hawai chak is a plain rice with beads in it and a sticky one is a khichdi by accident.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯀꯎ, ꯆꯨꯄꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯍꯅꯒꯅꯨ꯫ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯥꯛꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯈꯉꯍꯧꯗꯅ ꯈꯤꯆꯗꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: A spoon of raw mustard oil turned through at the end. It keeps thirty kilos from setting into a block on the way to the hall.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯃ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯆꯠꯄꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯳꯰ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯅꯁꯤꯅꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯉꯥꯀꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head, one vessel and one cook. A kilo and a half of hawai in the rice means the dal beside it can be thinner and the day still holds.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯸, ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛꯇ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱.꯵ ꯂꯩꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯗꯥꯜ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯌꯥꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯆꯠꯊꯏ꯫

start.en: Hawai soaks eight hours. Start the evening before.
start.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯅꯃꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel and a draining basket. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯅꯕ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and on any day the dal is thin.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯗꯥꯜ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Champra Chak
recipes.sub: Rice turned through with citron juice and its grated skin
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯝꯄ꯭ꯔ ꯃꯍꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ

method.en: Grate the skin before the fruit is cut and keep the white pith out. The pith is the bitterness in a citron and it does not cook away.
method.l: ꯍꯩ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯑꯉꯧꯕ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯆꯝꯄ꯭ꯔꯗ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕꯁꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: The juice goes in off the fire. Boiled citron juice turns bitter in ninety seconds and twenty-eight kilos of rice cannot be washed.
method.l: ꯃꯍꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯆꯝꯄ꯭ꯔ ꯃꯍꯤꯅ ꯁꯦꯀꯦꯟꯗ ꯹꯰ꯗ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯲꯸ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯝꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Cook the rice drier than usual. Citron juice is a liquid and a rice already soft goes to paste the moment it is turned through.
method.l: ꯃꯑꯣꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯆꯝꯄ꯭ꯔ ꯃꯍꯤ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯥꯅꯅ ꯃꯅꯤꯔꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Turn it with two ladles and lift, do not stir. A rice stirred in a round breaks and the whole vessel is a chitranna gone wrong.
method.l: ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯅꯤꯅ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ, ꯀꯨꯟꯗꯨꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯀꯨꯟꯗꯨꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯑꯣꯡ ꯆꯨꯃꯗꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head. In Poinu the Tamenglong citron is on every cart at thirty rupees a kilo, and this is the rice that carries a plain kangshoi meal.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯰꯫ ꯄꯣꯏꯅꯨꯗ ꯇꯥꯃꯦꯡꯂꯣꯡꯒꯤ ꯆꯝꯄ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯳꯰ꯗ ꯒꯥꯔꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯀꯥꯡꯁꯣꯏꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯄꯨꯔꯤꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Grate and squeeze while the rice cooks. Fifty minutes.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯍꯤꯀꯎ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel, a grater and two long ladles. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ, ꯀꯣꯛꯅꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯁꯥꯡꯕ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Poinu to Lamda, while the citron is on the carts.
season.l: ꯆꯝꯄ꯭ꯔ ꯒꯥꯔꯤꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯄꯣꯏꯅꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Mairen Chak
recipes.sub: Rice cooked with diced pumpkin so the grains take its colour
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯛꯅ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯂꯧꯅꯕ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯅꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ

method.en: Dice the mairen large, an inch to the side. A small dice dissolves and thirty kilos of rice is orange with nothing in it.
method.l: ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯟꯆ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯨ꯫ ꯑꯄꯤꯛꯄ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯈꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯳꯰ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯀꯃꯂꯥ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Put the mairen in when the rice is half done. From the start it is gone; at the end it is raw in the middle.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯁꯦꯝꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯑꯍꯧꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯈꯤ; ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Cook the rice drier than usual. A mairen gives up water for twenty minutes after the fire is out and a wet vessel is a khichdi.
method.l: ꯃꯑꯣꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯅꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯈꯤꯆꯗꯤꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: No sugar of any kind. A mairen in Mera is sweet enough to be mistaken for a sweet rice already and nothing needs to help it.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯅꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ ꯍꯥꯌꯅ ꯂꯃꯍꯧꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯅ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯇꯦꯡ ꯄꯥꯡꯅꯕ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ꯫

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head, the cheapest rice in this book. In Mera a Thoubal field gives more mairen than the kitchen can use and four kilos of it colours thirty.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯵ — ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯊꯧꯕꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯅ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯔꯤꯅ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯳꯰ꯗ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯄꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Dice while the rice comes to the boil. Forty minutes.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯍꯨꯃꯗꯣꯛꯂꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯀꯛꯂꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Mera to Wakching, from the field and then the cold room.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯂꯧꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯀꯥꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Chakhi Chak
recipes.sub: Rice cooled and folded through with salted curd
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯅꯂꯒ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯤꯗ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ

method.en: The rice has to be completely cold. Warm rice in curd splits six kilos of it before the vessel reaches the hall.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯤꯗ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨ ꯌꯧꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Cook the rice softer than usual and break the grain a little. A separate grain will not hold curd and the vessel goes watery at the bottom.
method.l: ꯃꯑꯣꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯃꯅꯤꯅ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯈꯔ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅꯕ ꯃꯔꯨꯅ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯤ ꯄꯥꯏꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Fold it in an hour before the bell and no earlier. Curd in rice for three hours is a sour rice and nobody asked for one.
method.l: ꯒꯪ ꯈꯣꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯒꯤ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛꯇ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯤꯅ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯅꯥꯅꯁꯨ ꯍꯥꯌꯖꯈꯤꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Keep a litre of curd back and stir it in at the counter. Rice drinks curd for an hour and the vessel that was right in the kitchen is dry in the hall.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯤ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯑꯃ ꯋꯥꯠꯍꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯤ ꯆꯨꯄꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯆꯨꯃꯂꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨꯗ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-one rupees a head and no fire under it at the counter. On a Kalen day when the hall is at thirty-four degrees it is the only rice a devotee finishes.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯱, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯃꯩ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨ ꯗꯤꯒ꯭ꯔꯤ ꯳꯴ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕ ꯀꯥꯂꯦꯅꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡꯕꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯅ ꯆꯥꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Rice is cooked two hours ahead and cooled. Curd folded in an hour before the bell.
start.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯅꯩ꯫ ꯒꯪ ꯈꯣꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯒꯤ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯤ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel, a cooling tray and a tempering pan. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ, ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯅꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯐꯣꯗꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Sajibu to Kalen, and on any day above thirty degrees.
season.l: ꯁꯖꯤꯕꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯥꯂꯦꯟ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯗꯤꯒ꯭ꯔꯤ ꯳꯰ꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Pulao
recipes.sub: Rice cooked in ghee with whole spice and the winter vegetables
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯡꯊꯃꯊꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ

method.en: Soak the basmati twenty minutes and no longer. An hour's soak gives a grain that breaks in the vessel and a pulao of broken rice is a khichdi with a garnish.
method.l: ꯕꯁꯃꯇꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ, ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯕꯅ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯏꯔꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯄꯨꯂꯥꯎ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯈꯤꯆꯗꯤꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry the whole spice in the ghee until it is smelt across the kitchen, then the rice. Spice added after the rice sits on top and gives nothing.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ, ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥꯅ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯄꯤꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: One and a half measures of water to one of soaked rice. Two measures is the plain-rice ratio and it gives a pulao that sticks in the ladle.
method.l: ꯅꯃꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ꯫ ꯑꯅꯤꯅ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯁꯤꯡꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯆꯃꯆꯗ ꯅꯥꯛꯄ ꯄꯨꯂꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: Off the fire, lid on, twelve minutes, and nobody opens it. Every look costs the vessel two minutes of steam and thirty kilos cannot be recooked.
method.l: ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯨ, ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯅꯥꯅꯁꯨ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯑꯃꯨꯛ ꯍꯨꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄꯗ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯑꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯡꯁꯥꯡ ꯃꯥꯡꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯳꯰ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

recipes.why: Forty-four rupees a head, most of it the ghee and the basmati. This is the Ratha Jatra rice and the wedding rice, and on any other day the hall gets a hawai chak.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯴꯴, ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯕꯁꯃꯇꯤꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨꯗ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯄꯤ꯫

start.en: Rice soaks twenty minutes. Fifty minutes in all, and twelve of them under the lid.
start.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯅꯃꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰, ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯗ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel with a close lid. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯆꯦꯛꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Wakching to Lamda for the vegetables; at Ratha Jatra with peas alone.
season.l: ꯃꯅꯥꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ; ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕꯗ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯈꯛꯇꯅ꯫

recipes.name: Tan
recipes.sub: Manipuri fried flatbread
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯇꯥꯟ

method.en: Tan is a fried flatbread and it is closer to a puri than to a roti, though it is rolled thinner and larger.
method.l: ꯇꯥꯟ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯔꯣꯇꯤꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add a little sugar to the dough. It is not for sweetness — it is what gives the tan its colour in the oil.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨꯗ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯈꯔ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯆꯨꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Knead a stiff dough and rest it thirty minutes. A soft dough drinks oil and comes out heavy.
method.l: ꯆꯦꯠꯄ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯁꯦꯝꯂꯒ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roll thinner and larger than a puri — about the size of a spread hand.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯔꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯥꯛꯅ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯎꯅ ꯂꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roll on a lightly oiled board rather than a floured one. Loose flour burns in the kadhai and darkens the oil within two batches.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯇꯩꯕ ꯄꯥꯠꯇ ꯂꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry in hot oil and press the centre lightly so it puffs. Drain on mesh.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯖꯥꯂꯤꯗ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: A spoon of sugar for colour and an oiled board. Both are small and both are what a halwai does.
recipes.why_l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯈꯔ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯇꯩꯕ ꯄꯥꯠ꯫

start.en: Rest the dough thirty minutes. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Three deep kadhais and two rolling boards. Four cooks.
vessel.l: ꯀꯔꯥꯏ ꯳꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯴꯫

season.en: All year. The bread of a Manipuri breakfast.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Phulka
recipes.sub: Plain puffed wheat roti
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯆꯨꯝꯕ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ

method.en: Knead soft — softer than feels right. A stiff dough gives a phulka that will not puff no matter how hot the flame.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯦꯃꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Rest thirty minutes under a damp cloth so the flour takes up the water fully.
method.l: ꯐꯤ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕꯅ ꯀꯨꯞꯁꯤꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Knead again briefly after the rest, then divide into equal balls.
method.l: ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯑꯃꯨꯛ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯂꯒ ꯃꯔꯥꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯅ ꯀꯥꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roll evenly. A phulka thicker in the middle than at the edge will puff only at the rim.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯅꯅ ꯂꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook the first side lightly, the second until spots appear, then move it onto the open flame where it should balloon in seconds.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕ ꯃꯄꯥꯟ ꯈꯔ, ꯑꯅꯤꯁꯨꯕꯗ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯂꯥꯛꯂꯕꯗ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stack in a cloth-lined basket with a smear of ghee. Bare stacking steams them soft and leathery.
method.l: ꯐꯤ ꯊꯥꯗꯨꯅ ꯄꯥꯛꯆꯥꯗ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Soft dough, even rolling, open flame. Nothing else, and every kitchen still gets one of the three wrong.
recipes.why_l: ꯅꯦꯃꯕ ꯃꯆꯨ, ꯆꯥꯅꯕ ꯂꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄ, ꯃꯩ꯫

start.en: Rest the dough thirty minutes. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Six tawas and an open flame. Six cooks.
vessel.l: ꯇꯋꯥ ꯶ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯩ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯶꯫

season.en: All year.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Rice Flour Roti
recipes.sub: Flatbread from rice flour
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯆꯨꯒꯤ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ

method.en: There is no wheat tradition in the valley and the breads in this book are few for that reason. That is honest rather than a gap.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯗ ꯒꯦꯍꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯥꯛ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Pour boiling water onto the rice flour, not the flour into the water, and stir hard with a wooden spoon.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯤꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯆꯨꯗ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯨꯅ ꯍꯨꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boiling water, not warm. Rice flour has no gluten and it is the heat that gelatinises the starch — that is the only thing holding the roti together.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ, ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯤꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Knead as soon as it can be handled, while still genuinely hot. A cooled dough will not come together.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯁꯦꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯏꯡꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯄꯨꯟꯁꯤꯜꯂꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Pat between two greased sheets rather than rolling on a floured board, and keep the dough covered.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯇꯩꯕ ꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯛꯇ ꯊꯤꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook on a medium tawa and expect a shorter shelf than a wheat roti. These go hard within twenty minutes.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯥꯅ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯇꯋꯥꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Boiling water and hot hands. Manipur eats rice, and this is what happens when rice has to become a bread.
recipes.why_l: ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯤꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯈꯨꯠ꯫

start.en: The dough must be made with boiling water and used hot.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯤꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Four heavy tawas. Four cooks.
vessel.l: ꯇꯋꯥ ꯴꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯴꯫

season.en: All year. Manipur is rice country and this section is thin for that reason.
season.l: ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯂꯃꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Puri
recipes.sub: Wheat rolled small and fried to order in a deep kadai
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯄꯤꯛꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯥꯟꯗꯨꯅ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏꯗ ꯋꯥꯍꯪꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯨꯡ ꯏꯟꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯅꯕ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ

method.en: The dough is stiff, stiffer than a roti dough. A soft dough drinks oil and five hundred puri come out heavy.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯅꯕꯅꯤ, ꯔꯣꯇꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯀꯅꯕ꯫ ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯆꯨꯄꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯨꯔꯤ ꯃꯉꯥꯔꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: A handful of semolina in the flour. It is what keeps a puri crisp for the twenty minutes between the kadai and the leaf.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨꯗ ꯁꯨꯖꯤ ꯈꯨꯠꯃꯨꯛ ꯑꯃ꯫ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇꯥꯎꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ ꯄꯨꯔꯤ ꯀꯨꯔꯨꯛꯇꯤꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯃꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Rest the dough half an hour and no longer. A dough left an hour goes slack and the puri will not puff.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯍꯅꯨ, ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯃꯅꯤꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯨꯔꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯣꯝꯂꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Fry in lots of twenty and press each one down once with the ladle. That one press is what makes it rise and a puri pressed twice is flat.
method.l: ꯀꯨꯅꯅꯤꯃꯗꯣꯏ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛꯇ ꯆꯃꯆꯅ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯅꯃꯨ꯫ ꯅꯃꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯄꯣꯝꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯅꯃꯂꯕ ꯄꯨꯔꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees a head. Wheat is not a Manipur crop and every kilo comes up the road, so this is the roti for a festival and a chak-hao chak carries an ordinary day.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯳꯫ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯩ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯂꯝꯕꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ; ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯀꯨꯃꯍꯩꯒꯤ ꯔꯣꯇꯤꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯑꯣꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯄꯨꯔꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: The dough rests half an hour. Two hours in all for five hundred.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫ ꯃꯉꯥꯔꯥꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A deep kadai and two rolling boards. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯅꯐꯝ ꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

season.en: All year, at Ratha Jatra and Janmashtami above all.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯖꯅ꯭ꯃꯥꯁ꯭ꯇꯃꯤꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Paratha
recipes.sub: Wheat folded in layers with ghee and turned on a griddle
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯨꯄꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯇꯋꯥꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ

method.en: The dough is soft here, softer than for a puri. A stiff dough will not take layers and the paratha comes off the tawa as a board.
method.l: ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕꯅꯤ, ꯄꯨꯔꯤꯒꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕ꯫ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯧꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯔꯥꯆꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯋꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯥꯠꯀꯨꯝꯅ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Ghee between the folds and not in the dough. Ghee kneaded in gives a rich flat bread; ghee folded in gives the layers.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯀꯨꯄꯁꯤꯅꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯛꯇ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯨꯗ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯅ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ ꯄꯤ; ꯀꯨꯄꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕꯅ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: Three folds and no more. Every fold past three is a layer nobody can taste and a minute more on a tawa for three hundred.
method.l: ꯀꯨꯄꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯈꯛꯇ, ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯍꯨꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯀꯨꯄꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯀꯅꯥꯅꯁꯨ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯐꯉꯗꯕ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯃꯊꯥꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯇꯋꯥꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯦꯟꯅꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stack them in a cloth-lined basket and never on a plate. A paratha on a metal plate sweats and the bottom of the stack is wet in ten minutes.
method.l: ꯄ꯭ꯂꯦꯠꯇ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯐꯤꯅ ꯀꯨꯞꯂꯕ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡꯗ ꯄꯨꯅꯁꯤꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯦꯇꯦꯂꯒꯤ ꯄ꯭ꯂꯦꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯄꯔꯥꯆꯥꯅ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯗ ꯃꯈꯥꯒꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Thirty-two rupees a head, and the ghee is most of it. This is the morning bread of a festival day; on any other morning the hall gets tan and black tea.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯳꯲, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯀꯨꯃꯍꯩꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯑꯌꯨꯛꯀꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ; ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨꯗ ꯇꯥꯟ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯄꯤ꯫

start.en: The dough rests forty minutes. Two and a half hours in all for three hundred.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫ ꯆꯥꯃꯊꯥꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ꯫

vessel.en: Two large tawa and two rolling boards. Four cooks.
vessel.l: ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇꯋꯥ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯅꯐꯝ ꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯃꯔꯤ꯫

season.en: All year, on festival mornings.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯀꯨꯃꯍꯩꯒꯤ ꯑꯌꯨꯛꯇ꯫

recipes.name: Alu Paratha
recipes.sub: Wheat stuffed with mashed potato and chilli, rolled thick
recipes.sub_l: ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯕ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯥꯟꯗꯨꯅ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ

method.en: The filling must be completely dry and completely cold. A warm filling steams inside the paratha and tears it on the tawa.
method.l: ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯅꯕꯅ ꯄꯔꯥꯆꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯡꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇꯋꯥꯗ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Boil the potato in the skin and mash it warm, then let it cool. A potato peeled before boiling drinks water and the filling is wet whatever is done to it.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯁꯥꯗꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯨ, ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯅꯨ꯫ ꯍꯨꯝꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯑꯂꯨꯅ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯆꯨꯄꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯀꯔꯤ ꯇꯧꯔꯕꯁꯨ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Equal weights of dough and filling in each one. More filling than that and the paratha will not close; less and it is a plain paratha with a rumour in it.
method.l: ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛꯇ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯅꯕ ꯃꯥꯟꯅꯕ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ꯫ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯄꯔꯥꯆꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯣꯅꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ; ꯍꯦꯟꯊꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯋꯥꯐꯝ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯄꯔꯥꯆꯥ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roll from the centre out and turn the disc a quarter each time. Rolled in one direction the filling gathers at one edge and that edge splits.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯄꯥꯟ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯂꯥꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯣꯡꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯃꯥꯏꯀꯩ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯥꯅꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯅꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Thirty-four rupees a head and it is a meal on its own. On the morning of a long walking day a devotee needs no dal beside this and the kitchen saves a vessel.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯳꯴, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯠꯀꯗꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯑꯌꯨꯛꯇ ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡꯕꯅ ꯃꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯗꯥꯜ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯀꯅꯕꯤ꯫

start.en: Potatoes boil and cool the night before. Three hours on the day for three hundred.
start.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ ꯆꯥꯃꯊꯥꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

vessel.en: Two large tawa, a mashing tray and two rolling boards. Four cooks.
vessel.l: ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇꯋꯥ ꯑꯅꯤ, ꯅꯤꯡꯅꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯅꯐꯝ ꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯃꯔꯤ꯫

season.en: All year, and on any morning the hall is walking out.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨꯅ ꯆꯠꯀꯗꯕ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Missi Roti
recipes.sub: Wheat and gram flour together on a griddle, no oil in it
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯎ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯇꯋꯥꯗ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ

method.en: Two parts wheat to one of besan and no more besan than that. Half and half gives a roti that cracks on the tawa and cannot be turned.
method.l: ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯅ ꯇꯋꯥꯗ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯍꯣꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Knead with warm water. Besan does not take cold water and a cold-kneaded dough is still crumbling twenty minutes later.
method.l: ꯁꯥꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯕꯦꯁꯅꯅ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯂꯧꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗꯁꯨ ꯀꯥꯏꯗꯨꯅꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Rest it a full hour. Besan needs the time to take up the water and a dough rolled early tears in the middle of every roti.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯍꯅꯨ꯫ ꯕꯦꯁꯅꯅ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯂꯧꯁꯤꯅꯅꯕ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯆꯪꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯂꯥꯅꯂꯕ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: A dry tawa and no oil on it. A missi roti is fried in nothing and an oiled one goes soft in the basket before the line has passed.
method.l: ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯇꯋꯥ, ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯁꯤ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯔꯤꯗꯁꯨ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯁꯤꯡ ꯂꯣꯏꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡꯗ ꯃꯅꯤꯔꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head, no ghee and no kadai. Besan is half the price of wheat in an Imphal market and this is the roti a Lamda day can afford four of.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯷, ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯜ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯕꯦꯁꯅꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯃꯔꯤ ꯄꯤꯕ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: The dough rests a full hour. Two hours in all for four hundred.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫ ꯆꯥꯃꯔꯤꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Two dry tawa and two rolling boards. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯇꯋꯥ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯅꯐꯝ ꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

season.en: All year, and every second day in Lamda.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Thoiding Roti
recipes.sub: Wheat kneaded with roasted chilli and coriander leaf
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯥꯡꯃ ꯃꯅꯥꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ

method.en: Roast the chilli and crush it coarse into the flour. A powder disappears into nine kilos and the roti is only hot; the pieces are seen and that is the point.
method.l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯒ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯃꯑꯣꯡꯗ ꯁꯨꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯆꯨꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯠꯀꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯥꯄꯂꯗ ꯃꯥꯡꯈꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯑꯣꯏ; ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯎꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Chop the coriander fine and knead it in dry, before the water. Added after, the leaf sits on the surface and burns black on the tawa.
method.l: ꯍꯥꯡꯃ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇꯋꯥꯗ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯆꯥꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Ajwain and no cumin. In a chilli roti the cumin is lost and the ajwain is what is smelt when the basket is opened.
method.l: ꯖꯤꯔꯥ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯑꯖꯋꯥꯏꯟ꯫ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯔꯣꯇꯤꯗ ꯖꯤꯔꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯈꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯐꯉꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯖꯋꯥꯏꯅꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: A dry tawa and a spoon of oil brushed on after it comes off. Oil on the tawa fries the chilli pieces and four hundred roti taste of burnt chilli.
method.l: ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯇꯋꯥ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯃ ꯇꯩꯔꯨ꯫ ꯇꯋꯥꯗ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯂꯩꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ ꯆꯥꯃꯔꯤꯅ ꯆꯥꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Nineteen rupees a head. It needs no sabji beside it — four of these and a bowl of dal is a meal, which is what a hill kitchen on a Ukhrul road has always known.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯹꯫ ꯃꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ — ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯔꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯗꯥꯜ ꯀꯆꯤꯟ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯎꯈ꯭ꯔꯨꯂꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯕꯤꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯈꯉꯂꯦ꯫

start.en: The dough rests forty minutes. Two hours in all for four hundred.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫ ꯆꯥꯃꯔꯤꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Two dry tawa and two rolling boards. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯇꯋꯥ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯅꯐꯝ ꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

season.en: All year, and in Lamda when a hot roti is the whole meal.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯔꯣꯇꯤ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Kanghou
recipes.sub: Quick-fried seasonal vegetables
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯀꯉꯍꯧ

method.en: Kanghou is the dry stir-fry and it is the counterpart to kangshoi, which is the wet one. Between them they cover most of what the valley cooks.
method.l: ꯀꯉꯍꯧ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯀꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯡꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cut everything to the same size and sort it into hard and soft before the pan is hot.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯔꯥꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯅ ꯀꯥꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry on the highest flame with the lid off. A kanghou is defined by being dry, and a lid turns it into a kangshoi.
method.l: ꯃꯩ ꯆꯥꯎꯅ ꯊꯝꯗꯨꯅ ꯀꯨꯞꯁꯤꯅꯗꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add no water at all. If the pan catches, lower the flame rather than adding water.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯜꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the salt only in the last three minutes. Salted early the vegetables collapse and release everything they hold.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯳ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Ten minutes on the fire, no more, and finish with coriander off the flame.
method.l: ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯱꯰ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ, ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

recipes.why: No lid, no water, late salt. Three negatives and they are the whole technique.
recipes.why_l: ꯀꯨꯞꯁꯤꯅꯗꯕ, ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯜꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕ, ꯊꯨꯝ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ꯫

start.en: Cut the vegetables an hour ahead. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯀꯥꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Two wide 30 L kadhais. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: All year with whatever the market gave.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯐꯪꯕ ꯃꯅꯥꯅ꯫

recipes.name: Ushoi Kanghou
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo shoot fried with potato
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯂꯨꯒ ꯂꯣꯏꯅꯅ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯀꯉꯍꯧ

method.en: Rinse the soibum twice in cold water and squeeze it out hard. Straight from the jar it will take over the whole kadhai.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯆꯦꯛꯂꯒ ꯄꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry the drained soibum in the oil on a high flame for eight minutes before anything else goes in.
method.l: ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯍꯥꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯸ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: That frying is what turns a raw ferment into a dish. Soibum added at the end tastes of the jar and nothing else.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯁꯤꯕꯨ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the diced potato and fry a further ten minutes without a lid.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯱꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯁꯤꯅꯗꯅ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Salt only at the end and taste first. Soibum is salted in the jar and a heavy hand cannot be taken back.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire and finish with coriander.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: One jar and seven kilos of potato feed a hundred. Fry the ferment first or it never becomes a dish.
recipes.why_l: ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯃꯤ ꯱꯰꯰ ꯆꯥꯍꯅꯒꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Rinse the soibum twice. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯆꯦꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year — soibum keeps a year in its jar.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Yendem Kanghou
recipes.sub: Taro fried with ginger and chilli
recipes.sub_l: ꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ

method.en: Boil the taro with the skin on and peel it after. Peeled raw it goes slimy in the water and the pieces will not fry.
method.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯨꯟ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Handle raw taro with oiled hands or cloth. The raw sap makes the palms itch badly and does not wash off with water alone.
method.l: ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯇꯩꯕ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯄꯥꯏꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Chill the boiled taro before frying. Warm taro breaks apart in the kadhai and the whole pan turns to mash.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯕ ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry on a high flame with the lid off until the cut faces brown. That browning is the whole dish.
method.l: ꯃꯩ ꯆꯥꯎꯅ ꯊꯝꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯂꯥꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Turn as little as possible. Every stir breaks a piece and a broken taro releases starch that sticks the pan.
method.l: ꯍꯨꯡꯕ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯇꯧꯔꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Salt only in the last three minutes and finish with coriander.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯳ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Boil with the skin on, chill, then fry. Three steps and each one is against the taro turning to paste.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯍꯨꯟ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ, ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯕ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯡꯕ꯫

start.en: Boil the taro the evening before. Start forty-five minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: October to March, when the tubers are out of the ground.
season.l: ꯑꯣꯛꯇꯣꯕꯔꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯔꯆ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Lai Kanghou
recipes.sub: Mustard greens quickly fried
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯀꯉꯍꯧ

method.en: Lai is the valley's mustard green and it is at its best from November. Wash in three changes of water.
method.l: ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯅꯕꯦꯝꯕꯔꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯖꯤ꯫ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯂꯛ ꯆꯦꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Chop coarsely and keep the tender leaf separate from the thicker stem.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯦꯃꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry the stems four minutes before the leaves go in.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯍꯥꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯴ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry on the highest flame with the lid off. Mustard greens hold a great deal of water and a lid turns the kadhai into a pot of soup.
method.l: ꯃꯩ ꯆꯥꯎꯅ ꯊꯝꯗꯨꯅ ꯀꯨꯞꯁꯤꯅꯗꯅ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the salt only in the last two minutes. Salted early the leaves collapse and release everything they hold.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯲ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Six minutes on the fire, no more. Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the flame.
method.l: ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯶ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: No lid, high flame, late salt. Six minutes and it is done.
recipes.why_l: ꯀꯨꯞꯁꯤꯅꯗꯕ, ꯃꯩ ꯆꯥꯎꯕ, ꯊꯨꯝ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ꯫

start.en: Wash three times. Start thirty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯂꯛ ꯆꯦꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Two wide 30 L kadhais. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯀꯔꯥꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: November to February, when the lai is in.
season.l: ꯅꯕꯦꯝꯕꯔꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯦꯕ꯭ꯔꯨꯋꯥꯔꯤ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Mairen Kanghou
recipes.sub: Pumpkin fried dry until the edges catch and go sweet
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯅꯥꯛ ꯆꯥꯛꯂꯒ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯄ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ

method.en: No water at any point. A kanghou is a dry fry and sixteen kilos of mairen gives up all the water it needs in the first ten minutes.
method.l: ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯀꯉꯍꯧ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇꯔꯨꯛꯅ ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯗ ꯆꯪꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook it in two batches in a wide kadai. Sixteen kilos at once steams in its own water and a steamed mairen is a wet thongba without a name.
method.l: ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏꯗ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇꯔꯨꯛꯅ ꯃꯁꯥꯒꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯖꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯃꯤꯡ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Let the edges catch before it is turned. That caught edge is where the sweetness comes from and a kanghou turned every minute has none.
method.l: ꯍꯣꯡꯗꯣꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯅꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯍꯅꯨ꯫ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯥꯛꯐꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯅꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯣꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯀꯉꯍꯧꯗ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: No sugar. A mairen in Mera is already sweet and a kanghou that has caught at the edges is sweeter still.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯅꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯁꯪꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯅꯥꯛ ꯆꯥꯛꯂꯕ ꯀꯉꯍꯧ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head, the cheapest dry sabji in this book. In Mera a Thoubal field gives more mairen than the kitchen can use and sixteen kilos costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯲ — ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯊꯧꯕꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯅ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇ ꯄꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯂꯩ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, in two batches.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai and a flat ladle. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯆꯃꯆ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Mera to Wakching, from the field and then the cold room.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯂꯧꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯀꯥꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Thabi Kanghou
recipes.sub: Lotus stem boiled once and fried dry with mustard seed
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯃꯔꯨꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯊꯕꯤ

method.en: Wash it three times and look at the water each time. Thabi comes out of the Loktak mud and the mud sits inside the holes where no brush reaches.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯂꯛ ꯍꯥꯝꯗꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯊꯕꯤ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯂꯩꯄꯥꯀꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯕ꯭ꯔꯁ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯌꯧꯗꯕ ꯃꯀꯨꯞꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯩꯄꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Boil it once in salted water before it goes near the kadai. A raw thabi does not soften in oil however long it is fried.
method.l: ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯅꯛꯇ ꯆꯪꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯊꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯌꯥ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕꯁꯨ ꯊꯥꯎꯗ ꯃꯅꯤꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Cut in rounds a finger thick and do not slice it thin. A thin thabi loses the holes and the holes are what it is served for.
method.l: ꯈꯨꯠꯁꯥ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯀꯊꯠꯂꯨ, ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯊꯕꯤꯅ ꯃꯀꯨꯞ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯀꯨꯞꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Serve within the hour. Thabi cooked and left is rubber by the evening and twenty kilos cannot be given away.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯊꯃꯂꯕ ꯊꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯔꯕꯔ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯀꯨꯅ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯤꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-five rupees a head. Thabi comes out of Loktak in Wakching at forty rupees a kilo, and of every dry sabji on this shelf it is the one a devotee names a year later.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯵꯫ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛꯇꯒꯤ ꯊꯕꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯴꯰ꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯐꯂꯤ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯔꯛꯇ ꯆꯍꯤ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗꯁꯨ ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡꯕꯅ ꯃꯃꯤꯡ ꯄꯥꯃꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks, but washing and boiling fourteen kilos takes ninety minutes. Two and a half hours in all.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ, ꯑꯗꯨꯕꯨ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯴ ꯍꯥꯝꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯨꯝꯕꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰ ꯂꯧꯏ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ꯫

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a wide 30 L kadai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Wakching to Lamda, when the Loktak stem is cut.
season.l: ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯊꯕꯤ ꯀꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Alu Kanghou
recipes.sub: Potato cut small and fried dry until every face has caught
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯃꯥꯏ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯆꯥꯛꯄ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯑꯄꯤꯛꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯒ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯑꯂꯨ

method.en: Cut small, a half inch to the side, and keep the pieces even. A mixed cut gives some pieces raw and some to paste in the same ladle.
method.l: ꯏꯟꯆ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯒꯤ ꯑꯄꯤꯛꯄ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯃꯥꯟꯅꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯥꯟꯅꯗꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯃꯗꯃꯛꯇ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯈꯔ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯈꯔ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: No water and no lid. A lid on eighteen kilos of potato steams it and a steamed potato is a boiled potato in oil.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯸ꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯃꯖꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯎꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯑꯂꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Turn it four times in forty minutes and no more. Every extra turn breaks a face and eighteen kilos turned constantly is a mash.
method.l: ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰ꯗ ꯃꯔꯤꯔꯛ ꯍꯣꯡꯗꯣꯀꯎ, ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯍꯦꯟꯒꯠꯂꯕ ꯍꯣꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯅ ꯃꯃꯥꯏ ꯑꯃ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯍꯣꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯸ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering. In a kitchen with no maroi and no onion it is the only thing standing where they would.
method.l: ꯐꯣꯗꯅꯤꯗ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯃꯔꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯤꯌꯥꯖ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯃꯈꯣꯌꯒꯤ ꯃꯐꯃꯗ ꯂꯦꯞꯄ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head. Potato is in an Imphal store room every month of the year, and this is the sabji that goes beside a puri when nothing else has come in.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯶꯫ ꯆꯍꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯥ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯗꯤꯄꯣꯗ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯂꯥꯛꯇꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯔꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯆꯠꯄ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes on the fire, in two batches.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai and a flat ladle. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯆꯃꯆ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, and every third day in Lamda.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯍꯨꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Phulkobi Kanghou
recipes.sub: Cauliflower broken into florets and fried dry with its stalk
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯄꯨꯡꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ

method.en: Soak the florets ten minutes in salted water and lift them out. There is more in a Lamda cauliflower than cauliflower and the salt brings it to the surface.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯂꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯗ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯨꯃꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯄꯨꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Peel the stalk and cut it in with the florets. The stalk is a third of the weight and a kitchen that throws it is throwing five kilos.
method.l: ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯨ꯫ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕꯒꯤ ꯑꯍꯨꯃꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯉꯥ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯛꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: No water and no lid, and cook it in two batches. Sixteen kilos under a lid steams and a steamed cauliflower smells through the hall.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇꯔꯨꯛꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯖꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Take it off while a floret still snaps. A cauliflower cooked through is a cauliflower nobody looks at twice on the leaf.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯉꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯥꯎꯗ ꯀꯅꯥꯅꯁꯨ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯌꯦꯡꯗꯕ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head, and in Lamda the phulkobi is thirty rupees a kilo in every Imphal market. The stalk goes in, so sixteen kilos is sixteen kilos.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯷, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯜ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯜ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯳꯰ꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯁꯨ ꯆꯪꯏ, ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇꯔꯨꯛꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Florets soak ten minutes in salted water. Fifty minutes in all.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯅꯃꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai and a soaking tray. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯃꯅꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Hiyangei to Lamda, while the cauliflower is in the market.
season.l: ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Yongchak Thongba
recipes.sub: Tree bean with potato in thin gravy
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ

method.en: Yongchak is the tree bean and it is the most strongly scented thing in this book. It is a legume, not an allium, and it is permitted — but a kitchen serving it for the first time should say so on the menu.
method.l: ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯅꯤ, ꯃꯔꯣꯏ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Shell the pods and split each bean, removing the thin skin. Unskinned yongchak is tough and far more strongly scented.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Blanch the shelled beans two minutes and drain. This takes some of the sharpness off without losing the character.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯲ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯄꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry the beans in oil with the ginger and asafoetida for five minutes before the potato goes in.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯍꯥꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the potato and water and simmer twenty minutes until the potato is soft enough to mash against the side.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mash a few pieces of potato into the gravy to thicken it and stir the ground perilla in off the fire.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯈꯔ ꯅꯃꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: The most distinctive dish in the valley and the most divisive. Skin the beans and blanch them, and it is far less severe.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ꯫

start.en: Shell the yongchak the evening before. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. Two cooks — shelling is the bottleneck.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: March to June, when the pods are on the tree.
season.l: ꯃꯥꯔꯆꯇꯒꯤ ꯖꯨꯟ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Thabi Thongba
recipes.sub: Lotus stem in a thin gravy
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯕꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ

method.en: Thabi comes out of Loktak and arrives packed with mud inside the hollow chambers, which rinsing under a tap will not reach.
method.l: ꯊꯕꯤ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛꯇꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯩꯉꯣꯏ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Push a long brush or a cloth strip right through each chamber. Skip this and every mouthful is gritty.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯕ꯭ꯔꯁ ꯑꯃ ꯆꯪꯍꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯁꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Slice into thin rounds and boil ten minutes before frying. Raw lotus stem takes forty minutes to soften in a kadhai and everything else burns waiting.
method.l: ꯄꯥꯛꯅ ꯀꯥꯛꯂꯒ ꯀꯥꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯱꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry the boiled thabi with the ginger and asafoetida until the edges brown.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯕ ꯊꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the potato and water and simmer twenty minutes.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mash a few pieces of potato into the gravy and stir the ground perilla in off the fire. Thabi never goes fully soft and is not meant to.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯈꯔ ꯅꯃꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Brush the chambers and boil before frying. Both are about grit and about time, and neither can be skipped.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯁꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ꯫

start.en: Clean the thabi an hour ahead. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯊꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯁꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai and a long brush. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯕ꯭ꯔꯁ꯫

season.en: October to March, from the Loktak beds.
season.l: ꯑꯣꯛꯇꯣꯕꯔꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯔꯆ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛꯇꯒꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Paneer Thongba
recipes.sub: Paneer in a light tomato gravy
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ

method.en: This is the lighter Manipuri paneer, not the North Indian one. There is no cream, no cashew and no butter, and adding them makes it a different dish.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯄꯅꯤꯔꯅꯤ, ꯅꯣꯔꯊ ꯏꯟꯗꯤꯌꯥꯒꯤ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Cut the paneer into cubes and keep them in warm salted water until needed. Paneer left on a tray goes rubbery within the hour.
method.l: ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕꯗ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Temper the bay leaf and a generous amount of asafoetida in oil, then the ginger and green chilli.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook the tomato a full twenty minutes until it collapses and the oil separates. Without onion this is the entire body of the gravy.
method.l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add water and salt and simmer ten minutes, then the paneer for the last three minutes only.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯱꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯳ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠꯇ ꯈꯛꯇ꯫

method.en: Finish with the house masala and coriander. Keep the gravy thin — this is poured over rice, not scooped with bread.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯣꯛꯆꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Thin rather than rich, and poured over rice. That is what makes it Manipuri rather than Punjabi.
recipes.why_l: ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯄꯥꯛꯅ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯨꯅ꯫

start.en: Set the paneer the day before. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯁꯦꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: Festivals. A Vaishnava household dish.
season.l: ꯀꯨꯝꯃꯩꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Kobi Thongba
recipes.sub: Cabbage and potato in a thin gravy
recipes.sub_l: ꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ

method.en: Shred the cabbage coarsely rather than finely. Finely shredded cabbage disappears entirely in a wet dish.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯥꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry the potato in the oil first and lift it out. Potato takes longer than cabbage and together the cabbage is gone before the potato is done.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Temper the bay leaf and asafoetida, add the ginger and chilli, then the tomato for fifteen minutes.
method.l: ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯱꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Return the potato with the water and cook ten minutes, then add the cabbage.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯱꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ, ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯀꯣꯕꯤ꯫

method.en: Cabbage needs eight minutes only. Cooked longer it goes grey and sulphurous and the whole pot smells of it.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯸ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire and finish with coriander.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯀꯣꯛꯆꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Eight minutes on the cabbage. It is the only timing in the dish and the only way to get it wrong.
recipes.why_l: ꯀꯣꯕꯤꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯸ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: November to February, when cabbage is cheapest.
season.l: ꯅꯕꯦꯝꯕꯔꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯦꯕ꯭ꯔꯨꯋꯥꯔꯤ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Hendru Thongba
recipes.sub: Tomato cooked down to a thin gravy with roasted rice flour
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯆꯨꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ

method.en: Roast the tomato on the flame and peel it. The skin in a thongba rolls up into strings and every devotee finds one.
method.l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯒ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯤꯛ ꯃꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯨꯟꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡꯕ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛꯅ ꯑꯃ ꯐꯉꯏ꯫

method.en: Mix the rice flour to a slurry in cold water before it goes in. Thrown in dry, four hundred grams of it becomes forty lumps.
method.l: ꯆꯪꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯴꯰꯰ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯅꯤꯃꯔꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Cook the tomato twenty minutes before the flour goes in. Flour in early stops the tomato breaking and the thongba tastes of raw fruit.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯅ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯂꯦꯞꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯅ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯩꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: Keep it thin. A hendru thongba is drunk off the leaf and a thick one is a chutney that came to the wrong vessel.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯥꯎꯗꯒꯤ ꯊꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯥꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head. Tomato is in the Imphal market every month of the year and the roasted rice flour does the work a cream would do in a north Indian gravy.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯶꯫ ꯆꯍꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯥ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯜ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯣꯡꯄꯣꯛ ꯏꯟꯗꯤꯌꯥꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯀ꯭ꯔꯤꯃꯅ ꯇꯧꯒꯗꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯇꯧꯏ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, most of it roasting and peeling.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰, ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯄꯗ꯫

vessel.en: An open flame for the roasting and a 35 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯅꯕ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯩ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: All year, and cheapest in Mera and Hiyangei.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯦꯔꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯃꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Phulkobi Thongba
recipes.sub: Cauliflower and peas in a thin gravy with perilla
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯔ

method.en: Soak the florets ten minutes in salted water and lift them out. There is more in a Lamda cauliflower than cauliflower.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯂꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯗ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: The peas go in at the very end, four minutes off the fire. A pea cooked from the start is grey and thirty litres shows it.
method.l: ꯃꯇꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ, ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯛꯅꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯔꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯤ꯫ ꯑꯍꯧꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯳꯰ꯗ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯎꯏ꯫

method.en: Perilla and not coconut and not cashew. It grows in the hills here and it is what thickens thirty litres without a rupee of cream.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯀꯣꯅꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯖꯨ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀ꯭ꯔꯤꯃꯒꯤ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯳꯰ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Take it off while a floret still holds. Cauliflower cooks for ten minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a pulp in the hall.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯂꯩꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯍꯨꯃꯖꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯆꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨꯗ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees a head. In Lamda the phulkobi is thirty rupees a kilo, and with two kilos of peas in it this is the wet dish that carries a plain rice through the winter.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯳꯫ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯳꯰ꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯅꯤ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯁꯤꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯊꯃꯊꯥ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯄꯨꯔꯤ꯫

start.en: Florets soak ten minutes. Fifty minutes in all.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯅꯃꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel and a soaking tray. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯃꯅꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Hiyangei to Lamda, while the cauliflower is in the market.
season.l: ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Soibum Thongba
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo shoot cooked thin, the Meitei winter dish
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯩꯇꯩꯒꯤ ꯅꯤꯡꯊꯃꯊꯥꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ — ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ

method.en: Squeeze the soibum out of its liquor and keep two cups of that liquor back. The liquor is the whole sourness and the squeezing is what stops it being too much.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯍꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯀꯄ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯋꯥꯠꯍꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯍꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯅꯕ ꯂꯦꯞꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯤꯛꯄꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: The soibum goes in first and the potato after ten minutes. A potato in soibum liquor from the start hardens and stays hard however long the vessel boils.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕꯗ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯆꯪꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯑꯂꯨ꯫ ꯑꯍꯧꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯃꯍꯤꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯂꯨꯅ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯀꯌꯥ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕꯁꯨ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Keep the vessel uncovered the first ten minutes. Under a lid the smell of five kilos of soibum stays in it and comes out at the counter all at once.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯗ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯉꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯗ ꯊꯣꯛꯂꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. A soibum from Tamenglong is salted in the jar and two hundred grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯌꯦꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯇꯥꯃꯦꯡꯂꯣꯡꯒꯤ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯖꯥꯔꯗ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯖꯥꯔ ꯈꯔꯗ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯲꯰꯰ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯅꯅꯃꯛ ꯍꯦꯟꯅꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head. Five kilos of soibum out of a jar put down in Kalen is what gives an Imphal kitchen a wet dish in Lamda when there is nothing green in the market at all.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯸꯫ ꯀꯥꯂꯦꯅꯗ ꯊꯃꯂꯕ ꯖꯥꯔ ꯑꯃꯗꯒꯤ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯉꯥ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ, ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯄꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Squeeze the soibum and cook. Fifty minutes.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯍꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰꯫

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, uncovered at the start. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯑꯍꯧꯕꯗ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Mera to Lamda, out of the jar put down in Kalen.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯀꯥꯂꯦꯅꯗ ꯊꯃꯂꯕ ꯖꯥꯔꯗꯒꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Hawaijar Thongba
recipes.sub: Fermented soybean cooked thin with perilla and chilli
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ

method.en: Hawaijar goes in at the end and not at the start. Boiled twenty minutes it loses the smell it is bought for and becomes an ordinary bean.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯧꯕꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯂꯩꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯤꯕ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯑꯣꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Crush half of it and leave half whole. The crushed half thickens twenty-six litres and the whole half is what a Meitei devotee looks for on the leaf.
method.l: ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯑꯃ ꯁꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯁꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯶ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯩꯇꯩ ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯇꯥꯎꯗ ꯌꯦꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook it uncovered from the moment the hawaijar goes in. Under a lid three kilos of it will empty a hall.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯆꯪꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯥꯡꯍꯅꯒꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Serve it within the hour. Hawaijar left standing goes bitter and the bitterness is what people remember of a badly run kitchen.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯑꯣꯡ ꯆꯨꯝꯅ ꯆꯠꯊꯗꯕ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯃꯗ ꯃꯤꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯁꯤꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-one rupees a head. Hawaijar is the protein of a Meitei meal and three kilos of it gives a hundred people what a kilo of paneer would at four times the price.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯱꯫ ꯃꯩꯇꯩꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯃꯔꯤꯔꯛ ꯍꯦꯟꯅꯕ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯅ ꯄꯤꯒꯗꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯍꯨꯃꯅ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯆꯥꯃꯗ ꯄꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the hawaijar in the last five.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯉꯥꯗ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ꯫

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. Hawaijar is made every week of it.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯁꯥꯏ꯫

recipes.name: Singju
recipes.sub: Shredded salad with roasted gram flour
recipes.sub_l: ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ

method.en: Singju is the salad the valley is known for, and it is normally bound with ngari. Roasted gram flour and ground perilla do that work here.
method.l: ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯉꯥꯔꯤꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the besan on a dry pan until it smells nutty and turns a shade darker. Raw besan in a singju tastes chalky and is the commonest fault.
method.l: ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯔꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Shred everything as fine as possible and by hand where you can. A singju is judged on the shred.
method.l: ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯆꯥꯏꯅ ꯀꯥꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Clean the banana flower with oiled hands and drop each cleaned piece into salted water, or it blackens within a minute.
method.l: ꯂꯥꯐꯨ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯇꯩꯕ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯁꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil the lotus stem ten minutes and cool it. Everything else goes in raw.
method.l: ꯊꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯱꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯅꯧꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mix the roasted flour and perilla in at the counter, not in the kitchen. Mixed early they draw water and the salad goes pasty within twenty minutes.
method.l: ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯤꯅꯕ ꯃꯐꯃꯗ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Roasted besan in place of ngari, and mixed at the counter. Both decide whether it is a salad or a paste.
recipes.why_l: ꯉꯥꯔꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯠꯇ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯤꯅꯕ ꯃꯐꯃꯗ ꯌꯥꯟꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ꯫

start.en: Shred within the hour of serving. Roast the flour ahead.
start.l: ꯄꯤꯅꯕꯒꯤ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯀꯥꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Two large trays and a heavy pan. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯳꯫

season.en: All year with whatever is in season.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Champhut
recipes.sub: Plainly boiled vegetables
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯆꯨꯝꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ

method.en: There are three ingredients on this page and one of them is water. Champhut is boiled vegetables and nothing else, and it is eaten with a chutney.
method.l: ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯄꯣꯠꯆꯩ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Steam rather than boil where the vegetable allows it. Steamed vegetables keep their colour and lose less into the water.
method.l: ꯌꯥꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯕꯥꯐꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook each vegetable separately and combine at the end. Together, the beans are grey before the carrot is soft.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Do not overcook. Champhut is meant to have bite; a soft one is indistinguishable from a kangshoi without its broth.
method.l: ꯃꯌꯥꯝ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Salt it very lightly or not at all. It is eaten with morok metpa or hawaijar metpa, both of which are salted.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯈꯔꯈꯛꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Serve it warm rather than hot, and never dressed.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯤꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Three ingredients and no oil at all. It is here because the valley genuinely eats it, not to fill a page.
recipes.why_l: ꯄꯣꯠꯆꯩ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ, ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start thirty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel and a steamer basket. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. On the plate beside rice at most meals.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Tomato Shorba
recipes.sub: Thin peppered tomato soup
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨꯒꯤ ꯄꯥꯛꯅ ꯁꯨꯄ

method.en: Use ripe tomatoes and do not peel them. Boil them whole with the ginger, bay leaf and water for twenty-five minutes.
method.l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯨꯟ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯅ ꯲꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Press through a strainer rather than grinding. A grinder pulps the skin and seeds into the soup and turns it cloudy and slightly bitter.
method.l: ꯁꯨꯝꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯆꯥꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Temper the cumin, bay leaf and asafoetida in oil and pour in the strained soup.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯖꯤꯔꯥ, ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the sugar. It is not there to sweeten — it corrects the acidity of the tomato, and without it the soup tastes thin and sharp.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯆꯤꯟ ꯍꯥꯎꯅꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Simmer ten minutes with the salt and plenty of crushed pepper.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯱꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Finish with coriander and serve very hot. Held on a flame it reduces and turns sour.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯛꯆꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯤꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Twelve kilos of tomato feeds a hundred, and on a cold Imphal evening it does more than a second sabzi would.
recipes.why_l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯀꯦꯖꯤ ꯱꯲ ꯅ ꯃꯤ ꯱꯰꯰ ꯆꯥꯍꯅꯒꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: November to February, served hot before the meal.
season.l: ꯅꯕꯦꯝꯕꯔꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯦꯕ꯭ꯔꯨꯋꯥꯔꯤ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Kobi Singju
recipes.sub: Cabbage shredded raw and tossed with perilla and chilli
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯀꯣꯕꯤ

method.en: Shred the kobi fine and do not chop it. A singju is eaten with the fingers and a chunk of cabbage cannot be picked up with anything else on it.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯨ, ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯃꯑꯣꯡꯗ ꯀꯛꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯆꯥꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯣꯕꯤꯒꯤ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯄꯣꯠꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Roasted besan and perilla together are the dressing and there is no oil in a singju at all. The besan is what makes it hold together in the hand.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯅꯤꯅ ꯄꯨꯅꯅ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨꯗ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯈꯨꯠꯇ ꯄꯨꯅꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯕꯦꯁꯅꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Salt and lemon go on at the counter and not in the kitchen. Ten kilos of salted cabbage gives up two litres in half an hour and the tray is a soup.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯤ꯫ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯥꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯗ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯨꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Toss with the hands and not a ladle. A singju turned with a ladle bruises and the whole tray weeps within twenty minutes.
method.l: ꯆꯃꯆꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯆꯃꯆꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯃꯖꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a head, no fire and no oil. Kobi keeps ten days in an Imphal store room where a green leaf keeps two, and a singju is what a Manipuri leaf is not complete without.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯱, ꯃꯩ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯃꯅꯥꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯕ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯗꯤꯄꯣꯗ ꯀꯣꯕꯤꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗ꯭ꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯇꯥꯎ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯗꯦ꯫

start.en: Nothing cooks. Shred half an hour before the bell; dress at the counter.
start.l: ꯍꯨꯃꯕ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯒꯪ ꯈꯣꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯀꯛꯂꯨ; ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫

vessel.en: A shredding board and two wide trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯀꯛꯅꯕ ꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Mera to Lamda, out of the store room.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯗꯤꯄꯣꯗꯒꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Ushoi Singju
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot boiled once, cut fine and tossed with perilla
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ

method.en: Boil the ushoi once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sourness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯅꯠꯔꯒ ꯂꯩ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Squeeze it dry between the palms after boiling. A wet ushoi will not take the besan and the tray is a grey soup by the time the line starts.
method.l: ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯍꯤꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯅꯨ꯫ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯎꯁꯣꯏꯅ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯂꯧꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯤꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯧꯔꯀꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯁꯨꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Cut it in strips along the grain and never across. Cut across, the shoot falls into short pieces and there is nothing to pick up.
method.l: ꯃꯔꯤꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯇꯨꯡ ꯏꯟꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯨ, ꯃꯔꯛꯇ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯔꯛꯇ ꯀꯛꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯄꯤꯛꯄ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯅꯕ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯂꯩꯔꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: No oil and no lemon. The ushoi is sour enough on its own and a lemon over it is a singju nobody can eat past two mouthfuls.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯃꯔꯥꯡ ꯀꯥꯏꯅ ꯑꯁꯪꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯀꯅꯥꯅꯁꯨ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯅꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯆꯥꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯕ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head. In Sajibu the shoot comes off the hill for the cutting and eight kilos of it is a singju for a hundred with no oil bought at all.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯲꯫ ꯁꯖꯤꯕꯨꯗ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯛꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯈꯛꯇꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯗꯅ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯂꯅ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯆꯥꯃꯒꯤ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

start.en: Boil and squeeze two hours ahead. Dress at the counter.
start.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯍꯤꯀꯎ꯫ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a cloth for squeezing and two wide trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ, ꯍꯤꯛꯅꯕ ꯐꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Sajibu to Kalen for the fresh shoot.
season.l: ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯎꯁꯣꯏꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯁꯖꯤꯕꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯥꯂꯦꯟ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Thabi Singju
recipes.sub: Lotus stem boiled, sliced thin and tossed with perilla
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯊꯕꯤ

method.en: Wash the thabi three times and look at the water. It comes out of the Loktak mud and the mud sits inside the holes.
method.l: ꯊꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯂꯛ ꯍꯥꯝꯗꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯂꯩꯄꯥꯀꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯀꯨꯞꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯩꯄꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Boil it in salted water until a knife just goes through, then slice it paper thin. Boiled soft it cannot be sliced at all.
method.l: ꯊꯉꯣꯜ ꯑꯃ ꯆꯪꯕ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛꯀꯨꯝꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯨ꯫ ꯃꯅꯤꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Let it go completely cold before it is dressed. Warm thabi makes the besan pasty and the rings stick together in one grey block.
method.l: ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯊꯕꯤꯅ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯅꯥꯛꯅꯩ꯫

method.en: Serve it the moment it is dressed. Thabi in besan for an hour is soft and the whole reason for a lotus stem is the snap.
method.l: ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗꯃꯛ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯕꯦꯁꯅꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕ ꯊꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯤꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯕꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees a head. Thabi comes out of Loktak at forty rupees a kilo in Wakching, and this is the singju a Manipuri wedding is judged by.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯴꯫ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛꯇꯒꯤ ꯊꯕꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯴꯰ꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯌꯦꯡꯅꯕ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Boil and cool two hours ahead. Slice and dress at the counter.
start.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯅꯨ꯫ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯀꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a sharp knife and two wide trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ, ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯊꯉꯣꯜ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Wakching to Lamda, when the Loktak stem is cut.
season.l: ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯊꯕꯤ ꯀꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Hangam Champhut
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves boiled in plain water and drunk as a broth
recipes.sub_l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯛꯇꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯁꯨꯄꯀꯨꯝꯅ ꯊꯛꯅꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯃꯅꯥ

method.en: No oil at any point and nothing else in the vessel. A champhut is leaves and water and the whole art of it is not adding anything.
method.l: ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯁꯤꯡ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯅꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Twelve minutes and no more. Hangam boiled twenty minutes gives a broth the colour of a wet road and the bitterness of a medicine.
method.l: ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤ ꯈꯛꯇ, ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯃꯅ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯂꯝꯕꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯗꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯁꯨꯄ ꯑꯃ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: Bruise the ginger and drop it in whole, then take it out. Grated ginger clouds the broth and a champhut should be looked through.
method.l: ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯃꯂꯒ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤꯅ ꯁꯨꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯉꯥꯜ ꯂꯩꯇꯅ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯌꯦꯡꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Serve it hot and never reheated. A champhut boiled a second time is bitter and twenty-four litres of it goes back to the kitchen.
method.l: ꯁꯥꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯀꯎ, ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯀ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯁꯥꯍꯜꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛꯁꯨꯕ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯴ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯟꯖꯤꯜꯂꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head, the cheapest thing in this book. In Lamda the hangam is fifteen rupees a kilo and a bowl of champhut is what a Manipuri household drinks instead of a tea.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯷ — ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ꯫ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯵ꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯠꯇ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯌꯨꯃ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯊꯛꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯀꯆꯤꯟ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Twenty-five minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯩꯐꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯲꯵꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Mera to Lamda, while the mustard leaf is in the market.
season.l: ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Mairen Soup
recipes.sub: Pumpkin boiled soft and pressed through a sieve, no cream
recipes.sub_l: ꯀ꯭ꯔꯤꯝ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯃꯅꯤꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯅꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ

method.en: Peel it for a soup even though a thongba keeps the skin. The skin will not go through a sieve and it is the one thing a devotee finds in a bowl.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯊꯃꯖꯔꯕꯁꯨ ꯁꯨꯄꯀꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯀꯆꯤꯟ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯐꯉꯕ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roasted rice flour in place of a cream. Three hundred grams thickens twenty-four litres and a Manipuri kitchen has it on the shelf anyway.
method.l: ꯀ꯭ꯔꯤꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯠꯇ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯆꯨ꯫ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯳꯰꯰ꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯴ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯅꯅꯃꯛ ꯐꯂꯤꯗ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Press it through a sieve and do not use a blender. A blended pumpkin holds air and twenty-four litres of it froths over in the vessel.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯆꯪꯍꯜꯂꯨ, ꯕ꯭ꯂꯦꯟꯗꯔ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯔꯣꯏ꯫ ꯕ꯭ꯂꯦꯟꯗ ꯇꯧꯔꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯅꯅ ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯠ ꯄꯥꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯴ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯑꯐꯨꯠ ꯀꯥꯈꯠꯏ꯫

method.en: Black pepper and no chilli. This is the one dish in the book that goes out to the sick room and a morok in it defeats the purpose.
method.l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯃꯔꯤꯆ꯫ ꯅꯥꯕꯒꯤ ꯀꯥꯗ ꯆꯠꯄ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head, no cream and no dairy at all. In Mera a Thoubal field gives twelve kilos for the carrying, and this is the bowl that goes to whoever cannot take a full leaf.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯲, ꯀ꯭ꯔꯤꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯊꯧꯕꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯅ ꯄꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯈꯛꯇꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇꯥꯎ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯆꯥꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯕ ꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ ꯆꯠꯄ ꯀꯆꯤꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. An hour, most of it boiling and sieving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ, ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯕꯗ꯫

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a wide sieve. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯆꯥꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Mera to Wakching, from the field and then the cold room.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯂꯧꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯀꯥꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Chak-hao Kheer
recipes.sub: Black rice pudding
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎꯒꯤ ꯈꯤꯔ

method.en: This is the one dish outside Manipur has heard of, and the colour is the whole reason. Everything here protects that colour.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯤꯡ ꯆꯠꯄ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ, ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Soak the black rice six hours and boil it in plain water for a full hour before the milk goes anywhere near it.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯶ ꯅꯃꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil it in water first, not milk. Chak-hao boiled in milk from the start turns the whole pot grey rather than purple, and the colour cannot be brought back.
method.l: ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Keep the deep purple cooking water and add it back with the milk. That water is where the colour is.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝꯀ ꯂꯣꯏꯅꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Reduce the milk by about a third with the rice in it, stirring up from the bottom every few minutes.
method.l: ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯟꯊꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the sugar only at the end. Sugar in reducing milk makes it catch on the bottom far sooner, and a caught chak-hao kheer tastes burnt right through.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Boil in water first and keep the purple water. Those two rules are the difference between purple and grey.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯊꯝꯕ꯫

start.en: Soak the black rice six hours. Allow two and a half hours at the stove.
start.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯶ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy-bottomed 40 L vessel. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Festivals. The dish Manipur is known for outside Manipur.
season.l: ꯀꯨꯝꯃꯩꯗ꯫ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯤꯡ ꯆꯠꯄ ꯆꯥꯛ꯫

recipes.name: Rice Kheer
recipes.sub: Rice pudding with cardamom
recipes.sub_l: ꯏꯂꯥꯏꯆꯤ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯈꯤꯔ

method.en: Soak the rice thirty minutes, drain, then crush it lightly between the palms so the grains break. Broken rice thickens the kheer far faster.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯅꯃꯂꯒ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯦꯃꯅ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry the drained rice in a spoon of ghee with the bay leaf for two minutes before the milk goes in.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯉꯥꯃꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯲ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Reduce the milk by about a third on a medium flame, scraping the sides down into it as it thickens.
method.l: ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯟꯊꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the rice and cook forty minutes, stirring up from the bottom every few minutes. Rice settles and catches, and once it has caught the whole vessel tastes of it.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯴꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the sugar only at the end. Sugar in reducing milk makes it catch far sooner.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Finish with cardamom, almond and raisin. It thickens a great deal as it cools, so pull it off looser than it should be.
method.l: ꯏꯂꯥꯏꯆꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯕꯥꯗꯥꯝ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Sugar at the end and constant stirring. Everything that goes wrong with a kheer is one of those two.
recipes.why_l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯍꯨꯡꯕ꯫

start.en: Soak the rice thirty minutes. Allow two and a half hours at the stove.
start.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy-bottomed 40 L vessel. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫

season.en: All year. The temple offering sweet.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Sooji Halwa
recipes.sub: Semolina halwa in ghee
recipes.sub_l: ꯉꯥꯃꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯁꯨꯖꯤ ꯍꯂꯨꯋꯥ

method.en: Roast the semolina in ghee on a low flame for a full twenty-five minutes until it is the colour of wet sand and smells nutty.
method.l: ꯁꯨꯖꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯆꯥꯗ ꯲꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Do not hurry the roasting. Under-roasted semolina gives a halwa that tastes of raw flour and sets to a lump in the tray.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯡꯕꯗ ꯌꯥꯡꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil the water and sugar together in a separate vessel and keep it at a rolling boil.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Pour the boiling syrup into the roasted semolina, not the other way round, and stand back — it spits violently for a few seconds.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯤꯕ ꯁꯤꯔꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯨꯖꯤꯗ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯩꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Syrup that is not boiling will lump the halwa instantly, and no amount of stirring afterwards will smooth it out.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯁꯤꯔꯄꯅ ꯍꯂꯨꯋꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯗꯣꯂꯥ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Stir constantly until the ghee separates, then fold in cardamom and nuts and cover five minutes off the fire.
method.l: ꯉꯥꯃꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩ ꯍꯨꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Boiling syrup into roasted semolina, never the reverse. Everything that goes wrong is that one moment.
recipes.why_l: ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯤꯕ ꯁꯤꯔꯄ ꯁꯨꯖꯤꯗ, ꯑꯣꯟꯅ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. The prasadam halwa.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Sweet Bora
recipes.sub: Banana fritters in rice flour
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯆꯨꯗ ꯂꯥꯐꯨ ꯕꯣꯔꯥ

method.en: Use bananas that are properly ripe, with black flecks on the skin. An underripe banana gives a bora that is starchy rather than sweet.
method.l: ꯃꯍꯩ ꯑꯆꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯐꯨ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mash the bananas by hand rather than grinding them. A ground banana turns to liquid and the batter will not hold.
method.l: ꯂꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯃꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Use rice flour rather than wheat. Rice flour is what makes this crisp; wheat gives a soft, cakey fritter.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯒꯦꯍꯨ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Rest the batter twenty minutes and check it again — rice flour absorbs slowly and it will have tightened.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯑꯃꯨꯛ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry on a low to medium flame. Banana browns very fast because of its sugar, and a hot kadhai gives a bora black outside and raw within.
method.l: ꯃꯩ ꯃꯆꯥꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Drain on mesh and dust with a little sugar and cardamom while still warm.
method.l: ꯖꯥꯂꯤꯗ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕꯗ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯈꯔ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Ripe bananas and a low flame. Both are about the sugar in the fruit browning before the middle cooks.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯆꯥ꯫

start.en: Rest the batter twenty minutes. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Three deep kadhais. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯀꯔꯥꯏ ꯳꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯳꯫

season.en: All year. Bananas are cheap in the valley year round.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Sana Thongba
recipes.sub: Paneer cubes simmered in sweetened milk with cardamom
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯦꯂꯥꯆꯤꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯃꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯄꯅꯤꯔꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ

method.en: Cut the paneer in large cubes and fry them a minute in ghee. Unfried, they break up in sixteen litres and the vessel is a cloudy kheer.
method.l: ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯒ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯗ꯭ꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇ ꯃꯈꯣꯌ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯉꯥꯜ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯈꯤꯔ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Reduce the milk by a quarter before the paneer goes in. Paneer in thin milk drinks it and the thongba never thickens on its own.
method.l: ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯨꯃꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯃꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯄꯅꯤꯔꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯆꯨꯄꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Sugar in the last ten minutes only. Added early it stops the paneer softening and the cubes stay rubbery through the vessel.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯃꯅꯤꯕ ꯂꯦꯞꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯔꯕꯔꯒꯨꯝꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Serve it warm and not hot and not cold. Hot, the paneer is tough; cold, the milk sets on the tongue and nobody takes a second ladle.
method.l: ꯁꯥꯗꯅ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯀꯎ, ꯁꯥꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ; ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯩꯗ ꯀꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯅꯥꯅꯁꯨ ꯑꯅꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯂꯧꯗꯦ꯫

recipes.why: Fifty-three rupees a head, the dearest sweet in this book. It is the Ratha Jatra thongba and the wedding thongba; on any other day the hall gets a chakhao kheer at a third of the price.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯵꯳ — ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯌꯥꯝꯕ ꯃꯆꯤꯟ ꯍꯥꯎꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯅꯤ; ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨꯗ ꯃꯃꯂꯒꯤ ꯑꯍꯨꯃꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯈꯤꯔ ꯄꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯩꯐꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰꯫

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel and a frying pan. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯅꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: At Ratha Jatra, Janmashtami and a wedding.
season.l: ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕ, ꯖꯅ꯭ꯃꯥꯁ꯭ꯇꯃꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡꯕꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Mairen Kheer
recipes.sub: Pumpkin grated into milk and cooked down without sugar at first
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕꯗ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯃꯗ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ

method.en: Grate the mairen and fry it in ghee till the raw smell is gone before any milk. Grated straight into milk it curdles sixteen litres.
method.l: ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯂꯣꯏꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯃꯗ ꯍꯦꯛꯇ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇꯔꯨꯛ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: No sugar until the mairen is completely soft. Sugar early and the pumpkin stays in shreds and never becomes part of the kheer.
method.l: ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯃꯅꯤꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯤꯛ ꯃꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯈꯤꯔꯒꯤ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Two kilos of sugar and not three. A Mera mairen is sweet on its own and this is the one kheer in the book that needs less than the rest.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄꯁꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯊꯕ ꯆꯪꯕ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯈꯤꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stir the bottom every four minutes. Grated pumpkin sinks and sixteen litres of milk burns under it without a smell reaching the cook.
method.l: ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯔꯤ ꯃꯔꯤꯗ ꯃꯈꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯂꯨꯝꯊꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇꯔꯨꯛ ꯆꯥꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Thirty-two rupees a head, and five kilos of mairen takes the place of two kilos of rice and a kilo of sugar. In Mera it is the cheapest kheer a Thoubal kitchen can put out.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯳꯲, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯉꯥꯅ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯃꯦꯅꯖꯩ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯊꯧꯕꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯈꯤꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Two hours, most of it reducing.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ, ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯃꯍꯅꯕꯗ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel and a grater. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯣꯛꯅꯕ꯫ ꯆꯠꯊꯗꯕ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Mera to Wakching, while the mairen is in the field.
season.l: ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯂꯧꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Semiya Kheer
recipes.sub: Vermicelli roasted in ghee and cooked in reduced milk
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯒ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯃꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯁꯦꯃꯤꯌꯥ

method.en: Roast the semiya in ghee until it is the colour of a bay leaf. Unroasted, a kilo and a half of it turns twenty-two litres to glue.
method.l: ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯠꯇꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯁꯦꯃꯤꯌꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯗ꯭ꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯲ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯥꯛꯄ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: A kilo and a half in sixteen litres and no more. Semiya swells to four times its weight and two kilos is a vessel that cannot be poured.
method.l: ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇꯔꯨꯛꯇ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯈꯛꯇ, ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯁꯦꯃꯤꯌꯥꯅ ꯃꯁꯥꯒꯤ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯤꯔꯛ ꯄꯣꯝꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯅꯤꯅ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫
