method.en: The semiya goes in only after the milk has reduced by a fifth. Added to full milk it swells before the milk has thickened and there is nothing left to reduce.
method.l: ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯉꯥꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯁꯦꯃꯤꯌꯥ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯕ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯃꯗ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯄꯣꯝꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯨꯃꯍꯅꯕ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯋꯥꯠꯂꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Take it off looser than it should be. Semiya drinks for twenty minutes in the vessel and a kheer that is right in the kitchen is a pudding in the hall.
method.l: ꯆꯨꯝꯒꯗꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯁꯦꯃꯤꯌꯥꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯆꯨꯄꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯆꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯈꯤꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨꯗ ꯄꯨꯗꯤꯡ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Thirty-five rupees a head. A kilo and a half of semiya does what four kilos of rice would, and it is ready in half the time a chakhao kheer takes.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯳꯵꯫ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯔꯤꯅ ꯇꯧꯒꯗꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯦꯃꯤꯌꯥ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯅ ꯇꯧꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯈꯤꯔꯅ ꯂꯧꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯗ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯁꯦꯝꯃꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯩꯐꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰꯫

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel and a roasting pan. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯅꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ꯫ ꯆꯠꯊꯗꯕ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, on any festival day.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯀꯨꯃꯍꯩꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
recipes.sub: Milk powder balls fried slow and soaked in a thin syrup
recipes.sub_l: ꯇꯞꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯒ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯅꯃꯂꯕ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯃꯆꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ

method.en: Bind the dough and fry it inside twenty minutes. A milk powder dough left standing goes slack and the balls flatten in the ghee.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯃꯆꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯃꯅꯤꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯗ ꯃꯔꯨꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Fry on the lowest flame that will keep them moving. A hot ghee browns the outside in a minute and the centre is raw milk powder at the counter.
method.l: ꯃꯈꯣꯌ ꯆꯦꯅꯍꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯅꯦꯃꯕ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯃꯄꯥꯟ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯄꯤꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: The syrup is one thread and no more. A thick syrup will not go into the jamun and six hundred of them sit in it dry.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ, ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯖꯥꯃꯨꯅꯗ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯃꯇꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: The syrup must be warm and the jamun hot when they meet. Cold syrup on a hot jamun and the skin closes; nothing goes in after that.
method.l: ꯃꯈꯣꯌ ꯃꯔꯛ ꯇꯤꯅꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯖꯥꯃꯨꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯖꯥꯃꯨꯅꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯣꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ; ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ꯫

recipes.why: Fifty-seven rupees a head. Every ingredient comes up the road and it shows in the price, so this is for Janmashtami and Ratha Jatra and nothing else.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯵꯷꯫ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯂꯝꯕꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯃꯜꯗ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯎꯏ; ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯖꯅ꯭ꯃꯥꯁ꯭ꯇꯃꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: The syrup is made first and kept warm. Three hours in all for six hundred.
start.l: ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕꯗ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯁꯥꯔꯒ ꯁꯥꯗꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯆꯥꯃꯇꯔꯨꯛꯀꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

vessel.en: A deep kadai, a 30 L syrup vessel and a rolling tray. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ, ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯁꯥꯅꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

season.en: At Janmashtami and Ratha Jatra.
season.l: ꯖꯅ꯭ꯃꯥꯁ꯭ꯇꯃꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Kabok Laddu
recipes.sub: Puffed rice and jaggery balls
recipes.sub_l: ꯀꯕꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ

method.en: Kabok is sand-roasted puffed rice and it is the base of most Manipuri sweets. Make it first or buy it fresh.
method.l: ꯀꯕꯣꯛ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯤꯟ ꯍꯥꯎꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯣꯉꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the sesame separately and cool it. Warm sesame added to syrup will not bind.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the water and oil and strain it. Jaggery always carries grit and unstrained it goes into the laddu.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯪꯍꯅꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook the syrup to the hard-ball stage — a drop in cold water should set firm and crack between the teeth.
method.l: ꯁꯤꯔꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Under-cooked syrup gives laddu that sag by evening; over-cooked gives laddu nobody can bite.
method.l: ꯁꯤꯔꯄ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯅꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mix in the kabok, sesame, coconut and ginger and roll at once with oiled palms. It sets hard within two minutes.
method.l: ꯀꯕꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯈꯨꯗꯛꯇ ꯁꯦꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Three weeks in a tin, no dairy at all, and made from rice the kitchen already has.
recipes.why_l: ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯳ ꯆꯠꯀꯅꯤ, ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫

start.en: The kabok must be made first. Keeps three weeks in a tin.
start.l: ꯀꯕꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯁꯦꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide kadhai and a large tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯀꯔꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: All year, and made in quantity for Kang.
season.l: ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯃꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Til Laddu
recipes.sub: Sesame and jaggery balls
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ

method.en: Roast the sesame on a dry pan on a low flame, stirring constantly, until it pops steadily and turns a shade darker.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯆꯥꯗ ꯍꯨꯡꯗꯨꯅ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Take it off the moment it smells. Sesame goes from roasted to burnt in about thirty seconds and burnt til is bitter right through.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯝ ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯔꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cool completely on a tray. Warm sesame added to syrup will not bind.
method.l: ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦꯗ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the water and oil and cook to the hard-ball stage — a drop in cold water should set firm and crack between the teeth.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: That stage decides everything. Under-cooked syrup gives laddu that sag by evening; over-cooked gives laddu nobody can bite.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯤꯅ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯈꯉꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Mix in the sesame, coconut and grated ginger and roll at once with oiled palms.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ, ꯌꯨꯕꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯈꯨꯗꯛꯇ ꯁꯦꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: A month in a tin, no dairy at all, and warming — which is why it belongs to the cold months.
recipes.why_l: ꯊꯥ ꯑꯃ ꯆꯠꯀꯅꯤ, ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫

start.en: Roast and cool the sesame ahead. Keeps a month in a tin.
start.l: ꯊꯣꯏꯗꯤꯡ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy pan and a wide kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯀꯔꯥꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: November to February, in the cold months.
season.l: ꯅꯕꯦꯝꯕꯔꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯦꯕ꯭ꯔꯨꯋꯥꯔꯤ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Chana Laddu
recipes.sub: Roasted gram flour laddu
recipes.sub_l: ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯕ ꯕꯦꯁꯟꯒꯤ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ

method.en: Use coarse besan rather than fine. Fine besan gives a pasty laddu; coarse gives the slight grain a besan laddu should have.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Sprinkle the besan with a few spoons of milk and rub it through the fingers before roasting. This makes it grainy and is what a halwai does.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯕꯦꯁꯟꯗ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯈꯔ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯌꯦꯠꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the besan in ghee on a low flame for a full thirty minutes until it is deep gold and smells nutty, stirring without stopping.
method.l: ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯉꯥꯃꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Under-roasted besan tastes raw and the laddu will not keep a fortnight.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯊꯣꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Cool the roasted flour to just warm before the sugar goes in. Powdered sugar added to hot besan melts and the laddu will not hold.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯍꯥꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mix in the sugar, cardamom and almond and roll while still warm.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ, ꯏꯂꯥꯏꯆꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯕꯥꯗꯥꯝ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕꯗ ꯁꯦꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: The milk rub and thirty minutes of roasting. Both are what separate a halwai's laddu from a home one.
recipes.why_l: ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝꯅ ꯌꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯳꯰ ꯀꯥꯡꯕ꯫

start.en: Roast the flour ahead. Keeps two weeks in a tin.
start.l: ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide kadhai and a large tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯀꯔꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: All year. The temple offering laddu.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Chakhao Laddu
recipes.sub: Black rice flour roasted with jaggery and rolled warm
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯒ ꯁꯥꯗꯅ ꯁꯥꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯃꯆꯨ

method.en: Roast the chakhao flour in the ghee twenty-five minutes on a low flame. Under-roasted it tastes of raw flour and the laddu falls apart in the hand.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯦꯃꯕ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯲꯵ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯗ꯭ꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯆꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯈꯨꯠꯇ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately and strain it. Field jaggery carries sand and grit in a laddu is what is remembered of it.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯅꯨ꯫ ꯂꯧꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯅ ꯂꯩꯉꯣꯏ ꯄꯨꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯃꯗ ꯅꯤꯡꯁꯤꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯩꯉꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roll them while the mix is still too hot for a bare hand. Cooled, chakhao and jaggery set into a slab and no ball can be made of it.
method.l: ꯈꯨꯠ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕꯗ ꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯂꯩꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯈꯣꯌ ꯁꯥꯅꯨ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯅ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Keep them in a tin out of the light. Chakhao loses its purple to sunlight and a grey laddu is not what a devotee came for.
method.l: ꯃꯉꯥꯜ ꯌꯧꯗꯕ ꯃꯐꯃꯗ ꯗꯕ꯭ꯕꯥꯗ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠꯀꯤ ꯃꯉꯥꯂꯗ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎꯅ ꯃꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯃꯥꯡꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡꯕꯅ ꯄꯥꯃꯖꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-seven rupees a head and it keeps three weeks in a tin. Bishnupur chakhao is a Manipur crop and a temple that buys six kilos of it keeps a Loktak field planted.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯷, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯗꯕ꯭ꯕꯥꯗ ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫ ꯕꯤꯁ꯭ꯅꯨꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯍꯥꯎ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯩꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯂꯥꯏꯁꯉ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯂꯧ ꯑꯃ ꯊꯥꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Two hours, and the rolling must be done warm.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯥꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯥꯗꯅ ꯇꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide kadai, a jaggery pan and a strainer. Three cooks for the rolling.
vessel.l: ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ, ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯥꯅꯕꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

season.en: Made in Mera after the harvest, kept three weeks.
season.l: ꯂꯧ ꯂꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯁꯥꯏ, ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯊꯃꯖꯩ꯫

recipes.name: Phou Laddu
recipes.sub: Puffed rice pressed into jaggery syrup, no ghee at all
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯅꯃꯂꯕ ꯀꯕꯣꯛ

method.en: Take the jaggery syrup to the hard ball stage and test it in cold water. A soft syrup gives a laddu that will not hold and seven hundred of them are a tray of loose kabok.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯆꯥꯡꯌꯦꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯄꯥꯏꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯕ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯃꯔꯦꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯦꯅꯊꯔꯛꯂꯕ ꯀꯕꯣꯛꯀꯤ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: No ghee anywhere and none is wanted. The syrup is the whole binding and this is the one sweet in the book a fasting kitchen can make with no dairy in the store room.
method.l: ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ, ꯆꯪꯗꯦꯁꯨ꯫ ꯄꯨꯅꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯗꯤꯄꯣꯗ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯤꯟ ꯍꯥꯎꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mix off the fire and roll at once. The syrup sets in ninety seconds and a tray left standing cannot be broken up again.
method.l: ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯍꯦꯛ ꯁꯥꯅꯨ꯫ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯦꯀꯦꯟꯗ ꯹꯰ꯗ ꯀꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Wet the palms with cold water between every ten. Dry hands take the syrup off the kabok and by the fiftieth laddu there is no syrup left on the tray.
method.l: ꯇꯔꯥ ꯇꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯛꯇ ꯈꯨꯠꯄꯥꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯅ ꯍꯥꯝꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯀꯕꯣꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯀꯤ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ ꯃꯉꯥꯔꯛ ꯁꯨꯕꯗ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦꯗ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯋꯥꯠꯂꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees a head, the cheapest sweet in this book, and it keeps a month. Kabok is what a Manipuri house has in the corner and jaggery is the only thing bought for it.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯳ — ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯃꯆꯤꯟ ꯍꯥꯎꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ; ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯌꯨꯃ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯊꯪꯕꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯕꯣꯛꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. An hour, and the rolling is a race.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯥꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯇꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A syrup pan, a wide tray and a bowl of cold water. Four cooks for the rolling.
vessel.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ, ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯀꯆꯤꯟ ꯑꯃ꯫ ꯁꯥꯅꯕꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯃꯔꯤ꯫

season.en: All year, and at Yaoshang above all.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯌꯥꯎꯁꯪꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Chandok Laddu
recipes.sub: Perilla seed roasted, ground with jaggery and pressed by hand
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯒ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯃꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯃꯔꯨ

method.en: Roast the perilla until the seeds start to jump and take it off at once. Chandok past that point is bitter and four kilos of it cannot be salvaged.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯃꯔꯨꯅ ꯆꯣꯡꯍꯧꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯒ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯛ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯔꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯂꯧꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Grind it warm and it will give up its own oil. That oil is the binding and no ghee is needed anywhere in this laddu.
method.l: ꯁꯥꯗꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ, ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯁꯥꯒꯤ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯄꯤꯔꯛꯀꯅꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯅꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: A pinch of salt in it and the whole thing tastes of perilla instead of jaggery. Thirty grams in seven and a half kilos is the measure.
method.l: ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯈꯔ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯠꯇ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ꯫ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯦꯠ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯗ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯳꯰ꯅꯤ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ꯫

method.en: Press each one in the fist and do not roll it in the palm. A chandok laddu has to be squeezed to hold and a rolled one is dust in the tin by the morning.
method.l: ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯃꯨ, ꯈꯨꯠꯄꯥꯅꯗ ꯁꯥꯔꯣꯏ꯫ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯥꯏꯅꯕ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯥꯔꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯌꯨꯛ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕꯗ ꯗꯕ꯭ꯕꯥꯗ ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯠ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees a head, no ghee and no dairy. Chandok grows on the Ukhrul hillsides where nothing else will, and this is the sweet that puts a hill crop on a temple leaf.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯳, ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯍꯧꯗꯕ ꯎꯈ꯭ꯔꯨꯂꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯍꯧꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯩ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯥꯏꯁꯉꯒꯤ ꯇꯥꯎꯗ ꯊꯃꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯃꯆꯤꯟ ꯍꯥꯎꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, and the pressing is done warm.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯃꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯥꯗꯅ ꯇꯧꯏ꯫

vessel.en: A dry pan, a stone mill and a wide tray. Three cooks for the pressing.
vessel.l: ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ, ꯅꯨꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯁꯤꯅ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯅꯃꯅꯕꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

season.en: Made in Hiyangei when the perilla comes down from the hills.
season.l: ꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯂꯥꯛꯄ ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗ ꯁꯥꯏ꯫

recipes.name: Heikru Murabba
recipes.sub: Gooseberry pricked, boiled and held in a heavy syrup
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯀꯨꯞ ꯇꯨꯛꯂꯒ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯊꯃꯂꯕ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ

method.en: Prick every heikru all over with a fork before it is boiled. An unpricked one takes no syrup and stays sour to the middle for a year.
method.l: ꯍꯨꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯐꯣꯔꯛꯅ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯇꯨꯀꯎ꯫ ꯇꯨꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯂꯧꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯍꯤ ꯑꯃꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Boil them once in plain water and throw that water. It carries the bitterness and a murabba made without that step is bitter under the sweetness.
method.l: ꯃꯈꯣꯌ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯧꯗꯅ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯃꯨꯔꯕ꯭ꯕꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯁꯪꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Bring the syrup up over three days and not in one. Put into a heavy syrup at once, the fruit shrivels and eight kilos becomes five.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯍꯨꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯦꯛꯇ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯍꯩ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯉꯥ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: A squeeze of lemon in the syrup on the last day. It is what stops seven kilos of sugar crystallising in the jar by the second month.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠꯇ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯃꯍꯤ ꯈꯔ꯫ ꯊꯥ ꯑꯅꯤꯁꯨꯕꯗ ꯖꯥꯔꯗ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯦꯠ ꯀꯅꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯂꯦꯞꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a kilo of murabba and it keeps a year. In Hiyangei the heikru comes down from Ukhrul at eighteen rupees a kilo and one piece on a leaf is a sweet at two rupees.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯨꯔꯕ꯭ꯕꯥ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯴, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯍꯤ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫ ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯎꯈ꯭ꯔꯨꯂꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯸ꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇꯥꯎꯗ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯑꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯆꯤꯟ ꯍꯥꯎꯕ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Three days, a little syrup each day. Ready in a week.
start.l: ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ, ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯔ ꯈꯔ꯫ ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯁꯦꯝꯃꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a fork and a wide-mouthed glass jar. One cook, three days running.
vessel.l: ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ, ꯐꯣꯔꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯃꯥꯏ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯀꯥꯆꯒꯤ ꯖꯥꯔ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯍꯨꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Made in Hiyangei and eaten all year.
season.l: ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗ ꯁꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯆꯥꯏ꯫

recipes.name: Atta Laddu
recipes.sub: Wheat flour roasted long in ghee and rolled with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯗ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯒ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯁꯥꯂꯕ ꯒꯣꯗꯨꯝ ꯃꯆꯨ

method.en: Roast the atta thirty-five minutes and not twenty. This is the whole dish; under-roasted atta tastes of raw flour and no amount of jaggery covers it.
method.l: ꯑꯥꯇꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯳꯵ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ; ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯑꯥꯇꯥꯅ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯆꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯀꯌꯥ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯁꯨ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯨꯄꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: The flame stays low the whole thirty-five minutes. A brown atta at fifteen minutes is a burnt atta and six kilos is thrown.
method.l: ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯳꯵ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯃꯩ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯦꯃꯅ ꯂꯩꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯃꯉꯥꯗ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕ ꯑꯥꯇꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯛꯂꯕ ꯑꯥꯇꯥꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯛꯀꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately and strain it before it goes in. Field jaggery carries sand and grit in a laddu is what is remembered of it.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯆꯪꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯆꯥꯅꯨ꯫ ꯂꯧꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯅ ꯂꯩꯉꯣꯏ ꯄꯨꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯃꯗ ꯅꯤꯡꯁꯤꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯩꯉꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roll them while the mix is still too hot for a bare hand. Cooled, atta and jaggery set into a slab that has to be broken with a ladle.
method.l: ꯈꯨꯠ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕꯗ ꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯂꯩꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯈꯣꯌ ꯁꯥꯅꯨ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯑꯥꯇꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯅ ꯆꯃꯆꯅ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees a head and it keeps a fortnight in a tin. Atta and jaggery are the two cheapest things a temple buys by the sack, and this is what they make together.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯴, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯗꯕ꯭ꯕꯥꯗ ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯏ꯫ ꯂꯥꯏꯁꯉ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯈꯥꯎꯅ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯥꯇꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯈꯣꯌ ꯑꯅꯤꯅ ꯄꯨꯅꯅ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Two hours, thirty-five minutes of it roasting.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ, ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯳꯵ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯕꯗ꯫

vessel.en: A heavy wide kadai, a jaggery pan and a strainer. Three cooks for the rolling.
vessel.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ, ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯥꯅꯕꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

season.en: All year, and in Lamda when a laddu keeps longest.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯗ꯭ꯗꯨ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯕ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Chana Thongba
recipes.sub: Chickpeas in a thin spiced gravy
recipes.sub_l: ꯆꯅꯥ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ

method.en: This is the offering dish and the catering dish both, and it is lighter than a Punjabi chole. There is no chole masala and no anardana.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯅ꯭ꯗꯤꯔꯗ ꯀꯠꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ, ꯄꯉ꯭ꯖꯥꯕꯒꯤ ꯆꯣꯂꯦ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Soak the chana overnight and throw the soaking water away.
method.l: ꯆꯅꯥ ꯑꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯃꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook until a chickpea crushes to nothing between finger and thumb. Merely soft is not cooked.
method.l: ꯆꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯝꯂꯕꯗ ꯃꯅꯝ ꯉꯥꯛꯄ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Temper the bay leaf and a generous amount of asafoetida in oil, then the ginger, then the tomato for twenty minutes until the oil separates.
method.l: ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯲꯰ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the potato and let it break down into the gravy. That is what thickens it — there is no cream and no cashew in this book.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Simmer twenty-five minutes and finish with the house masala and coriander. It is better the next day.
method.l: ꯲꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Better the next day, holds four hours, and potato does the thickening that cream would do elsewhere.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯊꯪ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠꯇ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯐꯖꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯂꯨꯅ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

start.en: Soak the chana overnight. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: ꯆꯅꯥ ꯑꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L pressure vessel and a wide kadhai. Two cooks.

season.en: All year. The catering dish and the temple offering.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Mix Veg Kanghou
recipes.sub: Mixed vegetables fried dry for carrying
recipes.sub_l: ꯄꯨꯕꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯑꯀꯥꯡꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯀꯉꯍꯧ

method.en: This is the dry version, made deliberately without gravy so that it survives a journey.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯤ ꯑꯀꯥꯡꯕꯅꯤ, ꯄꯨꯗꯨꯅ ꯆꯠꯄꯗ ꯃꯥꯡꯗꯅꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Sort the vegetables into hard and soft and cut everything to the same size.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯦꯃꯕ ꯍꯥꯏꯅ ꯈꯥꯏꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Use more oil than in a household kanghou. Oil is what protects a dry dish on a four-hour journey and there is no gravy here to do it.
method.l: ꯌꯨꯃꯒꯤ ꯀꯉꯍꯧꯗꯒꯤ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry the hard vegetables eight minutes on a high flame with the lid off before the soft ones go in.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯸ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯅꯦꯃꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add no water at all. If the pan catches, lower the flame rather than adding water.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯜꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire and finish with the house masala and coriander.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: No gravy to split and no dairy to turn. Four hours on the road and it arrives as it left.
recipes.why_l: ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ, ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫

start.en: Cut the vegetables an hour ahead, hard and soft kept apart.
start.l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯀꯥꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: All year with whatever the market gave.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Aloo Thongba
recipes.sub: Potato in a thin bay-scented gravy
recipes.sub_l: ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯥꯠ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ

method.en: Boil and chill the potatoes the day before, then break them by hand into rough pieces.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯏꯡꯍꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯊꯨꯒꯥꯏꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Use a generous amount of bay leaf. It is the defining note of a Manipuri gravy and this dish has little else in it.
method.l: ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯥꯠ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Temper the cumin, bay leaf and a generous amount of asafoetida in oil, then the ginger and chilli.
method.l: ꯖꯤꯔꯥ, ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook the tomato a full fifteen minutes until it collapses and the oil separates.
method.l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯱꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the potato, salt and hot water and simmer fifteen minutes, mashing a few pieces against the side to thicken.
method.l: ꯑꯂꯨ, ꯊꯨꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯞꯂꯒ ꯱꯵ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Finish with the house masala and coriander. Transport it thicker than it should be and thin it with hot water at the other end.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯣꯛꯆꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Ingredients that are always in the store, fifty minutes from cold, and it travels without breaking.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯇꯝ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯇ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯄꯣꯠꯆꯩ, ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Boil the potatoes the evening before. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. The dish for a morning when nothing was planned.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and cashew gravy, no onion and no garlic
recipes.sub_l: ꯄꯤꯌꯥꯖ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯝ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯖꯨꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ

method.en: Soak the cashew an hour and grind it with the tomato. The cashew does the whole job an onion base would do and there is no honest substitute cheaper than this.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯖꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯄꯤꯌꯥꯖꯅ ꯇꯧꯒꯗꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯥꯖꯨꯅ ꯇꯧꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯁꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯑꯆꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯍꯨꯠ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the butter goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and a spoon of sugar only hides it for a minute.
method.l: ꯕꯇꯔ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯲꯵ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯁꯪꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯂꯣꯅꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Six kilos boiled in gravy is six kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯔꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯔꯕꯔ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯨꯛꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Cream off the fire and stirred in from the side. Cream into a boiling gravy splits and twenty-eight litres cannot be brought back.
method.l: ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇꯒꯤ ꯀ꯭ꯔꯤꯝ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯤꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯀ꯭ꯔꯤꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯸ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯂꯥꯀꯍꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

recipes.why: Sixty-five rupees a head, the dearest dish in this book. Paneer, cashew, butter and cream all come up the road, so this is for a wedding and for Ratha Jatra and nothing else.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯶꯵ — ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯌꯥꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ꯫ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ, ꯀꯥꯖꯨ, ꯕꯇꯔ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀ꯭ꯔꯤꯝ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯂꯝꯕꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ; ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Cashew soaks an hour. Two hours in all.
start.l: ꯀꯥꯖꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯃꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: At Ratha Jatra, Janmashtami and a wedding.
season.l: ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕ, ꯖꯅ꯭ꯃꯥꯁ꯭ꯇꯃꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡꯕꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Rajma Thongba
recipes.sub: Kidney beans cooked soft in a tomato gravy with dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯃꯅꯤꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯔꯥꯖꯃꯥ

method.en: Soak the rajma twelve hours and cook it in fresh water. The soaking water is what makes a rajma hard on the stomach and it costs nothing to throw.
method.l: ꯔꯥꯖꯃꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤꯃꯗꯣꯏ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯔꯥꯖꯃꯥꯅ ꯄꯨꯛꯇ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯃꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯛꯄꯗ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Cook it until a quarter of the beans break by themselves. That quarter thickens thirty litres and no flour is wanted in a rajma.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯔꯤꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯳꯰ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯔꯥꯖꯃꯥꯗ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a rajma hardens and two more hours on the fire will not save it.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯃꯅꯤꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯊꯨꯅ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯔꯥꯖꯃꯥ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯊꯃꯂꯕꯁꯨ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Plenty of ginger, more than seems right. In a kitchen with no onion and no garlic the ginger is the whole base of the gravy.
method.l: ꯆꯨꯃꯒꯅꯤ ꯍꯥꯌꯅ ꯈꯅꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ, ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯄꯤꯌꯥꯖ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯝ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Thirty-three rupees a head. It is the dish a Manipuri temple puts out when north Indian guests are on the list, and five kilos of rajma holds a hall longer than any thongba here.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯳꯳꯫ ꯅꯣꯡꯄꯣꯛ ꯏꯟꯗꯤꯌꯥꯒꯤ ꯂꯃꯍꯩꯁꯤꯡ ꯂꯩꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯏꯁꯉ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛꯇꯒꯤ ꯔꯥꯖꯃꯥ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯉꯥꯅ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯂꯦꯞꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

start.en: Rajma soaks twelve hours and cooks two. Start the evening before.
start.l: ꯔꯥꯖꯃꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤꯃꯗꯣꯏ ꯅꯃꯂꯒ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, on a guest day.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯂꯃꯍꯩ ꯂꯥꯛꯄ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠꯇ꯫

recipes.name: Matar Paneer
recipes.sub: Paneer and green peas in a light tomato gravy
recipes.sub_l: ꯅꯦꯃꯕ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯔ

method.en: Peas in the last four minutes and never at the start. A pea cooked twenty minutes is grey and four kilos of grey peas is seen from the door.
method.l: ꯃꯇꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯔꯤꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ, ꯑꯍꯧꯕꯗ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯔꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯎꯏ꯫

method.en: Only six hundred grams of cashew here, not the kilo a butter masala takes. A matar paneer should be thin enough to see the peas through.
method.l: ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯀꯥꯖꯨ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯶꯰꯰ ꯈꯛꯇ, ꯕꯇꯔ ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥꯗ ꯆꯪꯕ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯎꯕ ꯉꯃꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Hold the cut paneer in warm salted water until the gravy is ready. Left dry on a tray four kilos hardens at the edges within the hour.
method.l: ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯁꯦꯝꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯀꯛꯂꯕ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦꯗ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯃꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯔꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Take the vessel off before the paneer has been in five minutes. It goes on cooking in the gravy all the way to the hall.
method.l: ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯆꯪꯂꯕ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯉꯥ ꯂꯥꯅꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯆꯠꯄꯗ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

recipes.why: Forty-nine rupees a head. It is the guest dish a kitchen makes when a butter masala is beyond the day's money, and four kilos of peas does the work of two of paneer.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯴꯹꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯁꯦꯜꯅ ꯕꯇꯔ ꯃꯁꯥꯂꯥ ꯉꯝꯂꯣꯏꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯂꯃꯍꯩꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯔ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯔꯤꯅ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯇꯧꯏ꯫

start.en: Cashew soaks half an hour. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: ꯀꯥꯖꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯅꯃꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰꯫

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, a grinder and a holding pot for the paneer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ, ꯁꯨꯃꯅꯕ ꯃꯁꯤꯅ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯊꯃꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Wakching to Lamda for the fresh pea; frozen the rest of the year.
season.l: ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯃꯇꯔꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ; ꯆꯍꯤꯒꯤ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯅꯂꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Alu Phulkobi
recipes.sub: Potato and cauliflower in a light gravy with dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯅꯦꯃꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ

method.en: The potato goes in twelve minutes before the cauliflower. Started together, the phulkobi is pulp while the alu is still raw in the middle.
method.l: ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯅꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯧꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯑꯂꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩꯉꯩꯗ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Soak the florets ten minutes in salted water first. There is more in a Lamda cauliflower than cauliflower.
method.l: ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕꯗ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯂꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯗ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Keep it just wet and no more. This is not a thongba; the gravy should cling to the pieces and not stand around them.
method.l: ꯃꯈꯣꯡ ꯆꯨꯝꯅ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ, ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ; ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯅꯥꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯃꯈꯣꯌꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯂꯩꯒꯗꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Take it off while a floret still holds. Both vegetables cook for ten minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a mash in the hall.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯂꯩꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯅꯤꯃꯛꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯍꯨꯃꯖꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯆꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨꯗ ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees a head, and it is the guest dish for a Lamda day when no paneer has come up the road. Seven kilos each of alu and phulkobi fills thirty litres.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯲꯴, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯝꯕꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯂꯥꯛꯇꯕ ꯂꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯂꯃꯍꯩꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯦꯠ ꯇꯔꯦꯠꯅ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯳꯰ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

start.en: Florets soak ten minutes. An hour in all.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯅꯃꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel and a soaking tray. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯴꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯃꯅꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Hiyangei to Lamda, while the cauliflower is in the market.
season.l: ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Malai Kofta
recipes.sub: Paneer and gram flour balls dropped into a cashew gravy
recipes.sub_l: ꯀꯥꯖꯨꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯕꯦꯁꯅꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ

method.en: Grate the paneer and knead it with the besan until it takes a ball without a crack. A cracked kofta opens in the ghee and five kilos of paneer is in the kadai.
method.l: ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯕꯦꯁꯅꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯀꯥꯏꯔꯕ ꯀꯣꯐꯇꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯗ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯉꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯗꯥꯏꯗ ꯂꯩꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Fry the kofta on a medium flame and never hot. A hot ghee browns the outside while the besan inside is still raw.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯐꯇꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯤꯜꯃꯔꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ, ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕꯅ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯩꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯄꯥꯟ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯄꯤꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: The kofta go into the gravy at the counter and not in the kitchen. Five minutes in the vessel and they are gone; there is nothing left to serve.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯐꯇꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯉꯥ ꯂꯩꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯈꯣꯌ ꯃꯥꯡꯈ꯭ꯔꯦ; ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯅꯕ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯋꯥꯠꯂꯣꯏ꯫

method.en: Cream off the fire. Cream into a boiling gravy splits and twenty-six litres of it cannot be brought back.
method.l: ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯀ꯭ꯔꯤꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯤꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯀ꯭ꯔꯤꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯶ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯟꯅ ꯂꯥꯀꯍꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

recipes.why: Sixty-two rupees a head. It is the one dish in this book that needs a cook standing at a kadai for an hour, and a Manipuri wedding is the only day that hour is available.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯶꯲꯫ ꯀꯗꯥꯏꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯦꯞꯄ ꯆꯪꯕ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯐꯉꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡꯕ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Cashew soaks an hour. Two and a half hours in all.
start.l: ꯀꯥꯖꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯃꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ꯫

vessel.en: A deep kadai, a 35 L gravy vessel and a grinder. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯑꯔꯨꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ, ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯨꯃꯅꯕ ꯃꯁꯤꯅ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ꯫

season.en: At a wedding and at Ratha Jatra.
season.l: ꯂꯨꯍꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯪ ꯆꯤꯡꯕꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Yongchak Singju
recipes.sub: Stink bean salad with roasted chickpea flour, no dairy
recipes.sub_l: ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ, ꯁꯪꯒꯣꯝ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ

method.en: Slice the yongchak paper-thin. Cut thick it overwhelms everything else on the plate.
method.l: ꯌꯣꯡꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯄꯤꯛꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the chickpea flour dry until it darkens. It is the dressing here, and a singju is normally bound with ngari — this one is not.
method.l: ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯉꯥꯔꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Roast the umorok over a flame and pound it separately; wear cloth on the hands.
method.l: ꯎꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯁꯨꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Toss everything cold with oil, lemon and salt at serving. A singju dressed early is water in twenty minutes.
method.l: ꯄꯤꯒꯗꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯏꯡꯅ ꯌꯥꯟꯁꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Singju is the plate Manipur is known by and this one is bound with roasted besan rather than fermented fish, which makes it vegan without changing the taste anyone came for. Yongchak comes down from Tamenglong for four months and costs little in that season.
recipes.why_l: ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯃꯁꯛꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯩ, ꯉꯥꯔꯤ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Slice everything an hour ahead and dress it only as it goes out.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯀꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: Two large trays and a stone mortar for the chilli. Three cooks.
vessel.l: ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯨꯝꯕ ꯅꯨꯡ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯳꯫

season.en: February to May, while the yongchak is in.
season.l: ꯐꯦꯕ꯭ꯔꯨꯋꯥꯔꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯦꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Soibum Hawai Ooti
recipes.sub: Peas and bamboo shoot cooked with soda, no dairy
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ

method.en: Soak the peas twelve hours and boil them with a pinch of soda until they collapse. Ooti is a soft dish and a firm pea is a failure.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯱꯲ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯒ ꯁꯣꯗꯥ ꯈꯔ ꯍꯥꯄꯄꯒ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Rinse the soibum twice in fresh water to take the edge off it, and squeeze it dry.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯍꯥꯝꯗꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry the bay leaf and chilli in mustard oil, add the soibum and fry two minutes.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯇꯦꯖꯄꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Tip the peas in with their water and the ginger and simmer twenty minutes. There is no ghee and no milk in an ooti at any point.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯲꯰ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Ooti is what a Bishnupur household cooks at the end of the month — six kilos of dried peas and a handful of soibum feed a hundred. Nothing in it is fresh and nothing in it is dairy, so it can be cooked on any day of any season.
recipes.why_l: ꯎꯇꯤ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯪꯒꯣꯝ ꯅꯠꯔꯒ ꯉꯥꯃꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ꯫

start.en: Soak the peas twelve hours. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯱꯲ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 50 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯵꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. Soibum keeps a year in its jar.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Yendem Metpa
recipes.sub: Colocasia stem mashed with chilli and raw mustard oil
recipes.sub_l: ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ

method.en: Peel the stem completely and rub the hands with oil first. Yendem itches badly on bare skin.
method.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯟ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ, ꯈꯨꯠꯇ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯇꯩꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil it in salted water until a piece breaks under the thumb, and drain it hard.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯄ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯒ ꯄꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast and pound the umorok separately.
method.l: ꯎꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅ ꯀꯥꯡꯂꯒ ꯁꯨꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mash everything by hand with raw mustard oil, maroi and coriander. A metpa is never cooked after the oil goes in.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯏꯡꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯄ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯀꯅꯥꯁꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: A metpa is the cheapest thing a Manipuri kitchen makes and it has never had dairy in it — the fat is raw mustard oil poured at the end. Yendem grows in every ditch in Thoubal and costs the labour of pulling it.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ꯫ ꯌꯦꯟꯗꯦꯝ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯐꯪꯏ꯫

start.en: Peel and boil the stem an hour ahead. Mash it only when the plates are ready.
start.l: ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯟ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel and two large mashers. Two cooks.

season.en: June to November, while the stems are young.
season.l: ꯖꯨꯟꯗꯒꯤ ꯅꯕꯦꯝꯕꯔ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Hangam Eromba
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves boiled and mashed with roasted chilli, no oil
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯎ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ, ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯕ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯃꯅꯥ

method.en: No oil anywhere and none is wanted. The hawaijar carries it and a spoon of oil turns the whole tray into a kangmet.
method.l: ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ, ꯆꯪꯗꯦꯁꯨ꯫ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯔꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯆꯃꯆ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯀꯥꯡꯃꯦꯠ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Boil the hangam eight minutes in as little water as will cover it and throw nothing away. That water is where the taste of ten kilos of leaf has gone.
method.l: ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯨꯞꯄ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯔꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯛꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯆꯪꯈꯤꯕ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Roast the chilli on the flame and crush it in the hand. A powder gives heat; the pieces are what an eromba is looked at for.
method.l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯒ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯨꯅ ꯑꯀꯍꯕ ꯄꯤ; ꯏꯔꯣꯝꯕ ꯑꯃ ꯌꯦꯡꯅꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mash it with the hand and not a ladle. An eromba should show what went into it; a smooth one is a paste and comes back to the counter.
method.l: ꯆꯃꯆꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯏꯔꯣꯝꯕꯗ ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯆꯪꯈꯤꯕ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯎꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ; ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯍꯟꯖꯤꯜꯂꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a head, no oil and no dairy. In Lamda the hangam is fifteen rupees a kilo and this is the vegan dish an Imphal kitchen makes without buying anything but salt.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯱, ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯵ꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯂꯩꯗꯅ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯚꯤꯒꯅꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Potatoes boil an hour. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰꯫

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a wide mashing tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯡꯅꯕ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Mera to Lamda, while the mustard leaf is in the market.
season.l: ꯍꯉꯥꯝ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Ushoi Eromba
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot boiled once and mashed with chilli and hawaijar
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯕ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ

method.en: Boil the ushoi once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sourness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯅꯠꯔꯒ ꯂꯩ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: No oil anywhere and none is wanted. The hawaijar carries it and the ushoi is oily enough in the mouth on its own.
method.l: ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ, ꯆꯪꯗꯦꯁꯨ꯫ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯖꯥꯔꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯔꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯃꯅꯥꯗ ꯃꯔꯥꯡ ꯀꯥꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯂꯩ꯫

method.en: Cut the ushoi fine before it is mashed. A long strip in an eromba cannot be broken by the hand and it comes off the plate whole.
method.l: ꯅꯤꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯨ꯫ ꯏꯔꯣꯝꯕꯗ ꯑꯁꯥꯡꯕ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯄ꯭ꯂꯦꯠꯇꯒꯤ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Mash it with the hand and not a ladle. An eromba should show the shoot; a smooth one is a paste and comes back to the counter.
method.l: ꯆꯃꯆꯅ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯏꯔꯣꯝꯕꯗ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯎꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ; ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯍꯟꯖꯤꯜꯂꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head, no oil and no dairy. In Sajibu the shoot comes off the hill for the cutting and this is the eromba a Tamenglong kitchen makes twice a week.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯲, ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯁꯖꯤꯕꯨꯗ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯛꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯈꯛꯇꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇꯥꯃꯦꯡꯂꯣꯡꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯆꯌꯣꯜ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯏꯔꯣꯝꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Potatoes and ushoi boil together an hour. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯄꯨꯅꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯨꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯹꯰꯫

vessel.en: Two boiling pots and a wide mashing tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯤꯡꯅꯕ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Sajibu to Kalen for the fresh shoot; from Mera the soibum takes its place.
season.l: ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯎꯁꯣꯏꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯁꯖꯤꯕꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯥꯂꯦꯟ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ; ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯃꯅ ꯃꯍꯨꯠ ꯁꯤꯅꯩ꯫

recipes.name: Chandok Singju
recipes.sub: Perilla ground coarse over a plate of raw shredded vegetables
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯀꯛꯂꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯃꯑꯣꯡꯗ ꯁꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ

method.en: Roast the perilla until the seeds jump and grind it coarse. This is the whole dressing and no oil goes into a singju at all.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯃꯔꯨꯅ ꯆꯣꯡꯍꯧꯕ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯒ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯃꯑꯣꯡꯗ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯅꯕ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨꯗ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯆꯪꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Hold the cut banana flower in water with lemon in it until the plate is made. Left in air it is black in four minutes and no amount of chandok covers it.
method.l: ꯄ꯭ꯂꯦꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯦꯝꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ ꯀꯛꯂꯕ ꯂꯥꯐꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯠꯇ ꯊꯃꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯔꯤꯗ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯀꯌꯥ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯁꯨ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯨꯄꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Grind the chandok on the day it is used. Ground perilla holds its oil three days and after that a singju tastes of nothing.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯒꯗꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯗꯨꯗ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯁꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛꯅ ꯃꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯊꯃꯖꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨꯗ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Toss with the hands at the counter and not before. Salted cabbage weeps two litres in half an hour and the tray is a soup.
method.l: ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯈꯨꯠꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯀꯣꯕꯤꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯃꯈꯥꯏꯗ ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯨꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head, no oil and no dairy. Chandok grows on the Ukhrul hillsides where nothing else will and the banana flower is cut off a tree behind the kitchen.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯴, ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯍꯧꯗꯕ ꯎꯈ꯭ꯔꯨꯂꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯍꯧꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯐꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯊꯪꯕꯒꯤ ꯄꯥꯝꯕꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯛꯏ꯫

start.en: Grind the chandok in the morning. Shred half an hour before the bell.
start.l: ꯑꯌꯨꯛꯇ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯒꯪ ꯈꯣꯡꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯃꯈꯥꯏ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯀꯛꯂꯨ꯫

vessel.en: A dry pan, a stone mill and two wide trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ, ꯅꯨꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯁꯤꯅ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Hiyangei to Lamda, when the perilla is down from the hills.
season.l: ꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯂꯥꯛꯄ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Soibum Kanghou
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo shoot fried dry with chilli and perilla
recipes.sub_l: ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ

method.en: Squeeze the soibum dry out of its liquor and keep none of it back. A kanghou is a dry fry and the liquor turns eight kilos into a wet thongba.
method.l: ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯋꯥꯠꯍꯅꯒꯅꯨ꯫ ꯀꯉꯍꯧ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯍꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Cook it uncovered and cook it in two batches. Eight kilos of soibum under a lid will empty a hall.
method.l: ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯂꯅ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯍꯥꯡꯍꯅꯒꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Let the edges catch before it is turned. A soibum that has caught at the edges is a different thing from one that has only been warmed.
method.l: ꯍꯣꯡꯗꯣꯛꯇ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯅꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯍꯅꯨ꯫ ꯃꯅꯥꯛ ꯆꯥꯛꯂꯕ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯁꯥꯍꯅꯕ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯇꯧꯔꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅꯕ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. A soibum from Tamenglong is salted in the jar and a hundred and sixty grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯌꯦꯡꯉꯨ꯫ ꯇꯥꯃꯦꯡꯂꯣꯡꯒꯤ ꯁꯣꯏꯕꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯖꯥꯔꯗ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯖꯥꯔ ꯈꯔꯗ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯱꯶꯰ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯅꯅꯃꯛ ꯍꯦꯟꯅꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head, no dairy at all. Eight kilos out of a jar put down in Kalen is what gives an Imphal kitchen a dry sabji in Lamda when nothing green is in the market.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯶, ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯀꯥꯂꯦꯅꯗ ꯊꯃꯂꯕ ꯖꯥꯔ ꯑꯃꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯅꯤꯄꯥꯜ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ, ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯀꯔꯤꯁꯨ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯃ ꯄꯤ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Squeeze and fry. Forty minutes, in two batches.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯍꯤꯛꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai, uncovered, and a squeezing cloth. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯛꯅꯕ ꯐꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Mera to Lamda, out of the jar put down in Kalen.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯀꯥꯂꯦꯅꯗ ꯊꯃꯂꯕ ꯖꯥꯔꯗꯒꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Heikru Singju
recipes.sub: Gooseberry grated raw and tossed with perilla and chilli
recipes.sub_l: ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯆꯥꯟꯗꯣꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛꯀ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ

method.en: Grate the heikru off the stone and throw the stone. A heikru stone in a singju is a hard thing in a soft plate and somebody bites it.
method.l: ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯣꯛꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨꯗ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯅꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯄ꯭ꯂꯦꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯀꯅꯕ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯅꯥꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯆꯤꯀꯏ꯫

method.en: No lemon and no tamarind. Five kilos of raw heikru is the whole sourness of the plate and anything added makes it undrinkable.
method.l: ꯆꯝꯐꯨꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯩꯅꯧ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯄ꯭ꯂꯦꯠ ꯑꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯉꯥ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯕ ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯕ ꯉꯃꯗꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Grate it at the counter and not in the kitchen. Grated heikru is brown in fifteen minutes and a brown singju is not looked at twice.
method.l: ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯗ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯨ꯫ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥꯃꯉꯥꯗ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯕ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯌꯦꯡꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Roasted besan against the sourness and no oil at all. The besan is what makes a singju hold together in the hand.
method.l: ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯏꯑꯣꯛꯇ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯕꯦꯁꯟ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯁꯤꯡꯖꯨ ꯑꯃ ꯈꯨꯠꯇ ꯄꯨꯅꯁꯤꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯕꯦꯁꯅꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head, no oil and no dairy. In Hiyangei the heikru comes down from Ukhrul at eighteen rupees a kilo and free off any temple compound with a tree.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯲, ꯊꯥꯎ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯉ꯭ꯒꯣꯝ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗ ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯎꯈ꯭ꯔꯨꯂꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯸ꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯎ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯂꯥꯏꯁꯉꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡ ꯂꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯦꯝꯅ ꯂꯩ꯫

start.en: Nothing cooks. Grate and dress at the counter.
start.l: ꯍꯨꯃꯕ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯀꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫

vessel.en: A grater, a shredding board and two wide trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯀꯣꯛꯅꯕ, ꯀꯛꯅꯕ ꯄꯥꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: Hiyangei to Wakching, while the heikru is on the tree.
season.l: ꯍꯩꯀ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯄꯥꯝꯕꯤꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Jain Kangshoi
recipes.sub: The valley broth without colocasia, ngari or ginger
recipes.sub_l: ꯄꯥꯟ, ꯉꯥꯔꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯕ ꯀꯥꯡꯁꯣꯏ

method.en: A kangshoi normally takes colocasia to give the broth its body. Pumpkin does it here — it falls apart the same way and grows above the ground.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯡꯁꯣꯏꯗ ꯄꯥꯟ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯅꯩ꯫ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯃꯥꯏꯆꯨꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯇꯧꯏ꯫

method.en: Boil the soaked peas first; they take three times as long as any vegetable in the pot.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯥꯟꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add the vegetables in the order they cook, with the whole chillies and asafoetida.
method.l: ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯊꯪ ꯃꯅꯥꯑꯣ ꯅꯥꯏꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Finish with raw mustard oil and coriander off the fire. No ngari, no maroi and no fresh ginger goes in — the hing and the sonth do all of it.
method.l: ꯃꯩ ꯃꯨꯠꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯏꯡꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯅꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Kangshoi is the everyday vessel of the valley and the one dish here a Jain guest could almost eat as it stands. Take the colocasia and the ginger out and put pumpkin in, and the same pot serves the whole hall.
recipes.why_l: ꯀꯥꯡꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯅꯤ꯫ ꯄꯥꯟ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯖꯥꯏꯟ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯦ꯫

start.en: Soak the peas overnight. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯗꯥꯡ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 50 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯵꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year, with whatever the market gave that morning.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯐꯪꯕ ꯃꯅꯥꯅ꯫

recipes.name: Jain Hawai Thongba
recipes.sub: Dried peas in a light gravy, no onion, garlic or ginger
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ, ꯁꯤꯡ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯦ

method.en: Soak the peas twelve hours and boil them in the same water until the skins slip.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯱꯲ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯒ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Temper cumin, bay leaf, asafoetida and dry ginger in ghee. A thongba usually starts with onion; these four start this one.
method.l: ꯉꯥꯃꯨ ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯖꯤꯔꯥ, ꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Add tomato, turmeric and chilli and cook until the ghee separates.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯝꯂꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯏꯉꯥ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯊꯥꯑꯣ ꯊꯣꯛꯂꯛꯃꯟꯅ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Tip in the peas with their water and simmer twenty-five minutes, crushing a ladleful against the side to thicken it.
method.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯅ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯲꯵ ꯊꯣꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Nearly every thongba in this book is built on potato or colocasia. Dried peas need nothing from the ground, keep a year in a sack, and give a Jain guest the same full plate as everyone else.
recipes.why_l: ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯅꯠꯔꯒ ꯄꯥꯟꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯍꯋꯥꯏꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯃꯊꯧ ꯇꯥꯗꯦ꯫

start.en: Soak the peas twelve hours. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: ꯍꯋꯥꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯱꯲ ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A 50 L pressure vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯵꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: All year. Dried peas are a store item.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Jain Kobi Kanghou
recipes.sub: Cabbage and peas, dry-fried, with no root in the pan
recipes.sub_l: ꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯀꯉꯍꯧ, ꯃꯈꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯀꯄ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ

method.en: Shred the cabbage and let it stand fifteen minutes with a little salt, then squeeze it out.
method.l: ꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯛꯂꯒ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯈꯔ ꯍꯥꯄꯄꯒ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯱꯵ ꯊꯃꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Fry cumin, asafoetida and dry ginger in mustard oil.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯑꯣꯗ ꯖꯤꯔꯥ, ꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯀꯥꯡꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Put the cabbage and peas in on a high flame and keep the vessel uncovered. Covered, cabbage turns to water.
method.l: ꯃꯩ ꯆꯥꯎꯅ ꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯍꯥꯞꯆꯤꯜꯂꯒ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯂꯣꯏꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Take it off while there is still a bite in it and finish with coriander.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯁꯤꯡꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: A kanghou is the dry dish beside rice at most Manipuri meals and the usual one is made with potato. Cabbage and peas do the same work, cost less, and leave a Jain devotee with a full plate rather than a broth and rice.
recipes.why_l: ꯀꯉꯍꯧ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯆꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯅꯥꯛꯇ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯅꯥꯅꯤ꯫ ꯑꯂꯨ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯀꯣꯕꯤꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯇꯧꯏ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start forty minutes before serving; this dish will not wait.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯍꯧꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯔꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯲꯫

season.en: November to March, while the cabbage is firm.
season.l: ꯅꯕꯦꯝꯕꯔꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯔꯆ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Jain Ushoi Kanghou
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot fried dry with dry ginger and no root at all
recipes.sub_l: ꯂꯩꯃꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ

method.en: Boil the ushoi once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sourness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯃꯨꯛꯇꯪ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯑꯍꯥꯅꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯅꯠꯔꯒ ꯂꯩ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, and it is a hundred grams and not three. Dry ginger is four times the strength and a Jain plate is ruined by a heavy hand.
method.l: ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯂꯥ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯆꯥꯃꯅꯤ꯫ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕꯒꯤ ꯄꯥꯉ꯭ꯒꯜ ꯃꯔꯤꯔꯛ ꯍꯦꯟꯅꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯌꯥꯝꯅ ꯍꯥꯄꯄꯅ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯄ꯭ꯂꯦꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯥꯡꯍꯜꯂꯤ꯫

method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering and a pinch is enough. In a Jain kitchen it is the only thing standing where an onion would.
method.l: ꯐꯣꯗꯅꯤꯗ ꯍꯤꯡ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯜꯂꯨ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯈꯔꯅ ꯃꯔꯥꯡ ꯀꯥꯏ꯫ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯄꯤꯌꯥꯖꯒꯤ ꯃꯐꯃꯗ ꯂꯦꯞꯄ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: No water and no lid, and cook it in two batches. Ten kilos under a lid steams and a steamed ushoi is a wet thongba without a name.
method.l: ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯨꯞꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯈꯥꯗ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯇꯔꯥꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯖꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯃꯤꯡ ꯂꯩꯇꯕ ꯑꯍꯥꯡꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head. In Sajibu the shoot comes off the hill for the cutting, and there is no root anywhere in it, so a Jain guest eats the same dish as the hall.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯵꯫ ꯁꯖꯤꯕꯨꯗ ꯎꯁꯣꯏ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯤꯡꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯛꯄꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯈꯛꯇꯗ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯂꯩꯃꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ; ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯂꯃꯍꯩ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨꯒ ꯃꯥꯟꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯆꯥꯏ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Boil, drain and fry. An hour, in two batches.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯒ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯂꯪꯊꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯨ꯫ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ꯫

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a wide 30 L kadai. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯍꯨꯝꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Sajibu to Kalen for the fresh shoot.
season.l: ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯎꯁꯣꯏꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯁꯖꯤꯕꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯀꯥꯂꯦꯟ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Jain Hendru Thongba
recipes.sub: Tomato cooked thin with roasted rice flour and dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ

method.en: Roast the tomato on the flame and peel it. The skin in a thongba rolls up into strings and every devotee finds one.
method.l: ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯩꯗ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯒ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯤꯛ ꯃꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯀꯨꯟꯁꯤꯜꯂꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡꯕ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛꯅ ꯑꯃ ꯐꯉꯏ꯫

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, a hundred grams in twenty-eight litres. It is four times the strength of the fresh root.
method.l: ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ, ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯸ꯗ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯆꯥꯃ꯫ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯄꯥꯉ꯭ꯒꯜ ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯤꯔꯛ ꯍꯦꯟꯅꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Mix the rice flour to a slurry in cold water before it goes in. Thrown in dry, four hundred grams becomes forty lumps.
method.l: ꯆꯪꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯃꯆꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯌꯦꯡꯁꯤꯜꯂꯨ꯫ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯴꯰꯰ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯅꯤꯃꯔꯤ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

method.en: Keep it thin. A hendru thongba is drunk off the leaf at the end of the meal and a thick one is a chutney in the wrong vessel.
method.l: ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯂꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯇꯥꯎꯗꯒꯤ ꯊꯛꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯥꯅꯕ ꯆꯥꯐꯨꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯦꯠꯄ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head. Tomato is in the Imphal market every month of the year and there is no root and no fresh ginger anywhere in it, so a Jain guest is not given a separate leaf.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯶꯫ ꯆꯍꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯥ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ ꯏꯝꯐꯥꯜ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯂꯩꯃꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ; ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯂꯃꯍꯩꯗ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯅꯕ ꯇꯥꯎ ꯑꯃ ꯄꯤꯗꯦ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, most of it roasting and peeling.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰, ꯃꯔꯨꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯄꯗ꯫

vessel.en: An open flame for the roasting and a 35 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯅꯕ ꯍꯥꯡꯗꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯩ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ꯫

season.en: All year, and cheapest in Mera and Hiyangei.
season.l: ꯆꯍꯤ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯗ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯦꯔꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯃꯤ꯫

recipes.name: Jain Mairen Thongba
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked thin with asafoetida and dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: ꯍꯤꯡ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯔꯦꯞꯄ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ

method.en: Keep the skin on if it is a country mairen. The skin is what stops fourteen kilos collapsing into a single orange mass.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯂꯣꯏꯅꯅ ꯊꯝꯃꯨ꯫ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯱꯴ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯃꯂꯥ ꯃꯆꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯃꯇꯃꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯅ ꯂꯦꯞꯍꯜꯂꯤꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯗꯨꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, and ninety grams is the measure. Any more and a Jain plate tastes of medicine.
method.l: ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯹꯰ꯅꯤ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ꯫ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕꯗꯤ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯄ꯭ꯂꯦꯠ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯍꯤꯗꯥꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯍꯥꯎ ꯄꯤ꯫

method.en: No sugar and no jaggery. A mairen in Mera is sweet on its own and a thongba sweetened on top of that is a kheer with chilli in it.
method.l: ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯨꯕ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯑꯁꯪꯕ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯊꯣꯡꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯣꯔꯣꯛ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯈꯤꯔ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Let it fall apart on its own and do not mash it. Mairen mashed with a ladle goes watery within twenty minutes of standing.
method.l: ꯃꯁꯥꯅ ꯀꯥꯏꯊꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯃꯍꯅꯨ, ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯣꯏ꯫ ꯆꯃꯆꯅ ꯅꯤꯡꯂꯕ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯅꯅ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯀꯨꯅ ꯂꯩꯍꯧꯔꯕꯗ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯔꯛꯏ꯫

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head, the cheapest Jain dish in this book. In Mera a Thoubal field gives more mairen than the kitchen can use and there is no root anywhere in it.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯹ — ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯗ ꯈ꯭ꯋꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ꯫ ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗ ꯊꯧꯕꯥꯂꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯅ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯉꯃꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯃꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ ꯄꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯗ ꯀꯩꯗꯧꯉꯩꯗꯁꯨ ꯂꯩꯃꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: ꯅꯃꯗ꯭ꯔ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯃꯩꯐꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯴꯰꯫

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯳꯵ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯐꯨ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Mera to Wakching, from the field and then the cold room.
season.l: ꯃꯦꯔꯥꯗꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯛꯆꯤꯡ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ, ꯂꯧꯗꯒꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯇꯨꯡꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯀꯥꯗ꯫

recipes.name: Jain Phulkobi Kanghou
recipes.sub: Cauliflower fried dry with asafoetida and no root at all
recipes.sub_l: ꯂꯩꯃꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯗꯅ ꯍꯤꯡꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯂꯕ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ

method.en: Soak the florets ten minutes in salted water and lift them out. There is more in a Lamda cauliflower than cauliflower, and a Jain kitchen looks at that harder than anyone.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯂꯝꯗꯒꯤ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯗ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯗꯒꯤ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯂꯩ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡꯅ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯀꯅꯥꯒꯨꯝꯕꯗꯒꯤꯁꯨ ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯆꯦꯛꯁꯤꯅꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯏ꯫

method.en: Peel the stalk and cut it in with the florets. The stalk is a third of the weight and it is not a root.
method.l: ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯍꯨꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯀꯛꯂꯨ꯫ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯔꯨꯝꯕꯒꯤ ꯑꯍꯨꯃꯁꯨꯕ ꯑꯃꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯂꯩꯃꯥꯏꯗꯒꯤ ꯄꯣꯠ ꯅꯠꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering, sixty grams in twenty kilos. In a Jain kitchen it is the only thing standing where an onion would.
method.l: ꯐꯣꯗꯅꯤꯗ ꯍꯤꯡ, ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯀꯨꯅꯗ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯷꯰꯫ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯀꯁꯥꯡ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯄꯤꯌꯥꯖꯒꯤ ꯃꯐꯃꯗ ꯂꯦꯞꯄ ꯉꯃꯕ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯈꯛꯇꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: Take it off while a floret still snaps. A cauliflower cooked through is a cauliflower nobody looks at twice on the leaf.
method.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯀꯥꯏꯕ ꯉꯃꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯃꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯧꯊꯣꯀꯎ꯫ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯥꯅ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯇꯥꯎꯗ ꯀꯅꯥꯅꯁꯨ ꯑꯅꯤꯔꯛ ꯌꯦꯡꯗꯕ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head. In Lamda the phulkobi is thirty rupees a kilo, the stalk goes in, and a Jain guest gets the same dry sabji as the hall.
recipes.why_l: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯱꯸꯫ ꯂꯝꯗꯗ ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯑꯃꯗ ꯂꯨꯄ꯭ꯄꯥ ꯳꯰ꯅꯤ, ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯗꯨꯁꯨ ꯆꯪꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯂꯃꯍꯩꯅ ꯂꯨꯞꯄꯨꯒ ꯃꯥꯟꯅꯕ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ ꯃꯅꯥ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯐꯉꯏ꯫

start.en: Florets soak ten minutes in salted water. Fifty minutes in all.
start.l: ꯃꯆꯦꯠꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯊꯨꯝ ꯍꯥꯄꯂꯕ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯇꯔꯥ ꯅꯃꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯵꯰꯫

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai and a soaking tray. One cook.
vessel.l: ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯳꯰ ꯂꯤ.ꯒꯤ ꯀꯗꯥꯏ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯃꯅꯕ ꯇ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯃ꯫

season.en: Hiyangei to Lamda, while the cauliflower is in the market.
season.l: ꯐꯨꯜꯀꯣꯕꯤ ꯀꯦꯊꯦꯂꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯃꯇꯃꯗ, ꯍꯤꯌꯥꯡꯒꯩꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ ꯐꯥꯑꯣꯕ꯫

recipes.name: Jain Paneer Thongba
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and cashew gravy with dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯖꯨꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ

method.en: Soak the cashew an hour and grind it with the tomato. In a Jain gravy the cashew does the work of both an onion and a garlic and there is no cheaper honest way.
method.l: ꯀꯥꯖꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯃꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯝꯂꯒ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨꯒ ꯂꯣꯌꯅꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯄꯤꯌꯥꯖ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯆꯥꯅꯝ ꯑꯅꯤꯃꯛꯀꯤ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯀꯥꯖꯨꯅ ꯇꯧꯏ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨꯗꯒꯤ ꯃꯃꯜ ꯇꯝꯕ ꯑꯆꯨꯝꯕ ꯂꯝꯕꯤ ꯑꯃꯠꯇ ꯂꯩꯇꯦ꯫

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the ghee goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and no sugar can be added to a Jain thongba to hide it.
method.l: ꯊꯥꯎ ꯁꯦꯡꯕ ꯍꯥꯄꯗ꯭ꯔꯤꯉꯩꯗ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯲꯵ ꯍꯨꯃꯨ꯫ ꯃꯍꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏꯗ꯭ꯔꯕ ꯍꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯨ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑꯁꯪꯕꯅꯤ, ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯗꯨ ꯂꯣꯅꯁꯤꯅꯅꯕ ꯖꯩꯅꯒꯤ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯆꯤꯅꯤ ꯍꯥꯄꯆꯤꯅꯕ ꯌꯥꯗꯦ꯫

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, a hundred grams in twenty-six litres. It is four times the strength of the fresh root.
method.l: ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯅꯠꯇꯅ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯀꯪꯕ, ꯂꯤꯇꯔ ꯲꯶ꯗ ꯒ꯭ꯔꯥꯝ ꯆꯥꯃ꯫ ꯃꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯄꯥꯉ꯭ꯒꯜ ꯑꯅꯧꯕ ꯁꯤꯡꯒꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯤꯔꯛ ꯍꯦꯟꯅꯅꯤ꯫

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Five kilos boiled in gravy is five kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯀꯗꯕꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ ꯃꯔꯤ ꯃꯃꯥꯡꯗ ꯈꯛꯇ ꯄꯅꯤꯔ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫ ꯊꯣꯡꯕꯗ ꯍꯨꯃꯂꯕ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯉꯥ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯌꯦꯟꯊꯣꯛꯐꯃꯗ ꯔꯕꯔ ꯀꯦ.ꯖꯤ. ꯃꯉꯥꯅꯤ꯫

recipes.why: Fifty-five rupees a head. It is the dish that lets a Jain guest sit at a wedding leaf and be given the same festival gravy as everybody else, with no root and no fresh ginger in it.
